text_en: Now it came to pass after the death of Moses , the servant of the Lord , that the Lord spoke to Joshua, the son of Nun , the minister of Moses , and said to him:
text_la: Et factum est post mortem Moysi servi Domini, ut loqueretur Dominus ad Josue filium Nun, ministrum Moysi, et diceret ei:
text_pt: E sucedeu depois da morte de Moisés, servo do SENHOR, que o SENHOR falou a Josué, filho de Num, servo de Moisés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὴν τελευτὴν Μωυσῆ εἶπεν κύριος τῷ Ἰησοῖ υἱῷ Ναυη τῷ ὑπουργῷ Μωυσῆ λέγων

text_en: Moses my servant is dead: arise, and pass over this Jordan , you and your people with you, into the land which I will give to the children of Israel .
text_la: Moyses servus meus mortuus est : surge, et transi Jordanem istum tu, et omnis populus tecum, in terram quam ego dabo filiis Israël.
text_pt: Moisés, meu servo, é morto; levanta-te, pois, agora, passa este Jordão, tu e todo este povo, à terra que eu dou aos filhos de Israel.
text_el: Μωυσῆς ὁ θεράπων μου τετελεύτηκεν νῦν οὖν ἀναστὰς διάβηθι τὸν Ιορδάνην σὺ καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς οὗτος εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ἐγὼ δίδωμι αὐτοῖς

text_en: I will deliver to you every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, as I have said to Moses .
text_la: Omnem locum, quem calcaverit vestigium pedis vestri, vobis tradam, sicut locutus sum Moysi.
text_pt: Todo o lugar que pisar a planta do vosso pé, vo-lo tenho dado, como eu disse a Moisés.
text_el: πᾶς ὁ τόπος ἐφ' ὃν ἂν ἐπιβῆτε τῷ ἴχνει τῶν ποδῶν ὑμῶν ὑμῖν δώσω αὐτόν ὃν τρόπον εἴρηκα τῷ Μωυσῇ

text_en: From the desert , and from Libanus unto the great river Euphrates, all the land of the Hethites , unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.
text_la: A deserto et Libano usque ad fluvium magnum Euphraten, omnis terra Hethæorum usque ad mare magnum contra solis occasum erit terminus vester.
text_pt: Desde o deserto e do Líbano, até ao grande rio, o rio Eufrates, toda a terra dos heteus, e até o grande mar para o poente do sol, será o vosso termo.
text_el: τὴν ἔρημον καὶ τὸν Ἀντιλίβανον ἕως τοῦ ποταμοῦ τοῦ μεγάλου ποταμοῦ Εὐφράτου καὶ ἕως τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς ἐσχάτης ἀφ' ἡλίου δυσμῶν ἔσται τὰ ὅρια ὑμῶν

text_en: No man shall be able to resist you all the days of your life: as I have been with Moses , so will I be with you: I will not leave you, nor forsake you.
text_la: Nullus poterit vobis resistere cunctis diebus vitæ tuæ : sicut fui cum Moyse, ita ero tecum : non dimittam, nec derelinquam te.
text_pt: Ninguém te poderá resistir, todos os dias da tua vida; como fui com Moisés, assim serei contigo; não te deixarei nem te desampararei.
text_el: οὐκ ἀντιστήσεται ἄνθρωπος κατενώπιον ὑμῶν πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς σου καὶ ὥσπερ ἤμην μετὰ Μωυσῆ οὕτως ἔσομαι καὶ μετὰ σοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἐγκαταλείψω σε οὐδὲ ὑπερόψομαί σε

text_en: Take courage , and be strong: for you shall divide by lot to this people the land for which I swore to their fathers, that I would deliver it to them.
text_la: Confortare, et esto robustus : tu enim sorte divides populo huic terram, pro qua juravi patribus suis, ut traderem eam illis.
text_pt: Esforça-te, e tem bom ânimo; porque tu farás a este povo herdar a terra que jurei a seus pais lhes daria.
text_el: ἴσχυε καὶ ἀνδρίζου σὺ γὰρ ἀποδιαστελεῖς τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσα τοῖς πατράσιν ὑμῶν δοῦναι αὐτοῖς

text_en: Take courage therefore, and be very valiant : that you may observe and do all the law , which Moses my servant has commanded you: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may understand all things which you do.
text_la: Confortare igitur, et esto robustus valde, ut custodias, et facias omnem legem, quam præcepit tibi Moyses servus meus : ne declines ab ea ad dexteram vel ad sinistram, ut intelligas cuncta quæ agis.
text_pt: Tão-somente esforça-te e tem mui bom ânimo, para teres o cuidado de fazer conforme a toda a lei que meu servo Moisés te ordenou; dela não te desvies, nem para a direita nem para a esquerda, para que prudentemente te conduzas por onde quer que andares.
text_el: ἴσχυε οὖν καὶ ἀνδρίζου φυλάσσεσθαι καὶ ποιεῖν καθότι ἐνετείλατό σοι Μωυσῆς ὁ παῖς μου καὶ οὐκ ἐκκλινεῖς ἀπ' αὐτῶν εἰς δεξιὰ οὐδὲ εἰς ἀριστερά ἵνα συνῇς ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ἐὰν πράσσῃς

text_en: Let not the book of this law depart from your mouth: but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe and do all things that are written in it: then shall you direct your way, and understand it.
text_la: Non recedat volumen legis hujus ab ore tuo : sed meditaberis in eo diebus ac noctibus, ut custodias et facias omnia quæ scripta sunt in eo : tunc diriges viam tuam, et intelliges eam.
text_pt: Não se aparte da tua boca o livro desta lei; antes medita nele dia e noite, para que tenhas cuidado de fazer conforme a tudo quanto nele está escrito; porque então farás prosperar o teu caminho, e serás bem sucedido.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἀποστήσεται ἡ βίβλος τοῦ νόμου τούτου ἐκ τοῦ στόματός σου καὶ μελετήσεις ἐν αὐτῷ ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτός ἵνα συνῇς ποιεῖν πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα τότε εὐοδωθήσῃ καὶ εὐοδώσεις τὰς ὁδούς σου καὶ τότε συνήσεις

text_en: Behold I command you, take courage , and be strong. Fear not, and be not dismayed: because the Lord your God is with you in all things whatsoever you shall go to.
text_la: Ecce præcipio tibi : confortare, et esto robustus. Noli metuere, et noli timere : quoniam tecum est Dominus Deus tuus in omnibus ad quæcumque perrexeris.
text_pt: Não to mandei eu? Esforça-te, e tem bom ânimo; não temas, nem te espantes; porque o Senhor teu Deus é contigo, por onde quer que andares.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐντέταλμαί σοι ἴσχυε καὶ ἀνδρίζου μὴ δειλιάσῃς μηδὲ φοβηθῇς ὅτι μετὰ σοῦ κύριος ὁ θεός σου εἰς πάντα οὗ ἐὰν πορεύῃ

text_en: And Joshua commanded the princes of the people, saying: Pass through the midst of the camp, and command the people, and say:
text_la: Præcepitque Josue principibus populi, dicens : Transite per medium castrorum, et imperate populo, ac dicite:
text_pt: Então Josué deu ordem aos príncipes do povo, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο Ἰησοῦς τοῖς γραμματεῦσιν τοῦ λαοῦ λέγων

text_en: Prepare your victuals: for after the third day you shall pass over the Jordan , and shall go in to possess the land, which the Lord your God will give you.
text_la: Præparate vobis cibaria : quoniam post diem tertium transibitis Jordanem, et intrabitis ad possidendam terram quam Dominus Deus vester daturus est vobis.
text_pt: Passai pelo meio do arraial e ordenai ao povo, dizendo: Provede-vos de comida, porque dentro de três dias passareis este Jordão, para que entreis a possuir a terra que vos dá o Senhor vosso Deus, para a possuirdes.
text_el: εἰσέλθατε κατὰ μέσον τῆς παρεμβολῆς τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ ἐντείλασθε τῷ λαῷ λέγοντες ἑτοιμάζεσθε ἐπισιτισμόν ὅτι ἔτι τρεῖς ἡμέραι καὶ ὑμεῖς διαβαίνετε τὸν Ιορδάνην τοῦτον εἰσελθόντες κατασχεῖν τὴν γῆν ἣν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν δίδωσιν ὑμῖν

text_en: And he said to the Rubenites , and the Gadites , and the half tribe of Manasses :
text_la: Rubenitis quoque et Gaditis, et dimidiæ tribui Manasse, ait:
text_pt: E falou Josué aos rubenitas, e aos gaditas, e à meia tribo de Manassés, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ τῷ Ρουβην καὶ τῷ Γαδ καὶ τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς Μανασση εἶπεν Ἰησοῦς

text_en: Remember the word, which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, saying: The Lord your God has given you rest, and all this land.
text_la: Mementote sermonis, quem præcepit vobis Moyses famulus Domini, dicens : Dominus Deus vester dedit vobis requiem, et omnem terram.
text_pt: Lembrai-vos da palavra que vos mandou Moisés, o servo do Senhor, dizendo: O Senhor vosso Deus vos dá descanso, e vos dá esta terra.
text_el: μνήσθητε τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου ὃ ἐνετείλατο ὑμῖν Μωυσῆς ὁ παῖς κυρίου λέγων κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν κατέπαυσεν ὑμᾶς καὶ ἔδωκεν ὑμῖν τὴν γῆν ταύτην

text_en: Your wives, and children; and cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side of the Jordan : but pass you over armed before your brethren all of you that are strong of hand, and fight for them,
text_la: Uxores vestræ, et filii, ac jumenta manebunt in terra, quam tradidit vobis Moyses trans Jordanem : vos autem transite armati ante fratres vestros, omnes fortes manu, et pugnate pro eis,
text_pt: Vossas mulheres, vossos meninos e vosso gado fiquem na terra que Moisés vos deu deste lado do Jordão; porém vós passareis armados na frente de vossos irmãos, todos os valentes e valorosos, e ajudá-los-eis.
text_el: αἱ γυναῖκες ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ παιδία ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ κτήνη ὑμῶν κατοικείτωσαν ἐν τῇ γῇ ᾗ ἔδωκεν ὑμῖν ὑμεῖς δὲ διαβήσεσθε εὔζωνοι πρότεροι τῶν ἀδελφῶν ὑμῶν πᾶς ὁ ἰσχύων καὶ συμμαχήσετε αὐτοῖς

text_en: until the Lord give rest to your brethren, as he has given you, and they also possess the land which the Lord your God will give them: and so you shall return into the land of your possession, and you shall dwell in it, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you beyond the Jordan , toward the rising of the sun.
text_la: donec det Dominus requiem fratribus vestris sicut et vobis dedit, et possideant ipsi quoque terram quam Dominus Deus vester daturus est eis : et sic revertimini in terram possessionis vestræ, et habitabitis in ea, quam vobis dedit Moyses famulus Domini trans Jordanem contra solis ortum.
text_pt: Até que o Senhor dê descanso a vossos irmãos, como a vós, e eles também possuam a terra que o Senhor vosso Deus lhes dá; então tornareis à terra da vossa herança, e possuireis a que vos deu Moisés, o servo do Senhor, deste lado do Jordão, para o nascente do sol.
text_el: ἕως ἂν καταπαύσῃ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὑμῶν ὥσπερ καὶ ὑμᾶς καὶ κληρονομήσωσιν καὶ οὗτοι τὴν γῆν ἣν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν δίδωσιν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἀπελεύσεσθε ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ ἣν δέδωκεν ὑμῖν Μωυσῆς εἰς τὸ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἀπ' ἀνατολῶν ἡλίου

text_en: And they made answer to Joshua , and said: All that you have commanded us, we will do: and whither soever you shall send us, we will go.
text_la: Responderuntque ad Josue, atque dixerunt : Omnia quæ præcepisti nobis, faciemus : et quocumque miseris, ibimus.
text_pt: Então responderam a Josué, dizendo: Tudo quanto nos ordenaste faremos, e onde quer que nos enviares iremos.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθέντες τῷ Ἰησοῖ εἶπαν πάντα ὅσα ἂν ἐντείλῃ ἡμῖν ποιήσομεν καὶ εἰς πάντα τόπον οὗ ἐὰν ἀποστείλῃς ἡμᾶς πορευσόμεθα

text_en: As we obeyed Moses in all things, so will we obey you also: only be the Lord your God with you, as he was with Moses .
text_la: Sicut obedivimus in cunctis Moysi, ita obediemus et tibi : tantum sit Dominus Deus tuus tecum, sicut fuit cum Moyse.
text_pt: Como em tudo ouvimos a Moisés, assim te ouviremos a ti, tão-somente que o Senhor teu Deus seja contigo, como foi com Moisés.
text_el: κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἠκούσαμεν Μωυσῆ ἀκουσόμεθα σοῦ πλὴν ἔστω κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν μετὰ σοῦ ὃν τρόπον ἦν μετὰ Μωυσῆ

text_en: He that shall gainsay your mouth, and not obey all your words, that you shall command him, let him die: only take courage , and do manfully.
text_la: Qui contradixerit ori tuo, et non obedierit cunctis sermonibus, quos præceperis ei, moriatur. Tu tantum confortare, et viriliter age.
text_pt: Todo o homem, que for rebelde às tuas ordens, e não ouvir as tuas palavras em tudo quanto lhe mandares, morrerá. Tão-somente esforça-te, e tem bom ânimo.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἐὰν ἀπειθήσῃ σοι καὶ ὅστις μὴ ἀκούσῃ τῶν ῥημάτων σου καθότι ἂν αὐτῷ ἐντείλῃ ἀποθανέτω ἀλλὰ ἴσχυε καὶ ἀνδρίζου

text_en: And Joshua, the son of Nun , sent from Setim two men , to spy secretly: and said to them: Go, and view the land, and the city of Jericho . They went, and entered into the house of a woman that was a harlot, named Rahab, and lodged with her.
text_la: Misit igitur Josue filius Nun de Setim duos viros exploratores in abscondito : et dixit eis : Ite, et considerate terram, urbemque Jericho. Qui pergentes ingressi sunt domum mulieris meretricis, nomine Rahab, et quieverunt apud eam.
text_pt: E Josué, filho de Num, enviou secretamente, de Sitim, dois homens a espiar, dizendo: Ide reconhecer a terra e a Jericó. Foram, pois, e entraram na casa de uma mulher prostituta, cujo nome era Raabe, e dormiram ali.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ἰησοῦς υἱὸς Ναυη ἐκ Σαττιν δύο νεανίσκους κατασκοπεῦσαι λέγων ἀνάβητε καὶ ἴδετε τὴν γῆν καὶ τὴν Ιεριχω καὶ πορευθέντες εἰσήλθοσαν οἱ δύο νεανίσκοι εἰς Ιεριχω καὶ εἰσήλθοσαν εἰς οἰκίαν γυναικὸς πόρνης ᾗ ὄνομα Ρααβ καὶ κατέλυσαν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And it was told the king of Jericho , and was said: Behold there are men come in hither, by night, of the children of Israel , to spy the land.
text_la: Nuntiatumque est regi Jericho, et dictum : Ecce viri ingressi sunt huc per noctem de filiis Israël, ut explorarent terram.
text_pt: Então deu-se notícia ao rei de Jericó, dizendo: Eis que esta noite vieram aqui uns homens dos filhos de Israel, para espiar a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἀπηγγέλη τῷ βασιλεῖ Ιεριχω λέγοντες εἰσπεπόρευνται ὧδε ἄνδρες τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ κατασκοπεῦσαι τὴν γῆν

text_en: And the king of Jericho sent to Rahab, saying: Bring forth the men that came to you, and are entered into your house: for they are spies, and have come to view all the land.
text_la: Misitque rex Jericho ad Rahab, dicens : Educ viros, qui venerunt ad te, et ingressi sunt domum tuam : exploratores quippe sunt, et omnem terram considerare venerunt.
text_pt: Por isso mandou o rei de Jericó dizer a Raabe: Tira fora os homens que vieram a ti e entraram na tua casa, porque vieram espiar toda a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ιεριχω καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς Ρααβ λέγων ἐξάγαγε τοὺς ἄνδρας τοὺς εἰσπεπορευμένους εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν σου τὴν νύκτα κατασκοπεῦσαι γὰρ τὴν γῆν ἥκασιν

text_en: And the woman taking the men , hid them, and said: I confess they came to me, but I knew not whence they were:
text_la: Tollensque mulier viros, abscondit, et ait : Fateor, venerunt ad me, sed nesciebam unde essent:
text_pt: Porém aquela mulher tomou os dois homens, e os escondeu, e disse: É verdade que vieram homens a mim, porém eu não sabia de onde eram.
text_el: καὶ λαβοῦσα ἡ γυνὴ τοὺς ἄνδρας ἔκρυψεν αὐτοὺς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς λέγουσα εἰσεληλύθασιν πρός με οἱ ἄνδρες

text_en: And at the time of shutting the gate in the dark, they also went out together. I know not whither they have gone: pursue after them quickly, and you will overtake them.
text_la: cumque porta clauderetur in tenebris, et illi pariter exierunt; nescio quo abierunt : persequimini cito, et comprehendetis eos.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, havendo-se de fechar a porta, sendo já escuro, aqueles homens saíram; não sei para onde aqueles homens se foram; ide após eles depressa, porque os alcançareis.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἡ πύλη ἐκλείετο ἐν τῷ σκότει καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες ἐξῆλθον οὐκ ἐπίσταμαι ποῦ πεπόρευνται καταδιώξατε ὀπίσω αὐτῶν εἰ καταλήμψεσθε αὐτούς

text_en: But she made the men go up to the top of her house, and covered them with the stalks of flax, which was there.
text_la: Ipsa autem fecit ascendere viros in solarium domus suæ, operuitque eos stipula lini, quæ ibi erat.
text_pt: Porém ela os tinha feito subir ao eirado, e os tinha escondido entre as canas do linho, que pusera em ordem sobre o eirado.
text_el: αὐτὴ δὲ ἀνεβίβασεν αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τὸ δῶμα καὶ ἔκρυψεν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ λινοκαλάμῃ τῇ ἐστοιβασμένῃ αὐτῇ ἐπὶ τοῦ δώματος

text_en: Now they that were sent, pursued after them, by the way that leads to the fords of the Jordan : and as soon as they had gone out, the gate was presently shut.
text_la: Hi autem, qui missi fuerant, secuti sunt eos per viam, quæ ducit ad vadum Jordanis : illisque egressis statim porta clausa est.
text_pt: E foram-se aqueles homens após eles pelo caminho do Jordão, até aos vaus; e, havendo eles saído, fechou-se a porta.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες κατεδίωξαν ὀπίσω αὐτῶν ὁδὸν τὴν ἐπὶ τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἐπὶ τὰς διαβάσεις καὶ ἡ πύλη ἐκλείσθη καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἐξήλθοσαν οἱ διώκοντες ὀπίσω αὐτῶν

text_en: The men that were hid were not yet asleep, when behold the woman went up to them, and said:
text_la: Necdum obdormierant qui latebant, et ecce mulier ascendit ad eos, et ait:
text_pt: E, antes que eles dormissem, ela subiu a eles no eirado;
text_el: καὶ αὐτοὶ δὲ πρὶν ἢ κοιμηθῆναι αὐτούς καὶ αὐτὴ ἀνέβη ἐπὶ τὸ δῶμα πρὸς αὐτοὺς

text_en: I know that the Lord has given this land to you: for the dread of you is fallen upon us, and all the inhabitants of the land have lost all strength.
text_la: Novi quod Dominus tradiderit vobis terram : etenim irruit in nos terror vester, et elanguerunt omnes habitatores terræ.
text_pt: E disse aos homens: Bem sei que o Senhor vos deu esta terra e que o pavor de vós caiu sobre nós, e que todos os moradores da terra estão desfalecidos diante de vós.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς ἐπίσταμαι ὅτι δέδωκεν ὑμῖν κύριος τὴν γῆν ἐπιπέπτωκεν γὰρ ὁ φόβος ὑμῶν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς

text_en: We have heard that the Lord dried up the water of the Red Sea , at your going in, when you came out of Egypt : and what things you did to the two kings of the Amorrhites , that were beyond the Jordan , Sehon and Og whom you slew.
text_la: Audivimus quod siccaverit Dominus aquas maris Rubri ad vestrum introitum, quando egressi estis ex Ægypto : et quæ feceritis duobus Amorrhæorum regibus, qui erant trans Jordanem, Sehon et Og, quos interfecistis.
text_pt: Porque temos ouvido que o Senhor secou as águas do Mar Vermelho diante de vós, quando saíeis do Egito, e o que fizestes aos dois reis dos amorreus, a Siom e a Ogue, que estavam além do Jordão, os quais destruístes.
text_el: ἀκηκόαμεν γὰρ ὅτι κατεξήρανεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τὴν ἐρυθρὰν θάλασσαν ἀπὸ προσώπου ὑμῶν ὅτε ἐξεπορεύεσθε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου καὶ ὅσα ἐποίησεν τοῖς δυσὶ βασιλεῦσιν τῶν Αμορραίων οἳ ἦσαν πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου τῷ Σηων καὶ Ωγ οὓς ἐξωλεθρεύσατε αὐτούς

text_en: And at the hearing these things, we were affrighted, and our heart fainted away, neither did there remain any spirit in us, at your coming in: for the Lord your God he is God in heaven above, and in the earth beneath.
text_la: Et hæc audientes pertimuimus, et elanguit cor nostrum, nec remansit in nobis spiritus ad introitum vestrum : Dominus enim Deus vester ipse est Deus in cælo sursum et in terra deorsum.
text_pt: O que ouvindo, desfaleceu o nosso coração, e em ninguém mais há ânimo algum, por causa da vossa presença; porque o Senhor vosso Deus é Deus em cima nos céus e em baixo na terra.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσαντες ἡμεῖς ἐξέστημεν τῇ καρδίᾳ ἡμῶν καὶ οὐκ ἔστη ἔτι πνεῦμα ἐν οὐδενὶ ἡμῶν ἀπὸ προσώπου ὑμῶν ὅτι κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν θεὸς ἐν οὐρανῷ ἄνω καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς κάτω

text_en: Now, therefore, swear to me by the Lord , that as I have showed mercy to you, so you also will show mercy to my father's house: and give me a true token.
text_la: Nunc ergo jurate mihi per Dominum, ut quomodo ego misericordiam feci vobiscum, ita et vos faciatis cum domo patris mei : detisque mihi verum signum,
text_pt: Agora, pois, jurai-me, vos peço, pelo Senhor, que, como usei de misericórdia convosco, vós também usareis de misericórdia para com a casa de meu pai, e dai-me um sinal seguro,
text_el: καὶ νῦν ὀμόσατέ μοι κύριον τὸν θεόν ὅτι ποιῶ ὑμῖν ἔλεος καὶ ποιήσετε καὶ ὑμεῖς ἔλεος ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ πατρός μου

text_en: That you will save my father and mother , my brethren and sisters, and all things that are theirs, and deliver our souls from death.
text_la: ut salvetis patrem meum et matrem, et fratres ac sorores meas, et omnia quæ illorum sunt, et eruatis animas nostras a morte.
text_pt: De que conservareis com a vida a meu pai e a minha mãe, como também a meus irmãos e a minhas irmãs, com tudo o que têm e de que livrareis as nossas vidas da morte.
text_el: καὶ ζωγρήσετε τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός μου καὶ τὴν μητέρα μου καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφούς μου καὶ πάντα τὸν οἶκόν μου καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἐστὶν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐξελεῖσθε τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐκ θανάτου

text_en: They answered her: Be our lives for you unto death, only if you betray us not. And when the Lord shall have delivered us the land, we will show you mercy and truth .
text_la: Qui responderunt ei : Anima nostra sit pro vobis in mortem, si tamen non prodideris nos : cumque tradiderit nobis Dominus terram, faciemus in te misericordiam et veritatem.
text_pt: Então aqueles homens responderam-lhe: A nossa vida responderá pela vossa até à morte, se não denunciardes este nosso negócio, e será, pois, que, dando-nos o Senhor esta terra, usaremos contigo de misericórdia e de fidelidade.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῇ οἱ ἄνδρες ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν ἀνθ' ὑμῶν εἰς θάνατον καὶ αὐτὴ εἶπεν ὡς ἂν παραδῷ κύριος ὑμῖν τὴν πόλιν ποιήσετε εἰς ἐμὲ ἔλεος καὶ ἀλήθειαν

text_en: Then she let them down with a cord out of a window: for her house joined close to the wall.
text_la: Demisit ergo eos per funem de fenestra : domus enim ejus hærebat muro.
text_pt: Ela então os fez descer por uma corda pela janela, porquanto a sua casa estava sobre o muro da cidade, e ela morava sobre o muro.
text_el: καὶ κατεχάλασεν αὐτοὺς διὰ τῆς θυρίδος

text_en: And she said to them: Get up to the mountains, lest perhaps they meet you as they return: and there lie hid three days, till they come back, and so you shall go on your way.
text_la: Dixitque ad eos : Ad montana conscendite, ne forte occurrant vobis revertentes : ibique latitate tribus diebus, donec redeant, et sic ibitis per viam vestram.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Ide-vos ao monte, para que, porventura, não vos encontrem os perseguidores, e escondei-vos lá três dias, até que voltem os perseguidores, e depois ide pelo vosso caminho.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς εἰς τὴν ὀρεινὴν ἀπέλθετε μὴ συναντήσωσιν ὑμῖν οἱ καταδιώκοντες καὶ κρυβήσεσθε ἐκεῖ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἕως ἂν ἀποστρέψωσιν οἱ καταδιώκοντες ὀπίσω ὑμῶν καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἀπελεύσεσθε εἰς τὴν ὁδὸν ὑμῶν

text_en: And they said to her: We shall be blameless of this oath , which you have made us swear ,
text_la: Qui dixerunt ad eam : Innoxii erimus a juramento hoc, quo adjurasti nos:
text_pt: E, disseram-lhe aqueles homens: Desobrigados seremos deste juramento que nos fizeste jurar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ ἄνδρες πρὸς αὐτήν ἀθῷοί ἐσμεν τῷ ὅρκῳ σου τούτῳ

text_en: if, when we come into the land, this scarlet cord be a sign, and you tie it in the window, by which you have let us down: and gather together your father and mother , and brethren, and all your kindred into your house.
text_la: si ingredientibus nobis terram, signum fuerit funiculus iste coccineus, et ligaveris eum in fenestra, per quam demisisti nos : et patrem tuum ac matrem, fratresque et omnem cognationem tuam congregaveris in domum tuam.
text_pt: Eis que, quando nós entrarmos na terra, atarás este cordão de fio de escarlata à janela por onde nos fizeste descer; e recolherás em casa contigo a teu pai, e a tua mãe, e a teus irmãos e a toda a família de teu pai.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς εἰσπορευόμεθα εἰς μέρος τῆς πόλεως καὶ θήσεις τὸ σημεῖον τὸ σπαρτίον τὸ κόκκινον τοῦτο ἐκδήσεις εἰς τὴν θυρίδα δι' ἧς κατεβίβασας ἡμᾶς δι' αὐτῆς τὸν δὲ πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα σου καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου καὶ πάντα τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός σου συνάξεις πρὸς σεαυτὴν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν σου

text_en: Whosoever shall go out of the door of your house, his blood shall be upon his own head, and we shall be quit. But the blood of all that shall be with you in the house, shall light upon our head, if any man touch them.
text_la: Qui ostium domus tuæ egressus fuerit, sanguis ipsius erit in caput ejus, et nos erimus alieni. Cunctorum autem sanguis, qui tecum in domo fuerint, redundabit in caput nostrum, si eos aliquis tetigerit.
text_pt: Será, pois, que qualquer que sair fora da porta da tua casa o seu sangue será sobre a sua cabeça, e nós seremos inocentes; mas qualquer que estiver contigo, em casa, o seu sangue seja sobre a nossa cabeça, se alguém nele puser mão.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται πᾶς ὃς ἂν ἐξέλθῃ τὴν θύραν τῆς οἰκίας σου ἔξω ἔνοχος ἑαυτῷ ἔσται ἡμεῖς δὲ ἀθῷοι τῷ ὅρκῳ σου τούτῳ καὶ ὅσοι ἐὰν γένωνται μετὰ σοῦ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ σου ἡμεῖς ἔνοχοι ἐσόμεθα

text_en: But if you will betray us, and utter this word abroad, we shall be quit of this oath , which you have made us swear .
text_la: Quod si nos prodere volueris, et sermonem istum proferre in medium, erimus mundi ab hoc juramento, quo adjurasti nos.
text_pt: Porém, se tu denunciares este nosso negócio, seremos desobrigados do juramento que nos fizeste jurar.
text_el: ἐὰν δέ τις ἡμᾶς ἀδικήσῃ ἢ καὶ ἀποκαλύψῃ τοὺς λόγους ἡμῶν τούτους ἐσόμεθα ἀθῷοι τῷ ὅρκῳ σου τούτῳ

text_en: And she answered: As you have spoken, so be it done: and sending them on their way, she hung the scarlet cord in the window.
text_la: Et illa respondit : Sicut locuti estis, ita fiat : dimittensque eos ut pergerent, appendit funiculum coccineum in fenestra.
text_pt: E ela disse: Conforme as vossas palavras, assim seja. Então os despediu; e eles se foram; e ela atou o cordão de escarlata à janela.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα ὑμῶν οὕτως ἔστω καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν αὐτούς

text_en: But they went and came to the mountains, and stayed there three days, till they that pursued them were returned. For having sought them through all the way, they found them not.
text_la: Illi vero ambulantes pervenerunt ad montana, et manserunt ibi tres dies, donec reverterentur qui fuerant persecuti : quærentes enim per omnem viam, non repererunt eos.
text_pt: Foram-se, pois, e chegaram ao monte, e ficaram ali três dias, até que voltaram os perseguidores, porque os perseguidores os buscaram por todo o caminho, porém não os acharam.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν καὶ ἤλθοσαν εἰς τὴν ὀρεινὴν καὶ κατέμειναν ἐκεῖ τρεῖς ἡμέρας καὶ ἐξεζήτησαν οἱ καταδιώκοντες πάσας τὰς ὁδοὺς καὶ οὐχ εὕροσαν

text_en: And when they had gone back into the city, the spies returned, and came down from the mountain: and passing over the Jordan , they came to Joshua, the son of Nun , and told him all that befell them,
text_la: Quibus urbem ingressis, reversi sunt, et descenderunt exploratores de monte : et, transmisso Jordane, venerunt ad Josue filium Nun, narraveruntque ei omnia quæ acciderant sibi,
text_pt: Assim aqueles dois homens voltaram, e desceram do monte, e passaram, e chegaram a Josué, filho de Num, e contaram-lhe tudo quanto lhes acontecera;
text_el: καὶ ὑπέστρεψαν οἱ δύο νεανίσκοι καὶ κατέβησαν ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους καὶ διέβησαν πρὸς Ἰησοῦν υἱὸν Ναυη καὶ διηγήσαντο αὐτῷ πάντα τὰ συμβεβηκότα αὐτοῖς

text_en: and said: the Lord has delivered all this land into our hands, and all the inhabitants thereof are overthrown with fear.
text_la: atque dixerunt : Tradidit Dominus omnem terram hanc in manus nostras, et timore prostrati sunt cuncti habitatores ejus.
text_pt: E disseram a Josué: Certamente o Senhor tem dado toda esta terra nas nossas mãos, pois até todos os moradores estão atemorizados diante de nós.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς Ἰησοῦν ὅτι παρέδωκεν κύριος πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἐν χειρὶ ἡμῶν καὶ κατέπτηκεν πᾶς ὁ κατοικῶν τὴν γῆν ἐκείνην ἀφ' ἡμῶν

text_en: And Joshua rose before daylight, and removed the camp: and they departed from Setim , and came to the Jordan : he, and all the children of Israel , and they abode there for three days.
text_la: Igitur Josue de nocte consurgens movit castra : egredientesque de Setim, venerunt ad Jordanem ipse et omnes filii Israël, et morati sunt ibi tres dies.
text_pt: Levantou-se, pois, Josué de madrugada, e partiram de Sitim, ele e todos os filhos de Israel; e vieram até ao Jordão, e pousaram ali, antes que passassem.
text_el: καὶ ὤρθρισεν Ἰησοῦς τὸ πρωί καὶ ἀπῆραν ἐκ Σαττιν καὶ ἤλθοσαν ἕως τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ κατέλυσαν ἐκεῖ πρὸ τοῦ διαβῆναι

text_en: After which, the heralds went through the midst of the camp,
text_la: Quibus evolutis transierunt præcones per castrorum medium,
text_pt: E sucedeu, ao fim de três dias, que os oficiais passaram pelo meio do arraial;
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας διῆλθον οἱ γραμματεῖς διὰ τῆς παρεμβολῆς

text_en: and began to proclaim: When you shall see the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God , and the priests of the race of Levi carrying it, rise you up also, and follow them as they go before:
text_la: et clamare cœperunt : Quando videritis arcam fœderis Domini Dei vestri, et sacerdotes stirpis Leviticæ portantes eam, vos quoque consurgite, et sequimini præcedentes:
text_pt: E ordenaram ao povo, dizendo: Quando virdes a arca da aliança do Senhor vosso Deus, e que os sacerdotes levitas a levam, partireis vós também do vosso lugar, e a seguireis.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλαντο τῷ λαῷ λέγοντες ὅταν ἴδητε τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ τοὺς ἱερεῖς ἡμῶν καὶ τοὺς Λευίτας αἴροντας αὐτήν ἀπαρεῖτε ἀπὸ τῶν τόπων ὑμῶν καὶ πορεύεσθε ὀπίσω αὐτῆς

text_en: And let there be between you and the ark the space of two thousand cubits: that you may see it afar off, and know which way you must go: for you have not gone this way before: and take care you come not near the ark .
text_la: sitque inter vos et arcam spatium cubitorum duum millium : ut procul videre possitis, et nosse per quam viam ingrediamini : quia prius non ambulastis per eam : et cavete ne appropinquetis ad arcam.
text_pt: Haja contudo, entre vós e ela, uma distância de dois mil côvados; e não vos chegueis a ela, para que saibais o caminho pelo qual haveis de ir; porquanto por este caminho nunca passastes antes.
text_el: ἀλλὰ μακρὰν ἔστω ἀνὰ μέσον ὑμῶν καὶ ἐκείνης ὅσον δισχιλίους πήχεις στήσεσθε μὴ προσεγγίσητε αὐτῇ ἵν' ἐπίστησθε τὴν ὁδόν ἣν πορεύεσθε αὐτήν οὐ γὰρ πεπόρευσθε τὴν ὁδὸν ἀπ' ἐχθὲς καὶ τρίτης ἡμέρας

text_en: And Joshua said to the people: Be sanctified : for tomorrow the Lord will do wonders among you.
text_la: Dixitque Josue ad populum : Sanctificamini : cras enim faciet Dominus inter vos mirabilia.
text_pt: Disse Josué também ao povo: Santificai-vos, porque amanhã fará o Senhor maravilhas no meio de vós.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰησοῦς τῷ λαῷ ἁγνίσασθε εἰς αὔριον ὅτι αὔριον ποιήσει ἐν ὑμῖν κύριος θαυμαστά

text_en: And he said to the priests : Take up the ark of the covenant , and go before the people. And they obeyed his commands, and took it up, and walked before them.
text_la: Et ait ad sacerdotes : Tollite arcam fœderis, et præcedite populum. Qui jussa complentes, tulerunt, et ambulaverunt ante eos.
text_pt: E falou Josué aos sacerdotes, dizendo: Levantai a arca da aliança, e passai adiante deste povo. Levantaram, pois, a arca da aliança, e foram andando adiante do povo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰησοῦς τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν ἄρατε τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου καὶ προπορεύεσθε τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ ἦραν οἱ ἱερεῖς τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου καὶ ἐπορεύοντο ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: And the Lord said to Joshua : This day will I begin to exalt you before Israel : that they may know that as I was with Moses , so I am with you also.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Josue : Hodie incipiam exaltare te coram omni Israël : ut sciant quod sicut cum Moyse fui, ita et tecum sim.
text_pt: E o Senhor disse a Josué: Hoje começarei a engrandecer-te perante os olhos de todo o Israel, para que saibam que, assim como fui com Moisés, assim serei contigo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Ἰησοῦν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ ἄρχομαι ὑψῶσαί σε κατενώπιον πάντων υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἵνα γνῶσιν καθότι ἤμην μετὰ Μωυσῆ οὕτως ἔσομαι καὶ μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: And command the priests , that carry the ark of the covenant , and say to them: When you shall have entered into part of the water of the Jordan , stand in it.
text_la: Tu autem præcipe sacerdotibus, qui portant arcam fœderis, et dic eis : Cum ingressi fueritis partem aquæ Jordanis, state in ea.
text_pt: Tu, pois, ordenarás aos sacerdotes que levam a arca da aliança, dizendo: Quando chegardes à beira das águas do Jordão, parareis aí.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἔντειλαι τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν τοῖς αἴρουσιν τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης λέγων ὡς ἂν εἰσέλθητε ἐπὶ μέρους τοῦ ὕδατος τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ ἐν τῷ Ιορδάνῃ στήσεσθε

text_en: And Joshua said to the children of Israel : Come hither, and hear the word of the Lord your God .
text_la: Dixitque Josue ad filios Israël : Accedite huc, et audite verbum Domini Dei vestri.
text_pt: Então disse Josué aos filhos de Israel: Chegai-vos para cá, e ouvi as palavras do Senhor vosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰησοῦς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ προσαγάγετε ὧδε καὶ ἀκούσατε τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: And again he said: By this you shall know, that the Lord , the living God , is in the midst of you, and that he shall destroy, before your sight, the Chanaanite and the Hethite , the Hevite and the Pherezite, the Gergesite also, and the Jebusite, and the Amorrhite .
text_la: Et rursum : In hoc, inquit, scietis quod Dominus Deus vivens in medio vestri est, et disperdet in conspectu vestro Chananæum et Hethæum, Hevæum et Pherezæum, Gergesæum quoque et Jebusæum, et Amorrhæum.
text_pt: Disse mais Josué: Nisto conhecereis que o Deus vivo está no meio de vós; e que certamente lançará de diante de vós aos cananeus, e aos heteus, e aos heveus, e aos perizeus, e aos girgaseus, e aos amorreus, e aos jebuseus.
text_el: ἐν τούτῳ γνώσεσθε ὅτι θεὸς ζῶν ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ ὀλεθρεύων ὀλεθρεύσει ἀπὸ προσώπου ἡμῶν τὸν Χαναναῖον καὶ τὸν Χετταῖον καὶ τὸν Φερεζαῖον καὶ τὸν Ευαῖον καὶ τὸν Αμορραῖον καὶ τὸν Γεργεσαῖον καὶ τὸν Ιεβουσαῖον

text_en: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth shall go before you into the Jordan .
text_la: Ecce arca fœderis Domini omnis terræ antecedet vos per Jordanem.
text_pt: Eis que a arca da aliança do Senhor de toda a terra passa o Jordão diante de vós.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἡ κιβωτὸς διαθήκης κυρίου πάσης τῆς γῆς διαβαίνει τὸν Ιορδάνην

text_en: Prepare twelve men of the tribes of Israel , one of every tribe .
text_la: Parate duodecim viros de tribubus Israël, singulos per singulas tribus.
text_pt: Tomai, pois, agora doze homens das tribos de Israel, de cada tribo um homem;
text_el: προχειρίσασθε ὑμῖν δώδεκα ἄνδρας ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἕνα ἀφ' ἑκάστης φυλῆς

text_en: And when the priests , that carry the ark of the Lord the God of the whole earth, shall set the soles of their feet in the waters of the Jordan , the waters that are beneath shall run down and go off: and those that come from above, shall stand together upon a heap.
text_la: Et cum posuerint vestigia pedum suorum sacerdotes qui portant arcam Domini Dei universæ terræ in aquis Jordanis, aquæ quæ inferiores sunt, decurrent atque deficient : quæ autem desuper veniunt, in una mole consistent.
text_pt: Porque há de acontecer que, assim que as plantas dos pés dos sacerdotes, que levam a arca do Senhor, o Senhor de toda a terra, repousem nas águas do Jordão, se separarão as águas do Jordão, e as águas, que vêm de cima, pararão amontoadas.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὡς ἂν καταπαύσωσιν οἱ πόδες τῶν ἱερέων τῶν αἰρόντων τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου πάσης τῆς γῆς ἐν τῷ ὕδατι τοῦ Ιορδάνου τὸ ὕδωρ τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἐκλείψει τὸ δὲ ὕδωρ τὸ καταβαῖνον στήσεται

text_en: So the people went out of their tents, to pass over the Jordan : and the priests that carried the ark of the covenant , went on before them.
text_la: Igitur egressus est populus de tabernaculis suis, ut transiret Jordanem : et sacerdotes, qui portabant arcam fœderis, pergebant ante eum.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, partindo o povo das suas tendas, para passar o Jordão, levavam os sacerdotes a arca da aliança adiante do povo.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆρεν ὁ λαὸς ἐκ τῶν σκηνωμάτων αὐτῶν διαβῆναι τὸν Ιορδάνην οἱ δὲ ἱερεῖς ἤροσαν τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου πρότεροι τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: And as soon as they came into the Jordan , and their feet were dipped in part of the water, (now the Jordan , it being harvest time, had filled the banks of its channel),
text_la: Ingressisque eis Jordanem, et pedibus eorum in parte aquæ tinctis (Jordanis autem ripas alvei sui tempore messis impleverat),
text_pt: E quando os que levavam a arca, chegaram ao Jordão, e os seus pés se molharam na beira das águas (porque o Jordão transbordava sobre todas as suas ribanceiras, todos os dias da ceifa),
text_el: ὡς δὲ εἰσεπορεύοντο οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ αἴροντες τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης ἐπὶ τὸν Ιορδάνην καὶ οἱ πόδες τῶν ἱερέων τῶν αἰρόντων τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου ἐβάφησαν εἰς μέρος τοῦ ὕδατος τοῦ Ιορδάνου ὁ δὲ Ιορδάνης ἐπλήρου καθ' ὅλην τὴν κρηπῖδα αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ ἡμέραι θερισμοῦ πυρῶν

text_en: the waters that came down from above stood in one place, and swelling up like a mountain, were seen afar off, from the city that is called Adom, to the place of Sarthan: but those that were beneath, ran down into the sea of the wilderness , (which now is called the Dead Sea ) until they wholly failed.
text_la: steterunt aquæ descendentes in loco uno, et ad instar montis intumescentes apparebant procul, ab urbe quæ vocatur Adom usque ad locum Sarthan : quæ autem inferiores erant, in mare Solitudinis (quod nunc vocatur Mortuum) descenderunt, usquequo omnino deficerent.
text_pt: Pararam-se as águas, que vinham de cima; levantaram-se num montão, mui longe da cidade de Adão, que está ao lado de Zaretã; e as que desciam ao mar das campinas, que é o Mar Salgado, foram de todo separadas; então passou o povo em frente de Jericó.
text_el: καὶ ἔστη τὰ ὕδατα τὰ καταβαίνοντα ἄνωθεν ἔστη πῆγμα ἓν ἀφεστηκὸς μακρὰν σφόδρα σφοδρῶς ἕως μέρους Καριαθιαριμ τὸ δὲ καταβαῖνον κατέβη εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν Αραβα θάλασσαν ἁλός ἕως εἰς τὸ τέλος ἐξέλιπεν καὶ ὁ λαὸς εἱστήκει ἀπέναντι Ιεριχω

text_en: And the people marched over against Jericho : and the priests that carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord , stood girded upon the dry ground in the midst of the Jordan , and all the people passed over, through the channel that was dried up.
text_la: Populus autem incedebat contra Jericho : et sacerdotes qui portabant arcam fœderis Domini, stabant super siccam humum in medio Jordanis accincti, omnisque populus per arentem alveum transibat.
text_pt: Porém os sacerdotes, que levavam a arca da aliança do Senhor, pararam firmes, em seco, no meio do Jordão, e todo o Israel passou a seco, até que todo o povo acabou de passar o Jordão.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησαν οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ αἴροντες τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου ἐπὶ ξηρᾶς ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ πάντες οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ διέβαινον διὰ ξηρᾶς ἕως συνετέλεσεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς διαβαίνων τὸν Ιορδάνην

text_en: And when they were passed over, the Lord said to Joshua :
text_la: Quibus transgressis, dixit Dominus ad Josue:
text_pt: Sucedeu que, acabando todo o povo de passar o Jordão, falou o SENHOR a Josué, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐπεὶ συνετέλεσεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς διαβαίνων τὸν Ιορδάνην καὶ εἶπεν κύριος τῷ Ἰησοῖ λέγων

text_en: Choose twelve men , one of every tribe :
text_la: Elige duodecim viros singulos per singulas tribus:
text_pt: Tomai do povo doze homens, de cada tribo um homem;
text_el: παραλαβὼν ἄνδρας ἀπὸ τοῦ λαοῦ ἕνα ἀφ' ἑκάστης φυλῆς

text_en: And command them to take out of the midst of the Jordan , where the feet of the priests stood, twelve very hard stones, which you shall set in the place of the camp, where you shall pitch your tents this night.
text_la: et præcipe eis ut tollant de medio Jordanis alveo, ubi steterunt pedes sacerdotum, duodecim durissimos lapides, quos ponetis in loco castrorum, ubi fixeritis hac nocte tentoria.
text_pt: E mandai-lhes, dizendo: Tirai daqui, do meio do Jordão, do lugar onde estavam firmes os pés dos sacerdotes, doze pedras; e levai-as convosco à outra margem e depositai-as no alojamento em que haveis de passar esta noite.
text_el: σύνταξον αὐτοῖς λέγων ἀνέλεσθε ἐκ μέσου τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἑτοίμους δώδεκα λίθους καὶ τούτους διακομίσαντες ἅμα ὑμῖν αὐτοῖς θέτε αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ στρατοπεδείᾳ ὑμῶν οὗ ἐὰν παρεμβάλητε ἐκεῖ τὴν νύκτα

text_en: And Joshua called twelve men , whom he had chosen out of the children of Israel , one out of every tribe ,
text_la: Vocavitque Josue duodecim viros, quos elegerat de filiis Israël, singulos de singulis tribubus,
text_pt: Chamou, pois, Josué os doze homens, que escolhera dos filhos de Israel; de cada tribo um homem;
text_el: καὶ ἀνακαλεσάμενος Ἰησοῦς δώδεκα ἄνδρας τῶν ἐνδόξων ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἕνα ἀφ' ἑκάστης φυλῆς

text_en: and he said to them: Go before the ark of the Lord your God to the midst of the Jordan , and carry from thence every man a stone on your shoulders, according to the number of the children of Israel ,
text_la: et ait ad eos : Ite ante arcam Domini Dei vestri ad Jordanis medium, et portate inde singuli singulos lapides in humeris vestris, juxta numerum filiorum Israël,
text_pt: E disse-lhes Josué: Passai adiante da arca do Senhor vosso Deus, ao meio do Jordão; e cada um levante uma pedra sobre o ombro, segundo o número das tribos dos filhos de Israel;
text_el: εἶπεν αὐτοῖς προσαγάγετε ἔμπροσθέν μου πρὸ προσώπου κυρίου εἰς μέσον τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ ἀνελόμενος ἐκεῖθεν ἕκαστος λίθον ἀράτω ἐπὶ τῶν ὤμων αὐτοῦ κατὰ τὸν ἀριθμὸν τῶν δώδεκα φυλῶν τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: that it may be a sign among you: and when your children shall ask you tomorrow, saying: What means these stones?
text_la: ut sit signum inter vos : et quando interrogaverint vos filii vestri cras, dicentes : Quid sibi volunt isti lapides?
text_pt: Para que isto seja por sinal entre vós; e quando vossos filhos no futuro perguntarem, dizendo: Que significam estas pedras?
text_el: ἵνα ὑπάρχωσιν ὑμῖν οὗτοι εἰς σημεῖον κείμενον διὰ παντός ἵνα ὅταν ἐρωτᾷ σε ὁ υἱός σου αὔριον λέγων τί εἰσιν οἱ λίθοι οὗτοι ὑμῖν

text_en: You shall answer them: The waters of the Jordan ran off before the ark of the covenant of the Lord when it passed over the same: therefore were these stones set for a monument of the children of Israel forever.
text_la: respondebitis eis : Defecerunt aquæ Jordanis ante arcam fœderis Domini, cum transiret eum : idcirco positi sunt lapides isti in monimentum filiorum Israël usque in æternum.
text_pt: Então lhes direis que as águas do Jordão se separaram diante da arca da aliança do Senhor; passando ela pelo Jordão, separaram-se as águas do Jordão; assim estas pedras serão para sempre por memorial aos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ σὺ δηλώσεις τῷ υἱῷ σου λέγων ὅτι ἐξέλιπεν ὁ Ιορδάνης ποταμὸς ἀπὸ προσώπου κιβωτοῦ διαθήκης κυρίου πάσης τῆς γῆς ὡς διέβαινεν αὐτόν καὶ ἔσονται οἱ λίθοι οὗτοι ὑμῖν μνημόσυνον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: The children of Israel therefore did as Joshua commanded them, carrying out of the channel of the Jordan twelve stones, as the Lord had commanded him according to the number of the children of Israel unto the place wherein they camped, and there they set them.
text_la: Fecerunt ergo filii Israël sicut præcepit eis Josue, portantes de medio Jordanis alveo duodecim lapides, ut Dominus ei imperarat, juxta numerum filiorum Israël, usque ad locum in quo castrametati sunt, ibique posuerunt eos.
text_pt: Fizeram, pois, os filhos de Israel assim como Josué tinha ordenado, e levantaram doze pedras do meio do Jordão como o Senhor dissera a Josué, segundo o número das tribos dos filhos de Israel; e levaram-nas consigo ao alojamento, e as depositaram ali.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν οὕτως οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καθότι ἐνετείλατο κύριος τῷ Ἰησοῖ καὶ λαβόντες δώδεκα λίθους ἐκ μέσου τοῦ Ιορδάνου καθάπερ συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Ἰησοῖ ἐν τῇ συντελείᾳ τῆς διαβάσεως τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ διεκόμισαν ἅμα ἑαυτοῖς εἰς τὴν παρεμβολὴν καὶ ἀπέθηκαν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And Joshua put other twelve stones in the midst of the channel of the Jordan , where the priests stood that carried the ark of the covenant : and they are there until this present day.
text_la: Alios quoque duodecim lapides posuit Josue in medio Jordanis alveo, ubi steterunt sacerdotes qui portabant arcam fœderis : et sunt ibi usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: Levantou Josué também doze pedras no meio do Jordão, no lugar onde estiveram parados os pés dos sacerdotes, que levavam a arca da aliança; e ali estão até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: ἔστησεν δὲ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἄλλους δώδεκα λίθους ἐν αὐτῷ τῷ Ιορδάνῃ ἐν τῷ γενομένῳ τόπῳ ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας τῶν ἱερέων τῶν αἰρόντων τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου καί εἰσιν ἐκεῖ ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας

text_en: Now the priests that carried the ark , stood in the midst of the Jordan , till all things were accomplished, which the Lord had commanded Joshua to speak to the people, and Moses had said to him. And the people made haste, and passed over.
text_la: Sacerdotes autem qui portabant arcam, stabant in Jordanis medio, donec omnia complerentur, quæ Josue, ut loqueretur ad populum, præceperat Dominus, et dixerat ei Moyses. Festinavitque populus, et transiit.
text_pt: Pararam, pois, os sacerdotes, que levavam a arca, no meio do Jordão, em pé, até que se cumpriu tudo quanto o Senhor mandara Josué dizer ao povo, conforme a tudo quanto Moisés tinha ordenado a Josué; e apressou-se o povo, e passou.
text_el: εἱστήκεισαν δὲ οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ αἴροντες τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης ἐν τῷ Ιορδάνῃ ἕως οὗ συνετέλεσεν Ἰησοῦς πάντα ἃ ἐνετείλατο κύριος ἀναγγεῖλαι τῷ λαῷ καὶ ἔσπευσεν ὁ λαὸς καὶ διέβησαν

text_en: And when they had all passed over, the ark also of the Lord passed over, and the priests went before the people.
text_la: Cumque transissent omnes, transivit et arca Domini, sacerdotesque pergebant ante populum.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, assim que todo o povo acabou de passar, então passou a arca do Senhor, e os sacerdotes, à vista do povo.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς συνετέλεσεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς διαβῆναι καὶ διέβη ἡ κιβωτὸς τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου καὶ οἱ λίθοι ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν

text_en: The children of Ruben also, and Gad , and half the tribe of Manasses , went armed before the children of Israel , as Moses had commanded them.
text_la: Filii quoque Ruben, et Gad, et dimidia tribus Manasse, armati præcedebant filios Israël, sicut eis præceperat Moyses:
text_pt: E passaram os filhos de Rúben, e os filhos de Gade, e a meia tribo de Manassés, armados na frente dos filhos de Israel, como Moisés lhes tinha falado;
text_el: καὶ διέβησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ρουβην καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Γαδ καὶ οἱ ἡμίσεις φυλῆς Μανασση διεσκευασμένοι ἔμπροσθεν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καθάπερ ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς

text_en: And forty thousand fighting men by their troops and bands, marched through the plains and fields of the city of Jericho .
text_la: et quadraginta pugnatorum millia per turmas, et cuneos, incedebant per plana atque campestria urbis Jericho.
text_pt: Uns quarenta mil homens de guerra, armados, passaram diante do Senhor para batalha, às campinas de Jericó.
text_el: τετρακισμύριοι εὔζωνοι εἰς μάχην διέβησαν ἐναντίον κυρίου εἰς πόλεμον πρὸς τὴν Ιεριχω πόλιν

text_en: In that day the Lord magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel , that they should fear him, as they had feared Moses , while he lived.
text_la: In die illo magnificavit Dominus Josue coram omni Israël, ut timerent eum, sicut timuerant Moysen, dum adviveret.
text_pt: Naquele dia o Senhor engrandeceu a Josué diante dos olhos de todo o Israel; e temeram-no, como haviam temido a Moisés, todos os dias da sua vida.
text_el: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ηὔξησεν κύριος τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐναντίον παντὸς τοῦ γένους Ισραηλ καὶ ἐφοβοῦντο αὐτὸν ὥσπερ Μωυσῆν ὅσον χρόνον ἔζη

text_en: And he said to him:
text_la: Dixitque ad eum:
text_pt: Falou, pois, o Senhor a Josué, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος τῷ Ἰησοῖ λέγων

text_en: Command the priests , that carry the ark of the covenant , to come up out of the Jordan .
text_la: Præcipe sacerdotibus, qui portant arcam fœderis, ut ascendant de Jordane.
text_pt: Dá ordem aos sacerdotes, que levam a arca do testemunho, que subam do Jordão.
text_el: ἔντειλαι τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν τοῖς αἴρουσιν τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης τοῦ μαρτυρίου κυρίου ἐκβῆναι ἐκ τοῦ Ιορδάνου

text_en: And he commanded them, saying: Come up out of the Jordan .
text_la: Qui præcepit eis, dicens : Ascendite de Jordane.
text_pt: E deu Josué ordem aos sacerdotes, dizendo: Subi do Jordão.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο Ἰησοῦς τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν λέγων ἔκβητε ἐκ τοῦ Ιορδάνου

text_en: And when they that carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord , had come up, and began to tread on the dry ground, the waters returned into their channel, and ran as they were wont before.
text_la: Cumque ascendissent portantes arcam fœderis Domini, et siccam humum calcare cœpissent, reversæ sunt aquæ in alveum suum, et fluebant sicut ante consueverant.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, como os sacerdotes, que levavam a arca da aliança do Senhor, subiram do meio do Jordão, e as plantas dos pés dos sacerdotes se puseram em seco, as águas do Jordão se tornaram ao seu lugar, e corriam, como antes, sobre todas as suas ribanceiras.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἐξέβησαν οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ αἴροντες τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου ἐκ τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ ἔθηκαν τοὺς πόδας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὥρμησεν τὸ ὕδωρ τοῦ Ιορδάνου κατὰ χώραν καὶ ἐπορεύετο καθὰ ἐχθὲς καὶ τρίτην ἡμέραν δι' ὅλης τῆς κρηπῖδος

text_en: And the people came up out of the Jordan , the tenth day of the first month, and camped in Galgal, over against the east side of the city of Jericho .
text_la: Populus autem ascendit de Jordane decimo die mensis primi, et castrametati sunt in Galgalis contra orientalem plagam urbis Jericho.
text_pt: Subiu, pois, o povo, do Jordão no dia dez do mês primeiro; e alojaram-se em Gilgal, do lado oriental de Jericó.
text_el: καὶ ὁ λαὸς ἀνέβη ἐκ τοῦ Ιορδάνου δεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου καὶ κατεστρατοπέδευσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐν Γαλγαλοις κατὰ μέρος τὸ πρὸς ἡλίου ἀνατολὰς ἀπὸ τῆς Ιεριχω

text_en: And the twelve stones, which they had taken out of the channel of the Jordan , Joshua pitched in Galgal,
text_la: Duodecim quoque lapides, quos de Jordanis alveo sumpserant, posuit Josue in Galgalis,
text_pt: E as doze pedras, que tinham tomado do Jordão, levantou-as Josué em Gilgal.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς δώδεκα λίθους τούτους οὓς ἔλαβεν ἐκ τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἔστησεν Ἰησοῦς ἐν Γαλγαλοις

text_en: and said to the children of Israel : When your children shall ask their fathers tomorrow, and shall say to them: What mean these stones?
text_la: et dixit ad filios Israël : Quando interrogaverint filii vestri cras patres suos, et dixerint eis : Quid sibi volunt lapides isti?
text_pt: E falou aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Quando no futuro vossos filhos perguntarem a seus pais, dizendo: Que significam estas pedras?
text_el: λέγων ὅταν ἐρωτῶσιν ὑμᾶς οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν λέγοντες τί εἰσιν οἱ λίθοι οὗτοι

text_en: You shall teach them, and say: Israel passed over this Jordan through the dry channel,
text_la: docebitis eos, atque dicetis : Per arentem alveum transivit Israël Jordanem istum,
text_pt: Fareis saber a vossos filhos, dizendo: Israel passou em seco este Jordão.
text_el: ἀναγγείλατε τοῖς υἱοῖς ὑμῶν ὅτι ἐπὶ ξηρᾶς διέβη Ισραηλ τὸν Ιορδάνην

text_en: the Lord your God drying up the waters thereof in your sight, until you passed over: As he had done before in the Red Sea , which he dried up till we passed through:
text_la: siccante Domino Deo vestro aquas ejus in conspectu vestro, donec transiretis, sicut fecerat prius in mari Rubro, quod siccavit donec transiremus:
text_pt: Porque o Senhor vosso Deus fez secar as águas do Jordão diante de vós, até que passásseis, como o Senhor vosso Deus fez ao Mar Vermelho que fez secar perante nós, até que passássemos.
text_el: ἀποξηράναντος κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν τὸ ὕδωρ τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἐκ τοῦ ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν μέχρι οὗ διέβησαν καθάπερ ἐποίησεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν τὴν ἐρυθρὰν θάλασσαν ἣν ἀπεξήρανεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἔμπροσθεν ἡμῶν ἕως παρήλθομεν

text_en: That all the people of the earth may learn the most mighty hand of the Lord , that you also may fear the Lord your God for ever.
text_la: ut discant omnes terrarum populi fortissimam Domini manum, ut et vos timeatis Dominum Deum vestrum omni tempore.
text_pt: Para que todos os povos da terra conheçam a mão do Senhor, que é forte, para que temais ao Senhor vosso Deus todos os dias.
text_el: ὅπως γνῶσιν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τῆς γῆς ὅτι ἡ δύναμις τοῦ κυρίου ἰσχυρά ἐστιν καὶ ἵνα ὑμεῖς σέβησθε κύριον τὸν θεὸν ὑμῶν ἐν παντὶ χρόνῳ

text_en: Now when all the kings of the Amorrhites , who dwelt beyond the Jordan , westward, and all the kings of Chanaan , who possessed the places near the great sea, had heard that the Lord had dried up the waters of the Jordan before the children of Israel , till they passed over, their heart failed them, and there remained no spirit in them, fearing the coming in of the children of Israel .
text_la: Postquam ergo audierunt omnes reges Amorrhæorum, qui habitabant trans Jordanem ad occidentalem plagam, et cuncti reges Chanaan, qui propinqua possidebant magni maris loca, quod siccasset Dominus fluenta Jordanis coram filiis Israël donec transirent, dissolutum est cor eorum, et non remansit in eis spiritus, timentium introitum filiorum Israël.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo todos os reis dos amorreus, que habitavam deste lado do Jordão, ao ocidente, e todos os reis dos cananeus, que estavam ao pé do mar, que o SENHOR tinha secado as águas do Jordão, de diante dos filhos de Israel, até que passassem, desfaleceu-se-lhes o coração, e não houve mais ânimo neles, por causa dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤκουσαν οἱ βασιλεῖς τῶν Αμορραίων οἳ ἦσαν πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς Φοινίκης οἱ παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν ὅτι ἀπεξήρανεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τὸν Ιορδάνην ποταμὸν ἐκ τῶν ἔμπροσθεν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἐν τῷ διαβαίνειν αὐτούς καὶ ἐτάκησαν αὐτῶν αἱ διάνοιαι καὶ κατεπλάγησαν καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἐν αὐτοῖς φρόνησις οὐδεμία ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: At that time the Lord said to Joshua : Make knives of stone, and circumcise the second time the children of Israel .
text_la: Eo tempore ait Dominus ad Josue : Fac tibi cultros lapideos, et circumcide secundo filios Israël.
text_pt: Naquele tempo disse o Senhor a Josué: Faze facas de pedra, e torna a circuncidar segunda vez aos filhos de Israel.
text_el: ὑπὸ δὲ τοῦτον τὸν καιρὸν εἶπεν κύριος τῷ Ἰησοῖ ποίησον σεαυτῷ μαχαίρας πετρίνας ἐκ πέτρας ἀκροτόμου καὶ καθίσας περίτεμε τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ

text_en: He did what the Lord had commanded, and he circumcised the children of Israel in the hill of the foreskins.
text_la: Fecit quod jusserat Dominus, et circumcidit filios Israël in colle præputiorum.
text_pt: Então Josué fez para si facas de pedra, e circuncidou aos filhos de Israel no monte dos prepúcios.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Ἰησοῦς μαχαίρας πετρίνας ἀκροτόμους καὶ περιέτεμεν τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐπὶ τοῦ καλουμένου τόπου Βουνὸς τῶν ἀκροβυστιῶν

text_en: Now this is the cause of the second circumcision : All the people that came out of Egypt that were males, all the men fit for war , died in the desert , during the time of the long going about in the way:
text_la: Hæc autem causa est secundæ circumcisionis : omnis populus, qui egressus est de Ægypto generis masculini, universi bellatores viri, mortui sunt in deserto per longissimos viæ circuitus,
text_pt: E foi esta a causa por que Josué os circuncidou: todo o povo que tinha saído do Egito, os homens, todos os homens de guerra, já haviam morrido no deserto, pelo caminho, depois que saíram do Egito.
text_el: ὃν δὲ τρόπον περιεκάθαρεν Ἰησοῦς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ὅσοι ποτὲ ἐγένοντο ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ καὶ ὅσοι ποτὲ ἀπερίτμητοι ἦσαν τῶν ἐξεληλυθότων ἐξ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: Now these were all circumcised . But the people that were born in the desert ,
text_la: qui omnes circumcisi erant. Populus autem qui natus est in deserto,
text_pt: Porque todos os do povo que saíram estavam circuncidados, mas a nenhum dos que nasceram no deserto, pelo caminho, depois de terem saído do Egito, haviam circuncidado.
text_el: πάντας τούτους περιέτεμεν Ἰησοῦς

text_en: during the forty years of the journey in the wide wilderness , were uncircumcised: till all they were consumed that had not heard the voice of the Lord , and to whom he had sworn before, that he would not show them the land flowing with milk and honey.
text_la: per quadraginta annos itineris latissimæ solitudinis incircumcisus fuit : donec consumerentur qui non audierant vocem Domini, et quibus ante juraverat ut non ostenderet eis terram lacte et melle manantem.
text_pt: Porque quarenta anos andaram os filhos de Israel pelo deserto, até se acabar toda a nação, os homens de guerra, que saíram do Egito, e não obedeceram à voz do Senhor; aos quais o Senhor tinha jurado que lhes não havia de deixar ver a terra que o Senhor jurara a seus pais dar-nos; terra que mana leite e mel.
text_el: τεσσαράκοντα γὰρ καὶ δύο ἔτη ἀνέστραπται Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τῇ Μαδβαρίτιδι διὸ ἀπερίτμητοι ἦσαν οἱ πλεῖστοι αὐτῶν τῶν μαχίμων τῶν ἐξεληλυθότων ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου οἱ ἀπειθήσαντες τῶν ἐντολῶν τοῦ θεοῦ οἷς καὶ διώρισεν μὴ ἰδεῖν αὐτοὺς τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσεν κύριος τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν δοῦναι ἡμῖν γῆν ῥέουσαν γάλα καὶ μέλι

text_en: The children of these succeeded in the place of their fathers, and were circumcised by Joshua : for they were uncircumcised even as they were born, and no one had circumcised them in the way.
text_la: Horum filii in locum successerunt patrum, et circumcisi sunt a Josue : quia sicut nati fuerant, in præputio erant, nec eos in via aliquis circumciderat.
text_pt: Porém em seu lugar pôs a seus filhos; a estes Josué circuncidou, porquanto estavam incircuncisos, porque os não circuncidaram no caminho.
text_el: ἀντὶ δὲ τούτων ἀντικατέστησεν τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν οὓς Ἰησοῦς περιέτεμεν διὰ τὸ αὐτοὺς γεγενῆσθαι κατὰ τὴν ὁδὸν ἀπεριτμήτους

text_en: Now after they were all circumcised , they remained in the same place of the camp, until they were healed.
text_la: Postquam autem omnes circumcisi sunt, manserunt in eodem castrorum loco, donec sanarentur.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, acabando de circuncidar a toda a nação, ficaram no seu lugar no arraial, até que sararam.
text_el: περιτμηθέντες δὲ ἡσυχίαν εἶχον αὐτόθι καθήμενοι ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ ἕως ὑγιάσθησαν

text_en: And the Lord said to Joshua : This day have I taken away from you the reproach of Egypt . And the name of that place was called Galgal, until this present day.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Josue : Hodie abstuli opprobrium Ægypti a vobis. Vocatumque est nomen loci illius Galgala, usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Josué: Hoje retirei de sobre vós o opróbrio do Egito; por isso o nome daquele lugar se chamou Gilgal, até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος τῷ Ἰησοῖ υἱῷ Ναυη ἐν τῇ σήμερον ἡμέρᾳ ἀφεῖλον τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν Αἰγύπτου ἀφ' ὑμῶν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου Γαλγαλα

text_en: And the children of Israel abode in Galgal, and they kept the phase , on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, in the plains of Jericho :
text_la: Manseruntque filii Israël in Galgalis, et fecerunt Phase quartadecima die mensis ad vesperum in campestribus Jericho:
text_pt: Estando, pois, os filhos de Israel acampados em Gilgal, celebraram a páscoa no dia catorze do mês, à tarde, nas campinas de Jericó.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τὸ πασχα τῇ τεσσαρεσκαιδεκάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ μηνὸς ἀπὸ ἑσπέρας ἐπὶ δυσμῶν Ιεριχω ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ

text_en: And they ate on the next day unleavened bread of the corn of the land, and frumenty of the same year.
text_la: et comederunt de frugibus terræ die altero, azymos panes, et polentam ejusdem anni.
text_pt: E, ao outro dia depois da páscoa, nesse mesmo dia, comeram, do fruto da terra, pães ázimos e espigas tostadas.
text_el: καὶ ἐφάγοσαν ἀπὸ τοῦ σίτου τῆς γῆς ἄζυμα καὶ νέα ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ

text_en: And the manna ceased after they ate of the corn of the land, neither did the children of Israel use that food any more, but they ate of the corn of the present year of the land of Chanaan .
text_la: Defecitque manna postquam comederunt de frugibus terræ, nec usi sunt ultra cibo illo filii Israël, sed comederunt de frugibus præsentis anni terræ Chanaan.
text_pt: E cessou o maná no dia seguinte, depois que comeram do fruto da terra, e os filhos de Israel não tiveram mais maná; porém, no mesmo ano comeram dos frutos da terra de Canaã.
text_el: ἐξέλιπεν τὸ μαννα μετὰ τὸ βεβρωκέναι αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ σίτου τῆς γῆς καὶ οὐκέτι ὑπῆρχεν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ μαννα ἐκαρπίσαντο δὲ τὴν χώραν τῶν Φοινίκων ἐν τῷ ἐνιαυτῷ ἐκείνῳ

text_en: And when Joshua was in the field of the city of Jericho , he lifted up his eyes, and saw a man standing over against him, holding a drawn sword, and he went to him, and said: Are you one of ours, or of our adversaries?
text_la: Cum autem esset Josue in agro urbis Jericho, levavit oculos, et vidit virum stantem contra se, evaginatum tenentem gladium : perrexitque ad eum, et ait : Noster es, an adversariorum?
text_pt: E sucedeu que, estando Josué perto de Jericó, levantou os seus olhos e olhou; e eis que se pôs em pé diante dele um homem que tinha na mão uma espada nua; e chegou-se Josué a ele, e disse-lhe: És tu dos nossos, ou dos nossos inimigos?
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἦν Ἰησοῦς ἐν Ιεριχω καὶ ἀναβλέψας τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς εἶδεν ἄνθρωπον ἑστηκότα ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ ῥομφαία ἐσπασμένη ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ προσελθὼν Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἡμέτερος εἶ ἢ τῶν ὑπεναντίων

text_en: And he answered: No: but I am prince of the host of the Lord , and now I have come.
text_la: Qui respondit : Nequaquam : sed sum princeps exercitus Domini, et nunc venio.
text_pt: E disse ele: Não, mas venho agora como príncipe do exército do SENHOR. Então Josué se prostrou com o seu rosto em terra e o adorou, e disse-lhe: Que diz meu senhor ao seu servo?
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἐγὼ ἀρχιστράτηγος δυνάμεως κυρίου νυνὶ παραγέγονα

text_en: Joshua fell on his face to the ground. And worshipping , said: What says my lord to his servant?
text_la: Cecidit Josue pronus in terram, et adorans ait : Quid dominus meus loquitur ad servum suum?
text_pt: Então disse o príncipe do exército do Senhor a Josué: Descalça os sapatos de teus pés, porque o lugar em que estás é santo. E fez Josué assim.
text_el: καὶ Ἰησοῦς ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ δέσποτα τί προστάσσεις τῷ σῷ οἰκέτῃ

text_en: Loose, says he, your shoes from off your feet: for the place whereon you stand is holy . And Joshua did as was commanded him.
text_la: Solve, inquit, calceamentum tuum de pedibus tuis : locus enim, in quo stas, sanctus est. Fecitque Josue ut sibi fuerat imperatum.
text_el: καὶ λέγει ὁ ἀρχιστράτηγος κυρίου πρὸς Ἰησοῦν λῦσαι τὸ ὑπόδημα ἐκ τῶν ποδῶν σου ὁ γὰρ τόπος ἐφ' ᾧ σὺ ἕστηκας ἅγιός ἐστιν

text_en: Now Jericho was close shut up and fenced, for fear of the children of Israel , and no man dared go out or come in.
text_la: Jericho autem clausa erat atque munita, timore filiorum Israël, et nullus egredi audebat aut ingredi.
text_pt: Ora Jericó estava rigorosamente fechada por causa dos filhos de Israel; ninguém saía nem entrava.
text_el: καὶ Ιεριχω συγκεκλεισμένη καὶ ὠχυρωμένη καὶ οὐθεὶς ἐξεπορεύετο ἐξ αὐτῆς οὐδὲ εἰσεπορεύετο

text_en: And the Lord said to Joshua : Behold I have given into your hands Jericho , and the king thereof, and all the valiant men .
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Josue : Ecce dedi in manu tua Jericho, et regem ejus, omnesque fortes viros.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Josué: Olha, tenho dado na tua mão a Jericó, ao seu rei e aos seus homens valorosos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Ἰησοῦν ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ παραδίδωμι ὑποχείριόν σου τὴν Ιεριχω καὶ τὸν βασιλέα αὐτῆς τὸν ἐν αὐτῇ δυνατοὺς ὄντας ἐν ἰσχύι

text_en: Go round about the city all you fighting men once a day: so shall you do for six days.
text_la: Circuite urbem cuncti bellatores semel per diem : sic facietis sex diebus.
text_pt: Vós, pois, todos os homens de guerra, rodeareis a cidade, cercando-a uma vez; assim fareis por seis dias.
text_el: σὺ δὲ περίστησον αὐτῇ τοὺς μαχίμους κύκλῳ

text_en: And on the seventh day the priests shall take the seven trumpets, which are used in the jubilee , and shall go before the ark of the covenant : and you shall go about the city seven times, and the priests shall sound the trumpets.
text_la: Septimo autem die, sacerdotes tollant septem buccinas, quarum usus est in jubilæo, et præcedant arcam fœderis : septiesque circuibitis civitatem, et sacerdotes clangent buccinis.
text_pt: E sete sacerdotes levarão sete buzinas de chifres de carneiros adiante da arca, e no sétimo dia rodeareis a cidade sete vezes, e os sacerdotes tocarão as buzinas.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὡς ἂν σαλπίσητε τῇ σάλπιγγι ἀνακραγέτω πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἅμα καὶ ἀνακραγόντων αὐτῶν πεσεῖται αὐτόματα τὰ τείχη τῆς πόλεως καὶ εἰσελεύσεται πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁρμήσας ἕκαστος κατὰ πρόσωπον εἰς τὴν πόλιν

text_en: And when the voice of the trumpet shall give a longer and broken tune, and shall sound in your ears, all the people shall shout together with a very great shout, and the walls of the city shall fall to the ground, and they shall enter in every one at the place against which they shall stand.
text_la: Cumque insonuerit vox tubæ longior atque concisior, et in auribus vestris increpuerit, conclamabit omnis populus vociferatione maxima, et muri funditus corruent civitatis, ingredienturque singuli per locum contra quem steterint.
text_pt: E será que, tocando-se prolongadamente a buzina de carneiro, ouvindo vós o seu sonido, todo o povo gritará com grande brado; e o muro da cidade cairá abaixo, e o povo subirá por ele, cada um em frente.

text_en: Then Joshua, the son of Nun , called the priests , and said to them: Take the ark of the covenant : and let seven other priests take the seven trumpets of the jubilee , and march before the ark of the Lord .
text_la: Vocavit ergo Josue filius Nun sacerdotes, et dixit ad eos : Tollite arcam fœderis : et septem alii sacerdotes tollant septem jubilæorum buccinas, et incedant ante arcam Domini.
text_pt: Então Josué, filho de Num, chamou aos sacerdotes e disse-lhes: Levai a arca da aliança; e sete sacerdotes levem sete buzinas de chifres de carneiros, adiante da arca do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Ἰησοῦς ὁ τοῦ Ναυη πρὸς τοὺς ἱερεῖς

text_en: And he said to the people: Go, and compass the city, armed, marching before the ark of the Lord .
text_la: Ad populum quoque ait : Ite, et circuite civitatem, armati, præcedentes arcam Domini.
text_pt: E disse ao povo: Passai e rodeai a cidade; e quem estiver armado, passe adiante da arca do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς λέγων παραγγείλατε τῷ λαῷ περιελθεῖν καὶ κυκλῶσαι τὴν πόλιν καὶ οἱ μάχιμοι παραπορευέσθωσαν ἐνωπλισμένοι ἐναντίον κυρίου

text_en: And when Joshua had ended his words, and the seven priests blew the seven trumpets before the ark of the covenant of the Lord ,
text_la: Cumque Josue verba finisset, et septem sacerdotes septem buccinis clangerent ante arcam fœderis Domini,
text_pt: E assim foi que, como Josué dissera ao povo, os sete sacerdotes, levando as sete buzinas de carneiros diante do Senhor, passaram e tocaram as buzinas; e a arca da aliança do Senhor os seguia.
text_el: καὶ ἑπτὰ ἱερεῖς ἔχοντες ἑπτὰ σάλπιγγας ἱερὰς παρελθέτωσαν ὡσαύτως ἐναντίον τοῦ κυρίου καὶ σημαινέτωσαν εὐτόνως καὶ ἡ κιβωτὸς τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου ἐπακολουθείτω

text_en: and all the armed men went before, the rest of the common people followed the ark , and the sound of the trumpets was heard on all sides.
text_la: omnisque præcederet armatus exercitus, reliquum vulgus arcam sequebatur, ac buccinis omnia concrepabant.
text_pt: E os homens armados iam adiante dos sacerdotes, que tocavam as buzinas; e a retaguarda seguia após a arca; andando e tocando as buzinas iam os sacerdotes.
text_el: οἱ δὲ μάχιμοι ἔμπροσθεν παραπορευέσθωσαν καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ οὐραγοῦντες ὀπίσω τῆς κιβωτοῦ τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου πορευόμενοι καὶ σαλπίζοντες

text_en: But Joshua had commanded the people, saying: You shall not shout, nor shall your voice be heard, nor any word go out of your mouth: until the day come wherein I shall say to you: Cry, and shout.
text_la: Præceperat autem Josue populo, dicens : Non clamabitis, nec audietur vox vestra, neque ullus sermo ex ore vestro egredietur, donec veniat dies in quo dicam vobis : Clamate, et vociferamini.
text_pt: Porém ao povo Josué tinha dado ordem, dizendo: Não gritareis, nem fareis ouvir a vossa voz, nem sairá palavra alguma da vossa boca até ao dia que eu vos diga: Gritai. Então gritareis.
text_el: τῷ δὲ λαῷ ἐνετείλατο Ἰησοῦς λέγων μὴ βοᾶτε μηδὲ ἀκουσάτω μηθεὶς ὑμῶν τὴν φωνήν ἕως ἂν ἡμέραν αὐτὸς διαγγείλῃ ἀναβοῆσαι καὶ τότε ἀναβοήσετε

text_en: So the ark of the Lord went about the city once a day, and returning into the camp, abode there.
text_la: Circuivit ergo arca Domini civitatem semel per diem, et reversa in castra mansit ibi.
text_pt: E fez a arca do Senhor rodear a cidade, contornando-a uma vez; e entraram no arraial, e ali passaram a noite.
text_el: καὶ περιελθοῦσα ἡ κιβωτὸς τῆς διαθήκης τοῦ θεοῦ τὴν πόλιν εὐθέως ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὴν παρεμβολὴν καὶ ἐκοιμήθη ἐκεῖ

text_en: And Joshua rising before day, the priests took the ark of the Lord ,
text_la: Igitur Josue de nocte consurgente, tulerunt sacerdotes arcam Domini,
text_pt: Depois Josué se levantou de madrugada, e os sacerdotes levaram a arca do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ δευτέρᾳ ἀνέστη Ἰησοῦς τὸ πρωί καὶ ἦραν οἱ ἱερεῖς τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου

text_en: and seven of them seven trumpets, which are used in the jubilee : and they went before the ark of the Lord , walking and sounding the trumpets: and the armed men went before them, and the rest of the common people followed the ark , and they blew the trumpets.
text_la: et septem ex eis septem buccinas, quarum in jubilæo usus est : præcedebantque arcam Domini ambulantes atque clangentes : et armatus populus ibat ante eos, vulgus autem reliquum sequebatur arcam, et buccinis personabat.
text_pt: E os sete sacerdotes, que levavam as sete buzinas de chifres de carneiros, adiante da arca do Senhor, iam andando, e tocavam as buzinas, e os homens armados iam adiante deles e a retaguarda seguia atrás da arca do Senhor; os sacerdotes iam andando e tocando as buzinas.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἑπτὰ ἱερεῖς οἱ φέροντες τὰς σάλπιγγας τὰς ἑπτὰ προεπορεύοντο ἐναντίον κυρίου καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσεπορεύοντο οἱ μάχιμοι καὶ ὁ λοιπὸς ὄχλος ὄπισθε τῆς κιβωτοῦ τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς ἐσάλπισαν ταῖς σάλπιγξι καὶ ὁ λοιπὸς ὄχλος ἅπας περιεκύκλωσε τὴν πόλιν ἐγγύθεν

text_en: And they went round about the city the second day once, and returned into the camp. So they did six days.
text_la: Circuieruntque civitatem secundo die semel, et reversi sunt in castra. Sic fecerunt sex diebus.
text_pt: Assim rodearam outra vez a cidade no segundo dia e voltaram para o arraial; e assim fizeram seis dias.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν πάλιν εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν οὕτως ἐποίει ἐπὶ ἓξ ἡμέρας

text_en: But the seventh day, rising up early, they went about the city, as it was ordered, seven times.
text_la: Dies autem septimo, diluculo consurgentes, circuierunt urbem, sicut dispositum erat, septies.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ao sétimo dia, madrugaram ao subir da alva, e da mesma maneira rodearam a cidade sete vezes; naquele dia somente rodearam a cidade sete vezes.
text_el: καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ἀνέστησαν ὄρθρου καὶ περιήλθοσαν τὴν πόλιν ἑξάκις

text_en: And when in the seventh going about the priests sounded with the trumpets, Joshua said to all Israel : Shout: for the Lord has delivered the city to you:
text_la: Cumque septimo circuitu clangerent buccinis sacerdotes, dixit Josue ad omnem Israël : Vociferamini : tradidit enim vobis Dominus civitatem.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, tocando os sacerdotes pela sétima vez as buzinas, disse Josué ao povo: Gritai, porque o Senhor vos tem dado a cidade.
text_el: καὶ τῇ περιόδῳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ἐσάλπισαν οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ εἶπεν Ἰησοῦς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ κεκράξατε παρέδωκεν γὰρ κύριος ὑμῖν τὴν πόλιν

text_en: And let this city be an anathema , and all things that are in it, to the Lord . Let only Rahab, the harlot, live, with all that are with her in the house: for she hid the messengers whom we sent.
text_la: Sitque civitas hæc anathema, et omnia quæ in ea sunt, Domino : sola Rahab meretrix vivat, cum universis qui cum ea in domo sunt : abscondit enim nuntios quos direximus.
text_pt: Porém a cidade será anátema ao Senhor, ela e tudo quanto houver nela; somente a prostituta Raabe viverá; ela e todos os que com ela estiverem em casa; porquanto escondeu os mensageiros que enviamos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἡ πόλις ἀνάθεμα αὐτὴ καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἐστὶν ἐν αὐτῇ κυρίῳ σαβαωθ πλὴν Ρααβ τὴν πόρνην περιποιήσασθε αὐτὴν καὶ ὅσα ἐστὶν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτῆς

text_en: But beware lest you touch ought of those things that are forbidden , and you be guilty of transgression, and all the camp of Israel be under sin , and be troubled.
text_la: Vos autem cavete ne de his, quæ præcepta sunt, quippiam contingatis, et sitis prævaricationis rei, et omnia castra Israël sub peccato sint atque turbentur.
text_pt: Tão-somente guardai-vos do anátema, para que não toqueis nem tomeis alguma coisa dele, e assim façais maldito o arraial de Israel, e o perturbeis.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ὑμεῖς φυλάξασθε σφόδρα ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀναθέματος μήποτε ἐνθυμηθέντες ὑμεῖς αὐτοὶ λάβητε ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀναθέματος καὶ ποιήσητε τὴν παρεμβολὴν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἀνάθεμα καὶ ἐκτρίψητε ἡμᾶς

text_en: But whatsoever gold or silver there shall be, or vessels of brass and iron, let it be consecrated to the Lord , laid up in his treasures.
text_la: Quidquid autem auri et argenti fuerit, et vasorum æneorum ac ferri, Domino consecretur, repositum in thesauris ejus.
text_pt: Porém toda a prata, e o ouro, e os vasos de metal, e de ferro são consagrados ao Senhor; irão ao tesouro do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν ἀργύριον ἢ χρυσίον ἢ χαλκὸς ἢ σίδηρος ἅγιον ἔσται τῷ κυρίῳ εἰς θησαυρὸν κυρίου εἰσενεχθήσεται

text_en: So all the people making a shout, and the trumpets sounding, when the voice and the sound thundered in the ears of the multitude, the walls forthwith fell down: and every man went up by the place that was over against him: and they took the city,
text_la: Igitur omni populo vociferante, et clangentibus tubis, postquam in aures multitudinis vox sonitusque increpuit, muri illico corruerunt : et ascendit unusquisque per locum qui contra se erat : ceperuntque civitatem,
text_pt: Gritou, pois, o povo, tocando os sacerdotes as buzinas; e sucedeu que, ouvindo o povo o sonido da buzina, gritou o povo com grande brado; e o muro caiu abaixo, e o povo subiu à cidade, cada um em frente de si, e tomaram a cidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐσάλπισαν ταῖς σάλπιγξιν οἱ ἱερεῖς ὡς δὲ ἤκουσεν ὁ λαὸς τὴν φωνὴν τῶν σαλπίγγων ἠλάλαξεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἅμα ἀλαλαγμῷ μεγάλῳ καὶ ἰσχυρῷ καὶ ἔπεσεν ἅπαν τὸ τεῖχος κύκλῳ καὶ ἀνέβη πᾶς ὁ λαὸς εἰς τὴν πόλιν

text_en: and killed all that were in it, man and woman , young and old. The oxen also, and the sheep, and the asses, they slew with the edge of the sword.
text_la: et interfecerunt omnia quæ erant in ea, a viro usque ad mulierem, ab infante usque ad senem. Boves quoque et oves et asinos in ore gladii percusserunt.
text_pt: E tudo quanto havia na cidade destruíram totalmente ao fio da espada, desde o homem até à mulher, desde o menino até ao velho, e até ao boi e gado miúdo, e ao jumento.
text_el: καὶ ἀνεθεμάτισεν αὐτὴν Ἰησοῦς καὶ ὅσα ἦν ἐν τῇ πόλει ἀπὸ ἀνδρὸς καὶ ἕως γυναικός ἀπὸ νεανίσκου καὶ ἕως πρεσβύτου καὶ ἕως μόσχου καὶ ὑποζυγίου ἐν στόματι ῥομφαίας

text_en: But Joshua said to the two men that had been sent for spies: Go into the harlot's house, and bring her out, and all things that are hers, as you assured her by oath .
text_la: Duobus autem viris, qui exploratores missi fuerant, dixit Josue : Ingredimini domum mulieris meretricis, et producite eam, et omnia quæ illius sunt, sicut illi juramento firmastis.
text_pt: Josué, porém, disse aos dois homens que tinham espiado a terra: Entrai na casa da mulher prostituta, e tirai-a de lá com tudo quanto tiver, como lhe tendes jurado.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς δυσὶν νεανίσκοις τοῖς κατασκοπεύσασιν εἶπεν Ἰησοῦς εἰσέλθατε εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν τῆς γυναικὸς καὶ ἐξαγάγετε αὐτὴν ἐκεῖθεν καὶ ὅσα ἐστὶν αὐτῇ

text_en: And the young men went in, and brought out Rahab, and her parents , her brethren also, and all her goods , and her kindred , and made them to stay without the camp.
text_la: Ingressique juvenes eduxerunt Rahab, et parentes ejus, fratres quoque, et cunctam supellectilem ac cognationem illius, et extra castra Israël manere fecerunt.
text_pt: Então entraram os jovens espias, e tiraram a Raabe e a seu pai, e a sua mãe, e a seus irmãos, e a tudo quanto tinha; tiraram também a toda a sua parentela, e os puseram fora do arraial de Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθον οἱ δύο νεανίσκοι οἱ κατασκοπεύσαντες τὴν πόλιν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν τῆς γυναικὸς καὶ ἐξηγάγοσαν Ρααβ τὴν πόρνην καὶ τὸν πατέρα αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτῆς καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτῆς καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἦν αὐτῇ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν συγγένειαν αὐτῆς καὶ κατέστησαν αὐτὴν ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς Ισραηλ

text_en: But they burned the city, and all things that were therein; except the gold and silver, and vessels of brass and iron, which they consecrated unto the treasury of the Lord .
text_la: Urbem autem, et omnia quæ erant in ea, succenderunt, absque auro et argento, et vasis æneis, ac ferro, quæ in ærarium Domini consecrarunt.
text_pt: Porém a cidade e tudo quanto havia nela queimaram a fogo; tão-somente a prata, e o ouro, e os vasos de metal e de ferro, deram para o tesouro da casa do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἡ πόλις ἐνεπρήσθη ἐμπυρισμῷ σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν αὐτῇ πλὴν ἀργυρίου καὶ χρυσίου καὶ χαλκοῦ καὶ σιδήρου ἔδωκαν εἰς θησαυρὸν κυρίου εἰσενεχθῆναι

text_en: But Joshua saved Rahab the harlot, and her father's house , and all she had, and they dwelt in the midst of Israel until this present day: because she hid the messengers whom he had sent to spy out Jericho . At that time, Joshua made an imprecation , saying:
text_la: Rahab vero meretricem, et domum patris ejus, et omnia quæ habebat, fecit Josue vivere, et habitaverunt in medio Israël, usque in præsentem diem : eo quod absconderit nuntios, quos miserat ut explorarent Jericho. In tempore illo, imprecatus est Josue, dicens:
text_pt: Assim deu Josué vida à prostituta Raabe e à família de seu pai, e a tudo quanto tinha; e habitou no meio de Israel até ao dia de hoje; porquanto escondera os mensageiros que Josué tinha enviado a espiar a Jericó.
text_el: καὶ Ρααβ τὴν πόρνην καὶ πάντα τὸν οἶκον τὸν πατρικὸν αὐτῆς ἐζώγρησεν Ἰησοῦς καὶ κατῴκησεν ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας διότι ἔκρυψεν τοὺς κατασκοπεύσαντας οὓς ἀπέστειλεν Ἰησοῦς κατασκοπεῦσαι τὴν Ιεριχω

text_en: Cursed be the man before the Lord , that shall raise up and build the city of Jericho . In his firstborn may he lay the foundation thereof, and in the last of his children set up its gates.
text_la: Maledictus vir coram Domino, qui suscitaverit et ædificaverit civitatem Jericho. In primogenito suo fundamenta illius jaciat, et in novissimo liberorum ponat portas ejus.
text_pt: E naquele tempo Josué os esconjurou, dizendo: Maldito diante do Senhor seja o homem que se levantar e reedificar esta cidade de Jericó; sobre seu primogênito a fundará, e sobre o seu filho mais novo lhe porá as portas.
text_el: καὶ ὥρκισεν Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐναντίον κυρίου λέγων ἐπικατάρατος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὃς οἰκοδομήσει τὴν πόλιν ἐκείνην ἐν τῷ πρωτοτόκῳ αὐτοῦ θεμελιώσει αὐτὴν καὶ ἐν τῷ ἐλαχίστῳ αὐτοῦ ἐπιστήσει τὰς πύλας αὐτῆς καὶ οὕτως ἐποίησεν Οζαν ὁ ἐκ Βαιθηλ ἐν τῷ Αβιρων τῷ πρωτοτόκῳ ἐθεμελίωσεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐν τῷ ἐλαχίστῳ διασωθέντι ἐπέστησεν τὰς πύλας αὐτῆς

text_en: And the Lord was with Joshua , and his name was noised throughout all the land.
text_la: Fuit ergo Dominus cum Josue, et nomen ejus vulgatum est in omni terra.
text_pt: Assim era o Senhor com Josué; e corria a sua fama por toda a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἦν κύριος μετὰ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἦν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ κατὰ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν

text_en: But the children of Israel transgressed the commandment, and took to their own use of that which was accursed . For Achan, the son of Charmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zare, of the tribe of Juda , took something of the anathema : and the Lord was angry against the children of Israel .
text_la: Filii autem Israël prævaricati sunt mandatum, et usurpaverunt de anathemate. Nam Achan filius Charmi filii Zabdi filii Zare de tribu Juda tulit aliquid de anathemate : iratusque est Dominus contra filios Israël.
text_pt: E transgrediram os filhos de Israel no anátema; porque Acã filho de Carmi, filho de Zabdi, filho de Zerá, da tribo de Judá, tomou do anátema, e a ira do SENHOR se acendeu contra os filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐπλημμέλησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ πλημμέλειαν μεγάλην καὶ ἐνοσφίσαντο ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀναθέματος καὶ ἔλαβεν Αχαρ υἱὸς Χαρμι υἱοῦ Ζαμβρι υἱοῦ Ζαρα ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ιουδα ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀναθέματος καὶ ἐθυμώθη ὀργῇ κύριος τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ

text_en: And when Joshua sent men from Jericho against Hai, which is beside Bethaven, on the east side of the town of Bethel , he said to them: Go up, and view the country: and they fulfilled his command, and viewed Hai.
