text_la: Cumque mitteret Josue de Jericho viros contra Hai, quæ est juxta Bethaven, ad orientalem plagam oppidi Bethel, dixit eis : Ascendite, et explorate terram. Qui præcepta complentes exploraverunt Hai.
text_pt: Enviando, pois, Josué, de Jericó, alguns homens a Ai, que está junto a Bete-Áven do lado do oriente de Betel, falou-lhes dizendo: Subi, e espiai a terra. Subiram, pois, aqueles homens, e espiaram a Ai.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ἰησοῦς ἄνδρας εἰς Γαι ἥ ἐστιν κατὰ Βαιθηλ λέγων κατασκέψασθε τὴν Γαι καὶ ἀνέβησαν οἱ ἄνδρες καὶ κατεσκέψαντο τὴν Γαι

text_en: And returning, they said to him: Let not all the people go up, but let two or three thousand men go, and destroy the city: why should all the people be troubled in vain, against enemies that are very few?
text_la: Et reversi dixerunt ei : Non ascendat omnis populus, sed duo vel tria millia virorum pergant, et deleant civitatem : quare omnis populus frustra vexabitur contra hostes paucissimos?
text_pt: E voltaram a Josué, e disseram-lhe: Não suba todo o povo; subam uns dois mil, ou três mil homens, a ferir a Ai; não fatigueis ali a todo o povo, porque poucos são.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστρεψαν πρὸς Ἰησοῦν καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτόν μὴ ἀναβήτω πᾶς ὁ λαός ἀλλ' ὡς δισχίλιοι ἢ τρισχίλιοι ἄνδρες ἀναβήτωσαν καὶ ἐκπολιορκησάτωσαν τὴν πόλιν μὴ ἀναγάγῃς ἐκεῖ τὸν λαὸν πάντα ὀλίγοι γάρ εἰσιν

text_en: There went up therefore three thousand fighting men : who immediately turned their backs,
text_la: Ascenderunt ergo tria millia pugnatorum. Qui statim terga vertentes,
text_pt: Assim, subiram lá, do povo, uns três mil homens, os quais fugiram diante dos homens de Ai.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβησαν ὡσεὶ τρισχίλιοι ἄνδρες καὶ ἔφυγον ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν ἀνδρῶν Γαι

text_en: and were defeated by the men of the city of Hai, and there fell of them six and thirty men : and the enemies pursued them from the gate as far as Sabarim, and they slew them as they fled by the descent: and the heart of the people was struck with fear, and melted like water.
text_la: percussi sunt a viris urbis Hai, et corruerunt ex eis triginta sex homines : persecutique sunt eos adversarii de porta usque ad Sabarim, et ceciderunt per prona fugientes : pertimuitque cor populi, et instar aquæ liquefactum est.
text_pt: E os homens de Ai feriram deles uns trinta e seis, e os perseguiram desde a porta até Sebarim, e os feriram na descida; e o coração do povo se derreteu e se tornou como água.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέκτειναν ἀπ' αὐτῶν ἄνδρες Γαι εἰς τριάκοντα καὶ ἓξ ἄνδρας καὶ κατεδίωξαν αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς πύλης καὶ συνέτριψαν αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τοῦ καταφεροῦς καὶ ἐπτοήθη ἡ καρδία τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ ἐγένετο ὥσπερ ὕδωρ

text_en: But Joshua rent his garments, and fell flat on the ground, before the ark of the Lord , until the evening, both he and all the ancients of Israel : and they put dust upon their heads.
text_la: Josue vero scidit vestimenta sua, et pronus cecidit in terram coram arca Domini usque ad vesperam, tam ipse quam omnes senes Israël : miseruntque pulverem super capita sua,
text_pt: Então Josué rasgou as suas vestes, e se prostrou em terra sobre o seu rosto perante a arca do Senhor até à tarde, ele e os anciãos de Israel; e deitaram pó sobre as suas cabeças.
text_el: καὶ διέρρηξεν Ἰησοῦς τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔπεσεν Ἰησοῦς ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον ἐναντίον κυρίου ἕως ἑσπέρας αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι Ισραηλ καὶ ἐπεβάλοντο χοῦν ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: And Joshua said: Alas, O Lord God , why would you bring this people over the river Jordan , to deliver us into the hand of the Amorrhite , and to destroy us? Would God we had stayed beyond the Jordan , as we began.
text_la: et dixit Josue : Heu Domine Deus, quid voluisti traducere populum istum Jordanem fluvium, ut traderes nos in manus Amorrhæi, et perderes? utinam ut cœpimus, mansissemus trans Jordanem.
text_pt: E disse Josué: Ah! Senhor Deus! Por que, com efeito, fizeste passar a este povo o Jordão, para nos entregares nas mãos dos amorreus para nos fazerem perecer? Antes nos tivéssemos contentado em ficar além do Jordão!
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰησοῦς δέομαι κύριε ἵνα τί διεβίβασεν ὁ παῖς σου τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον τὸν Ιορδάνην παραδοῦναι αὐτὸν τῷ Αμορραίῳ ἀπολέσαι ἡμᾶς καὶ εἰ κατεμείναμεν καὶ κατῳκίσθημεν παρὰ τὸν Ιορδάνην

text_en: My Lord God , what shall I say, seeing Israel turning their backs to their enemies?
text_la: Mi Domine Deus, quid dicam, videns Israëlem hostibus suis terga vertentem?
text_pt: Ah, Senhor! Que direi? Pois Israel virou as costas diante dos inimigos!
text_el: καὶ τί ἐρῶ ἐπεὶ μετέβαλεν Ισραηλ αὐχένα ἀπέναντι τοῦ ἐχθροῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: The Chanaanites , and all the inhabitants of the land, will hear of it, and being gathered together will surround us, and cut off our name from the earth: and what will you do to your great name ?
text_la: Audient Chananæi, et omnes habitatores terræ, et pariter conglobati circumdabunt nos, atque delebunt nomen nostrum de terra : et quid facies magno nomini tuo?
text_pt: Ouvindo isto, os cananeus, e todos os moradores da terra, nos cercarão e desarraigarão o nosso nome da terra; e então que farás ao teu grande nome?
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσας ὁ Χαναναῖος καὶ πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν γῆν περικυκλώσουσιν ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐκτρίψουσιν ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς καὶ τί ποιήσεις τὸ ὄνομά σου τὸ μέγα

text_en: And the Lord said to Joshua : Arise, why do you lie flat on the ground?
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Josue : Surge : cur jaces pronus in terra?
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor a Josué: Levanta-te; por que estás prostrado assim sobre o teu rosto?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Ἰησοῦν ἀνάστηθι ἵνα τί τοῦτο σὺ πέπτωκας ἐπὶ πρόσωπόν σου

text_en: Israel has sinned , and transgressed my covenant: and they have taken of the anathema , and have stolen and lied , and have hid it among their goods .
text_la: Peccavit Israël, et prævaricatus est pactum meum : tuleruntque de anathemate, et furati sunt atque mentiti, et absconderunt inter vasa sua.
text_pt: Israel pecou, e transgrediram a minha aliança que lhes tinha ordenado, e tomaram do anátema, e furtaram, e mentiram, e debaixo da sua bagagem o puseram.
text_el: ἡμάρτηκεν ὁ λαὸς καὶ παρέβη τὴν διαθήκην ἣν διεθέμην πρὸς αὐτούς καὶ κλέψαντες ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀναθέματος ἐνέβαλον εἰς τὰ σκεύη αὐτῶν

text_en: Neither can Israel stand before his enemies, but he shall flee from them: because he is defiled with the anathema . I will be no more with you, till you destroy him that is guilty of this wickedness .
text_la: Nec poterit Israël stare ante hostes suos, eosque fugiet : quia pollutus est anathemate. Non ero ultra vobiscum, donec conteratis eum qui hujus sceleris reus est.
text_pt: Por isso os filhos de Israel não puderam subsistir perante os seus inimigos; viraram as costas diante dos seus inimigos; porquanto estão amaldiçoados; não serei mais convosco, se não desarraigardes o anátema do meio de vós.
text_el: οὐ μὴ δύνωνται οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ὑποστῆναι κατὰ πρόσωπον τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν αὐχένα ἐπιστρέψουσιν ἔναντι τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν ὅτι ἐγενήθησαν ἀνάθεμα οὐ προσθήσω ἔτι εἶναι μεθ' ὑμῶν ἐὰν μὴ ἐξάρητε τὸ ἀνάθεμα ἐξ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: Arise, sanctify the people, and say to them: Be sanctified against tomorrow: for thus says the Lord God of Israel : The curse is in the midst of you, O Israel : you can not stand before your enemies, till he be destroyed out of you, that is defiled with this wickedness .
text_la: Surge, sanctifica populum, et dic eis : Sanctificamini in crastinum : hæc enim dicit Dominus Deus Israël : Anathema in medio tui est, Israël : non poteris stare coram hostibus tuis, donec deleatur ex te qui hoc contaminatus est scelere.
text_pt: Levanta-te, santifica o povo, e dize: Santificai-vos para amanhã, porque assim diz o Senhor Deus de Israel: Anátema há no meio de ti, Israel; diante dos teus inimigos não poderás suster-te, até que tireis o anátema do meio de vós.
text_el: ἀναστὰς ἁγίασον τὸν λαὸν καὶ εἰπὸν ἁγιασθῆναι εἰς αὔριον τάδε λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ τὸ ἀνάθεμα ἐν ὑμῖν ἐστιν οὐ δυνήσεσθε ἀντιστῆναι ἀπέναντι τῶν ἐχθρῶν ὑμῶν ἕως ἂν ἐξάρητε τὸ ἀνάθεμα ἐξ ὑμῶν

text_en: And you shall come in the morning, every one by your tribes : and what tribe soever the lot shall find, it shall come by its kindreds, and the kindred by its houses and the house by the men .
text_la: Accedetisque mane singuli per tribus vestras : et quamcumque tribum sors invenerit, accedet per cognationes suas, et cognatio per domos, domusque per viros.
text_pt: Amanhã, pois, vos chegareis, segundo as vossas tribos; e será que a tribo que o Senhor tomar se chegará, segundo as famílias; e a família que o Senhor tomar se chegará por casas; e a casa que o Senhor tomar se chegará homem por homem.
text_el: καὶ συναχθήσεσθε πάντες τὸ πρωὶ κατὰ φυλάς καὶ ἔσται ἡ φυλή ἣν ἂν δείξῃ κύριος προσάξετε κατὰ δήμους καὶ τὸν δῆμον ὃν ἐὰν δείξῃ κύριος προσάξετε κατ' οἶκον καὶ τὸν οἶκον ὃν ἐὰν δείξῃ κύριος προσάξετε κατ' ἄνδρα

text_en: And whosoever he be that shall be found guilty of this fact, he shall be burnt with fire, with all his substance , because he has transgressed the covenant of the Lord , and has done wickedness in Israel .
text_la: Et quicumque ille in hoc facinore fuerit deprehensus, comburetur igni cum omni substantia sua : quoniam prævaricatus est pactum Domini, et fecit nefas in Israël.
text_pt: E será que aquele que for tomado com o anátema será queimado a fogo, ele e tudo quanto tiver; porquanto transgrediu a aliança do Senhor, e fez uma loucura em Israel.
text_el: καὶ ὃς ἂν ἐνδειχθῇ κατακαυθήσεται ἐν πυρὶ καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἐστὶν αὐτῷ ὅτι παρέβη τὴν διαθήκην κυρίου καὶ ἐποίησεν ἀνόμημα ἐν Ισραηλ

text_en: Joshua , therefore, when he rose in the morning, made Israel to come by their tribes , and the tribe of Juda was found.
text_la: Surgens itaque Josue mane, applicuit Israël per tribus suas, et inventa est tribus Juda.
text_pt: Então Josué se levantou de madrugada, e fez chegar a Israel, segundo as suas tribos; e a tribo de Judá foi tomada;
text_el: καὶ ὤρθρισεν Ἰησοῦς καὶ προσήγαγεν τὸν λαὸν κατὰ φυλάς καὶ ἐνεδείχθη ἡ φυλὴ Ιουδα

text_en: Which being brought by in families , it was found to be the family of Zare. Bringing that also by the houses, he found it to be Zabdi:
text_la: Quæ cum juxta familias suas esset oblata, inventa est familia Zare. Illam quoque per domos offerens, reperit Zabdi:
text_pt: E, fazendo chegar a tribo de Judá, tomou a família dos zeraítas; e fazendo chegar a família dos zeraítas homem por homem, foi tomado Zabdi;
text_el: καὶ προσήχθη κατὰ δήμους καὶ ἐνεδείχθη δῆμος ὁ Ζαραϊ καὶ προσήχθη κατὰ ἄνδρα

text_en: And bringing his house man by man , he found Achan, the son of Charmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zare, of the tribe of Juda .
text_la: cujus domum in singulos dividens viros, invenit Achan filium Charmi filii Zabdi filii Zare de tribu Juda.
text_pt: E, fazendo chegar a sua casa, homem por homem, foi tomado Acã, filho de Carmi, filho de Zabdi, filho de Zerá, da tribo de Judá.
text_el: καὶ ἐνεδείχθη Αχαρ υἱὸς Ζαμβρι υἱοῦ Ζαρα

text_en: And Joshua said to Achan: My son, give glory to the Lord God of Israel , and confess, and tell me what you have done, hide it not.
text_la: Et ait Josue ad Achan : Fili mi, da gloriam Domino Deo Israël, et confitere, atque indica mihi quid feceris, ne abscondas.
text_pt: Então disse Josué a Acã: Filho meu, dá, peço-te, glória ao Senhor Deus de Israel, e faze confissão perante ele; e declara-me agora o que fizeste, não mo ocultes.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰησοῦς τῷ Αχαρ δὸς δόξαν σήμερον τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ Ισραηλ καὶ δὸς τὴν ἐξομολόγησιν καὶ ἀνάγγειλόν μοι τί ἐποίησας καὶ μὴ κρύψῃς ἀπ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: And Achan answered Joshua , and said to him: Indeed I have sinned against the Lord , the God of Israel , and thus and thus have I done.
text_la: Responditque Achan Josue, et dixit ei : Vere ego peccavi Domino Deo Israël, et sic et sic feci.
text_pt: E respondeu Acã a Josué, e disse: Verdadeiramente pequei contra o Senhor Deus de Israel, e fiz assim e assim.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Αχαρ τῷ Ἰησοῖ καὶ εἶπεν ἀληθῶς ἥμαρτον ἐναντίον κυρίου θεοῦ Ισραηλ οὕτως καὶ οὕτως ἐποίησα

text_en: For I saw among the spoils a scarlet garment, exceeding good , and two hundred sicles of silver, and a golden rule of fifty sicles: and I coveted them, and I took them away , and hid them in the ground in the midst of my tent, and the silver I covered with the earth that I dug up.
text_la: Vidi enim inter spolia pallium coccineum valde bonum, et ducentos siclos argenti, regulamque auream quinquaginta siclorum : et concupiscens abstuli, et abscondi in terra contra medium tabernaculi mei, argentumque fossa humo operui.
text_pt: Quando vi entre os despojos uma boa capa babilônica, e duzentos siclos de prata, e uma cunha de ouro, do peso de cinqüenta siclos, cobicei-os e tomei-os; e eis que estão escondidos na terra, no meio da minha tenda, e a prata por baixo dela.
text_el: εἶδον ἐν τῇ προνομῇ ψιλὴν ποικίλην καλὴν καὶ διακόσια δίδραχμα ἀργυρίου καὶ γλῶσσαν μίαν χρυσῆν πεντήκοντα διδράχμων καὶ ἐνθυμηθεὶς αὐτῶν ἔλαβον καὶ ἰδοὺ αὐτὰ ἐγκέκρυπται ἐν τῇ γῇ ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ μου καὶ τὸ ἀργύριον κέκρυπται ὑποκάτω αὐτῶν

text_en: Joshua therefore sent ministers: who running to his tent, found all hid in the same place, together with the silver.
text_la: Misit ergo Josue ministros : qui currentes ad tabernaculum illius, repererunt cuncta abscondita in eodem loco, et argentum simul.
text_pt: Então Josué enviou mensageiros, que foram correndo à tenda; e eis que tudo estava escondido na sua tenda, e a prata por baixo.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ἰησοῦς ἀγγέλους καὶ ἔδραμον εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν εἰς τὴν παρεμβολήν καὶ ταῦτα ἦν ἐγκεκρυμμένα εἰς τὴν σκηνήν καὶ τὸ ἀργύριον ὑποκάτω αὐτῶν

text_en: And taking them away out of the tent, they brought them to Joshua , and to all the children of Israel , and threw them down before the Lord .
text_la: Auferentesque de tentorio, tulerunt ea ad Josue, et ad omnes filios Israël, projeceruntque ante Dominum.
text_pt: Tomaram, pois, aquelas coisas do meio da tenda, e as trouxeram a Josué e a todos os filhos de Israel; e as puseram perante o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήνεγκαν αὐτὰ ἐκ τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ ἤνεγκαν πρὸς Ἰησοῦν καὶ τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους Ισραηλ καὶ ἔθηκαν αὐτὰ ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: Then Joshua , and all Israel with him, took Achan, the son of Zare, and the silver, and the garment, and the golden rule, his sons also, and his daughters, his oxen, and asses, and sheep, the tent also, and all the goods : and brought them to the valley of Achor :
text_la: Tollens itaque Josue Achan filium Zare, argentumque et pallium, et auream regulam, filios quoque et filias ejus, boves et asinos et oves, ipsumque tabernaculum, et cunctam supellectilem (et omnis Israël cum eo), duxerunt eos ad vallem Achor:
text_pt: Então Josué, e todo o Israel com ele, tomaram a Acã filho de Zerá, e a prata, e a capa, e a cunha de ouro, e seus filhos, e suas filhas, e seus bois, e seus jumentos, e suas ovelhas, e sua tenda, e tudo quanto ele tinha; e levaram-nos ao vale de Acor.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ἰησοῦς τὸν Αχαρ υἱὸν Ζαρα καὶ ἀνήγαγεν αὐτὸν εἰς φάραγγα Αχωρ καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς μόσχους αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ ὑποζύγια αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντα τὰ πρόβατα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν σκηνὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντα τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνήγαγεν αὐτοὺς εἰς Εμεκαχωρ

text_en: Where Joshua said: Because you have troubled us, the Lord trouble you this day. And all Israel stoned him: and all things that were his, were consumed with fire.
text_la: ubi dixit Josue : Quia turbasti nos, exturbet te Dominus in die hac. Lapidavitque eum omnis Israël : et cuncta quæ illius erant, igne consumpta sunt.
text_pt: E disse Josué: Por que nos perturbaste? O Senhor te perturbará neste dia. E todo o Israel o apedrejou; e os queimaram a fogo depois de apedrejá-los.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰησοῦς τῷ Αχαρ τί ὠλέθρευσας ἡμᾶς ἐξολεθρεύσαι σε κύριος καθὰ καὶ σήμερον καὶ ἐλιθοβόλησαν αὐτὸν λίθοις πᾶς Ισραηλ

text_en: And they gathered together upon him a great heap of stones, which remains until this present day And the wrath of the Lord was turned away from them. And the name of that place was called the Valley of Achor , until this day.
text_la: Congregaveruntque super eum acervum magnum lapidum, qui permanet usque in præsentem diem. Et aversus est furor Domini ab eis. Vocatumque est nomen loci illius, vallis Achor, usque hodie.
text_pt: E levantaram sobre ele um grande montão de pedras, até o dia de hoje; assim o Senhor se apartou do ardor da sua ira; pelo que aquele lugar se chama o vale de Acor, até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστησαν αὐτῷ σωρὸν λίθων μέγαν καὶ ἐπαύσατο κύριος τοῦ θυμοῦ τῆς ὀργῆς διὰ τοῦτο ἐπωνόμασεν αὐτὸ Εμεκαχωρ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: And the Lord said to Joshua : Fear not, nor be dismayed: take with you all the multitude of fighting men , arise, and go up to the town of Hai: Behold I have delivered into your hand the king thereof, and the people, and the city, and the land.
text_la: Dixit autem Dominus ad Josue : Ne timeas, neque formides : tolle tecum omnem multitudinem pugnatorum, et consurgens ascende in oppidum Hai. Ecce tradidi in manu tua regem ejus et populum, urbemque et terram.
text_pt: Então disse o SENHOR a Josué: Não temas, e não te espantes; toma contigo toda a gente de guerra, e levanta-te, sobe a Ai; olha que te tenho dado na tua mão o rei de Ai e o seu povo, e a sua cidade, e a sua terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Ἰησοῦν μὴ φοβηθῇς μηδὲ δειλιάσῃς λαβὲ μετὰ σοῦ τοὺς ἄνδρας πάντας τοὺς πολεμιστὰς καὶ ἀναστὰς ἀνάβηθι εἰς Γαι ἰδοὺ δέδωκα εἰς τὰς χεῖράς σου τὸν βασιλέα Γαι καὶ τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And you shall do to the city of Hai, and to the king thereof, as you have done to Jericho , and to the king thereof: but the spoils, and all the cattle, you shall take for a prey to yourselves: lay an ambush for the city behind it.
text_la: Faciesque urbi Hai, et regi ejus, sicut fecisti Jericho, et regi illius : prædam vero, et omnia animantia diripietis vobis : pone insidias urbi post eam.
text_pt: Farás, pois, a Ai e a seu rei, como fizeste a Jericó, e a seu rei; salvo que, para vós, tomareis os seus despojos, e o seu gado; põe emboscadas à cidade, por detrás dela.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις τὴν Γαι ὃν τρόπον ἐποίησας τὴν Ιεριχω καὶ τὸν βασιλέα αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν προνομὴν τῶν κτηνῶν προνομεύσεις σεαυτῷ κατάστησον δὲ σεαυτῷ ἔνεδρα τῇ πόλει εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω

text_en: And Joshua arose, and all the army of the fighting men with him, to go up against Hai: and he sent thirty thousand chosen valiant men in the night,
text_la: Surrexitque Josue, et omnis exercitus bellatorum cum eo, ut ascenderent in Hai : et electa triginta millia virorum fortium misit nocte,
text_pt: Então Josué levantou-se, e toda a gente de guerra, para subir contra Ai; e escolheu Josué trinta mil homens valorosos, e enviou-os de noite.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Ἰησοῦς καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁ πολεμιστὴς ὥστε ἀναβῆναι εἰς Γαι ἐπέλεξεν δὲ Ἰησοῦς τριάκοντα χιλιάδας ἀνδρῶν δυνατοὺς ἐν ἰσχύι καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς νυκτός

text_en: and commanded them, saying: Lay an ambush behind the city: and go not very far from it: and be all ready.
text_la: præcepitque eis, dicens : Ponite insidias post civitatem, nec longius recedatis : et eritis omnes parati.
text_pt: E deu-lhes ordem, dizendo: Olhai! Ponde-vos de emboscadas contra a cidade, por detrás dela; não vos alongueis muito da cidade; e estai todos vós atentos.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς λέγων ὑμεῖς ἐνεδρεύσατε ὀπίσω τῆς πόλεως μὴ μακρὰν γίνεσθε ἀπὸ τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἔσεσθε πάντες ἕτοιμοι

text_en: But I, and the rest of the multitude which is with me, will approach on the contrary side against the city. And when they shall come out against us, we will flee, and turn our backs, as we did before:
text_la: Ego autem, et reliqua multitudo, quæ mecum est, accedemus ex adverso contra urbem. Cumque exierint contra nos, sicut ante fecimus, fugiemus, et terga vertemus,
text_pt: Porém eu e todo o povo que está comigo nos aproximaremos da cidade; e será que, quando nos saírem ao encontro, como antes, fugiremos diante deles.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ καὶ πάντες οἱ μετ' ἐμοῦ προσάξομεν πρὸς τὴν πόλιν καὶ ἔσται ὡς ἂν ἐξέλθωσιν οἱ κατοικοῦντες Γαι εἰς συνάντησιν ἡμῖν καθάπερ καὶ πρῴην καὶ φευξόμεθα ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν

text_en: Till they pursuing us be drawn farther from the city: for they will think that we flee as before.
text_la: donec persequentes ab urbe longius protrahantur : putabunt enim nos fugere sicut prius.
text_pt: Deixai-os, pois, sair atrás de nós, até que os tiremos da cidade; porque dirão: Fogem diante de nós como antes. Assim fugiremos diante deles.
text_el: καὶ ὡς ἂν ἐξέλθωσιν ὀπίσω ἡμῶν ἀποσπάσομεν αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἐροῦσιν φεύγουσιν οὗτοι ἀπὸ προσώπου ἡμῶν ὃν τρόπον καὶ ἔμπροσθεν

text_en: And whilst we are fleeing, and they pursuing, you shall rise out of the ambush, and shall destroy the city: and the Lord your God will deliver it into your hands.
text_la: Nobis ergo fugientibus, et illis persequentibus, consurgetis de insidiis, et vastabitis civitatem : tradetque eam Dominus Deus vester in manus vestras.
text_pt: Então saireis vós da emboscada, e tomareis a cidade; porque o Senhor vosso Deus vo-la dará nas vossas mãos.
text_el: ὑμεῖς δὲ ἐξαναστήσεσθε ἐκ τῆς ἐνέδρας καὶ πορεύσεσθε εἰς τὴν πόλιν

text_en: And when you shall have taken it, set it on fire, and you shall do all things so as I have commanded.
text_la: Cumque ceperitis, succendite eam, et sic omnia facietis, ut jussi.
text_pt: E será que tomando vós a cidade, pôr-lhe-eis fogo; conforme a palavra do Senhor fareis; olhai que vo-lo tenho mandado.
text_el: κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο ποιήσετε ἰδοὺ ἐντέταλμαι ὑμῖν

text_en: And he sent them away, and they went on to the place of the ambush, and abode between Bethel and Hai, on the west side of the city of Hai. But Joshua staid that night in the midst of the people,
text_la: Dimisitque eos, et perrexerunt ad locum insidiarum, sederuntque inter Bethel et Hai, ad occidentalem plagam urbis Hai : Josue autem nocte illa in medio mansit populi,
text_pt: Assim Josué os enviou, e eles se foram à emboscada; e ficaram entre Betel e Ai, ao ocidente de Ai; porém Josué passou aquela noite no meio do povo.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν εἰς τὴν ἐνέδραν καὶ ἐνεκάθισαν ἀνὰ μέσον Βαιθηλ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον Γαι ἀπὸ θαλάσσης τῆς Γαι

text_en: and rising early in the morning, he mustered his soldiers, and went up with the ancients in the front of the army, environed with the aid of the fighting men .
text_la: surgensque diluculo recensuit socios, et ascendit cum senioribus in fronte exercitus, vallatus auxilio pugnatorum.
text_pt: E levantou-se Josué de madrugada, e contou o povo; e subiram ele e os anciãos de Israel adiante do povo contra Ai.
text_el: καὶ ὀρθρίσας Ἰησοῦς τὸ πρωὶ ἐπεσκέψατο τὸν λαόν καὶ ἀνέβησαν αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ λαοῦ ἐπὶ Γαι

text_en: And when they had come, and had gone up over against the city, they stood on the north side of the city, between which and them there was a valley in the midst.
text_la: Cumque venissent et ascendissent ex adverso civitatis, steterunt ad septentrionalem urbis plagam, inter quam et eos erat vallis media.
text_pt: E subiram também todos os homens de guerra, que estavam com ele; e aproximaram-se, e chegaram defronte da cidade; e alojaram-se do lado norte de Ai, e havia um vale entre eles e Ai.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁ πολεμιστὴς μετ' αὐτοῦ ἀνέβησαν καὶ πορευόμενοι ἦλθον ἐξ ἐναντίας τῆς πόλεως ἀπ' ἀνατολῶν

text_en: And he had chosen five thousand men , and set them to lie in ambush between Bethel and Hai, on the west side of the same city:
text_la: Quinque autem millia viros elegerat, et posuerat in insidiis inter Bethel et Hai ex occidentali parte ejusdem civitatis:
text_pt: Tomou também uns cinco mil homens, e pô-los de emboscada entre Betel e Ai, ao ocidente da cidade.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ἔνεδρα τῆς πόλεως ἀπὸ θαλάσσης

text_en: But all the rest of the army went in battle array on the north side, so that the last of that multitude reached to the west side of the city. So Joshua went that night, and stood in the midst of the valley.
text_la: omnis vero reliquus exercitus ad aquilonem aciem dirigebat, ita ut novissimi illius multitudinis occidentalem plagam urbis attingerent. Abiit ergo Josue nocte illa, et stetit in vallis medio.
text_pt: E puseram o povo, todo o arraial que estava ao norte da cidade, e a emboscada ao ocidente da cidade; e foi Josué aquela noite até ao meio do vale.

text_en: And when the king of Hai saw this, he made haste in the morning, and went out with all the army of the city, and set it in battle array, toward the desert , not knowing that there lay an ambush behind his back.
text_la: Quod cum vidisset rex Hai, festinavit mane, et egressus est cum omni exercitu civitatis, direxitque aciem contra desertum, ignorans quod post tergum laterent insidiæ.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, vendo-o o rei de Ai, ele e todo o seu povo se apressaram, e se levantaram de madrugada, e os homens da cidade saíram ao encontro de Israel ao combate, ao tempo determinado, defronte das campinas; porém ele não sabia que se achava uma emboscada contra ele atrás da cidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς εἶδεν βασιλεὺς Γαι ἔσπευσεν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτοῖς ἐπ' εὐθείας εἰς τὸν πόλεμον αὐτὸς καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁ μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς οὐκ ᾔδει ὅτι ἔνεδρα αὐτῷ ἐστιν ὀπίσω τῆς πόλεως

text_en: But Joshua , and all Israel gave back, making as if they were afraid, and fleeing by the way of the wilderness .
text_la: Josue vero et omnis Israël cesserunt loco, simulantes metum, et fugientes per solitudinis viam.
text_pt: Josué, pois, e todo o Israel se houveram como feridos diante deles, e fugiram pelo caminho do deserto.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν καὶ ἀνεχώρησεν Ἰησοῦς καὶ Ισραηλ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν

text_en: But they shouting together, and encouraging one another, pursued them. And when they had come from the city,
text_la: At illi vociferantes pariter, et se mutuo cohortantes, persecuti sunt eos. Cumque recessissent a civitate,
text_pt: Por isso todo o povo, que estava na cidade, foi convocado para os seguir; e seguiram a Josué e foram afastados da cidade.
text_el: καὶ κατεδίωξαν ὀπίσω τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ αὐτοὶ ἀπέστησαν ἀπὸ τῆς πόλεως

text_en: and not one remained in the city of Hai and of Bethel , that did not pursue after Israel , leaving the towns open as they had rushed out,
text_la: et ne unus quidem in urbe Hai et Bethel remansisset qui non persequeretur Israël (sicut eruperant aperta oppida relinquentes),
text_pt: E nem um só homem ficou em Ai, nem em Betel, que não saísse após Israel; e deixaram a cidade aberta, e seguiram a Israel.
text_el: οὐ κατελείφθη οὐθεὶς ἐν τῇ Γαι ὃς οὐ κατεδίωξεν ὀπίσω Ισραηλ καὶ κατέλιπον τὴν πόλιν ἀνεῳγμένην καὶ κατεδίωξαν ὀπίσω Ισραηλ

text_en: the Lord said to Joshua : Lift up the shield that is in your hand, towards the city of Hai, for I will deliver it to you.
text_la: dixit Dominus ad Josue : Leva clypeum, qui in manu tua est, contra urbem Hai, quoniam tibi tradam eam.
text_pt: Então o Senhor disse a Josué: Estende a lança que tens na tua mão, para Ai, porque a darei na tua mão. E Josué estendeu a lança, que estava na sua mão, para a cidade.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Ἰησοῦν ἔκτεινον τὴν χεῖρά σου ἐν τῷ γαίσῳ τῷ ἐν τῇ χειρί σου ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν εἰς γὰρ τὰς χεῖράς σου παραδέδωκα αὐτήν καὶ τὰ ἔνεδρα ἐξαναστήσονται ἐν τάχει ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτῶν καὶ ἐξέτεινεν Ἰησοῦς τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ τὸν γαῖσον ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν

text_en: And when he had lifted up his shield towards the city, the ambush, that lay hid, rose up immediately: and going to the city, took it, and set it on fire.
text_la: Cumque elevasset clypeum ex adverso civitatis, insidiæ, quæ latebant, surrexerunt confestim : et pergentes ad civitatem, ceperunt, et succenderunt eam.
text_pt: Então a emboscada se levantou apressadamente do seu lugar, e, estendendo ele a sua mão, correram e entraram na cidade, e a tomaram; e apressando-se, puseram fogo na cidade.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ἔνεδρα ἐξανέστησαν ἐν τάχει ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτῶν καὶ ἐξήλθοσαν ὅτε ἐξέτεινεν τὴν χεῖρα καὶ ἤλθοσαν ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν καὶ κατελάβοντο αὐτὴν καὶ σπεύσαντες ἐνέπρησαν τὴν πόλιν ἐν πυρί

text_en: And the men of the city, that pursued after Joshua , looking back, and seeing the smoke of the city rise up to heaven , had no more power to flee this way or that way: especially as they that had counterfeited flight, and were going toward the wilderness , turned back most valiantly against them that pursued.
text_la: Viri autem civitatis, qui persequebantur Josue, respicientes et videntes fumum urbis ad cælum usque conscendere, non potuerunt ultra huc illucque diffugere : præsertim cum hi qui simulaverant fugam, et tendebant ad solitudinem, contra persequentes fortissime restitissent.
text_pt: E virando-se os homens de Ai para trás, olharam, e eis que a fumaça da cidade subia ao céu, e não puderam fugir nem para uma parte nem para outra, porque o povo, que fugia para o deserto, se tornou contra os que os seguiam.
text_el: καὶ περιβλέψαντες οἱ κάτοικοι Γαι εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω αὐτῶν καὶ ἐθεώρουν καπνὸν ἀναβαίνοντα ἐκ τῆς πόλεως εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν καὶ οὐκέτι εἶχον ποῦ φύγωσιν ὧδε ἢ ὧδε

text_en: So Joshua , and all Israel , seeing that the city was taken, and that the smoke of the city rose up, returned, and slew the men of Hai.
text_la: Vidensque Josue et omnis Israël quod capta esset civitas, et fumus urbis ascenderet, reversus percussit viros Hai.
text_pt: E vendo Josué e todo o Israel que a emboscada tomara a cidade, e que a fumaça da cidade subia, voltaram, e feriram os homens de Ai.
text_el: καὶ Ἰησοῦς καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ εἶδον ὅτι ἔλαβον τὰ ἔνεδρα τὴν πόλιν καὶ ὅτι ἀνέβη ὁ καπνὸς τῆς πόλεως εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν καὶ μεταβαλόμενοι ἐπάταξαν τοὺς ἄνδρας τῆς Γαι

text_en: And they also that had taken and set the city on fire, issuing out of the city to meet their own men , began to cut off the enemies who were surrounded by them. So that the enemies being cut off on both sides, not one of so great a multitude was saved.
text_la: Siquidem et illi qui ceperant et succenderant civitatem, egressi ex urbe contra suos, medios hostium ferire cœperunt. Cum ergo ex utraque parte adversarii cæderentur, ita ut nullus de tanta multitudine salvaretur,
text_pt: Também aqueles da cidade lhes saíram ao encontro, e assim ficaram no meio dos israelitas, uns de uma, e outros de outra parte; e feriram-nos, até que nenhum deles sobreviveu nem escapou.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι ἐξήλθοσαν ἐκ τῆς πόλεως εἰς συνάντησιν καὶ ἐγενήθησαν ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς παρεμβολῆς οὗτοι ἐντεῦθεν καὶ οὗτοι ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ἐπάταξαν ἕως τοῦ μὴ καταλειφθῆναι αὐτῶν σεσωσμένον καὶ διαπεφευγότα

text_en: And they took the king of the city of Hai alive and brought him to Joshua .
text_la: regem quoque urbis Hai apprehenderunt viventem, et obtulerunt Josue.
text_pt: Porém ao rei de Ai tomaram vivo, e o trouxeram a Josué.
text_el: καὶ τὸν βασιλέα τῆς Γαι συνέλαβον ζῶντα καὶ προσήγαγον αὐτὸν πρὸς Ἰησοῦν

text_en: So all being slain that had pursued after Israel , in his flight to the wilderness , and falling by the sword in the same place, the children of Israel returned and laid waste the city.
text_la: Igitur omnibus interfectis, qui Israëlem ad deserta tendentem fuerant persecuti, et in eodem loco gladio corruentibus, reversi filii Israël percusserunt civitatem.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, acabando os israelitas de matar todos os moradores de Ai no campo, no deserto, onde os tinham seguido, e havendo todos caído ao fio da espada, até serem consumidos, todo o Israel se tornou a Ai e a feriu ao fio de espada.
text_el: καὶ ὡς ἐπαύσαντο οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἀποκτέννοντες πάντας τοὺς ἐν τῇ Γαι τοὺς ἐν τοῖς πεδίοις καὶ ἐν τῷ ὄρει ἐπὶ τῆς καταβάσεως οὗ κατεδίωξαν αὐτοὺς ἀπ' αὐτῆς εἰς τέλος καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν Ἰησοῦς εἰς Γαι καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὴν ἐν στόματι ῥομφαίας

text_en: And the number of them that fell that day, both of men and women , was twelve thousand persons, all of the city of Hai.
text_la: Erant autem qui in eodem die conciderant a viro usque ad mulierem, duodecim millia hominum, omnes urbis Hai.
text_pt: E todos os que caíram aquele dia, assim homens como mulheres, foram doze mil, todos moradores de Ai.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθησαν οἱ πεσόντες ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἀπὸ ἀνδρὸς καὶ ἕως γυναικὸς δώδεκα χιλιάδες πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Γαι

text_en: But Joshua drew not back his hand, which he had stretched out on high, holding the shield, till all the inhabitants of Hai were slain.
text_la: Josue vero non contraxit manum, quam in sublime porrexerat, tenens clypeum donec interficerentur omnes habitatores Hai.
text_pt: Porque Josué não retirou a sua mão, que estendera com a lança, até destruir totalmente a todos os moradores de Ai.

text_en: And the children of Israel divided among them, the cattle and the prey of the city, as the Lord had commanded Joshua .
text_la: Jumenta autem et prædam civitatis diviserunt sibi filii Israël, sicut præceperat Dominus Josue.
text_pt: Tão-somente os israelitas tomaram para si o gado e os despojos da cidade, conforme à palavra do Senhor, que tinha ordenado a Josué.
text_el: πλὴν τῶν κτηνῶν καὶ τῶν σκύλων τῶν ἐν τῇ πόλει πάντα ἃ ἐπρονόμευσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ κατὰ πρόσταγμα κυρίου ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Ἰησοῖ

text_en: And he burnt the city, and made it a heap forever:
text_la: Qui succendit urbem, et fecit eam tumulum sempiternum:
text_pt: Queimou, pois, Josué a Ai e a tornou num montão perpétuo, em ruínas, até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ ἐνεπύρισεν Ἰησοῦς τὴν πόλιν ἐν πυρί χῶμα ἀοίκητον εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἔθηκεν αὐτὴν ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: And he hung the king thereof on a gibbet, until the evening and the going down of the sun. Then Joshua commanded, and they took down his carcass from the gibbet: and threw it in the very entrance of the city, heaping upon it a great heap of stones, which remains until this present day.
text_la: regem quoque ejus suspendit in patibulo usque ad vesperam et solis occasum. Præcepitque Josue, et deposuerunt cadaver ejus de cruce : projeceruntque in ipso introitu civitatis, congesto super eum magno acervo lapidum, qui permanet usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: E ao rei de Ai enforcou num madeiro, até à tarde; e ao pôr do sol ordenou Josué que o seu corpo fosse tirado do madeiro; e o lançaram à porta da cidade, e levantaram sobre ele um grande montão de pedras, até o dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ τὸν βασιλέα τῆς Γαι ἐκρέμασεν ἐπὶ ξύλου διδύμου καὶ ἦν ἐπὶ τοῦ ξύλου ἕως ἑσπέρας καὶ ἐπιδύνοντος τοῦ ἡλίου συνέταξεν Ἰησοῦς καὶ καθείλοσαν αὐτοῦ τὸ σῶμα ἀπὸ τοῦ ξύλου καὶ ἔρριψαν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν βόθρον καὶ ἐπέστησαν αὐτῷ σωρὸν λίθων ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: Then Joshua built an altar to the Lord , the God of Israel , in Mount Hebal,
text_la: Tunc ædificavit Josue altare Domino Deo Israël in monte Hebal,
text_pt: Então Josué edificou um altar ao Senhor Deus de Israel, no monte Ebal.
text_el: τότε ᾠκοδόμησεν Ἰησοῦς θυσιαστήριον κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ Ισραηλ ἐν ὄρει Γαιβαλ

text_en: as Moses , the servant of the Lord , had commanded the children of Israel , and it is written in the book of the law of Moses : an altar of unhewn stones, which iron had not touched: and he offered upon it holocausts to the Lord , and immolated victims of peace offerings .
text_la: sicut præceperat Moyses famulus Domini filiis Israël, et scriptum est in volumine legis Moysi : altare vero de lapidibus impolitis, quos ferrum non tetigit : et obtulit super eo holocausta Domino, immolavitque pacificas victimas.
text_pt: Como Moisés, servo do Senhor, ordenara aos filhos de Israel, conforme ao que está escrito no livro da lei de Moisés, a saber: um altar de pedras inteiras, sobre o qual não se moverá instrumento de ferro; e ofereceram sobre ele holocaustos ao Senhor, e sacrificaram ofertas pacíficas.
text_el: καθότι ἐνετείλατο Μωυσῆς ὁ θεράπων κυρίου τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καθὰ γέγραπται ἐν τῷ νόμῳ Μωυσῆ θυσιαστήριον λίθων ὁλοκλήρων ἐφ' οὓς οὐκ ἐπεβλήθη σίδηρος καὶ ἀνεβίβασεν ἐκεῖ ὁλοκαυτώματα κυρίῳ καὶ θυσίαν σωτηρίου

text_en: And he wrote upon stones, the Deuteronomy of the law of Moses , which he had ordered before the children of Israel .
text_la: Et scripsit super lapides Deuteronomium legis Moysi, quod ille digesserat coram filiis Israël.
text_pt: Também escreveu ali, em pedras, uma cópia da lei de Moisés, que este havia escrito diante dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἔγραψεν Ἰησοῦς ἐπὶ τῶν λίθων τὸ δευτερονόμιον νόμον Μωυσῆ ὃν ἔγραψεν ἐνώπιον υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And all the people, and the ancients, and the princes, and judges, stood on both sides of the ark , before the priests that carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord , both the stranger and he that was born among them, half of them by Mount Garizim, and half by Mount Hebal, as Moses the servant of the Lord , had commanded. And first he blessed the people of Israel .
text_la: Omnis autem populus, et majores natu, ducesque ac judices, stabant ex utraque parte arcæ, in conspectu sacerdotum qui portabant arcam fœderis Domini, ut advena, ita et indigena. Media pars eorum juxta montem Garizim, et media juxta montem Hebal, sicut præceperat Moyses famulus Domini. Et primum quidem benedixit populo Israël.
text_pt: E todo o Israel, com os seus anciãos, e os seus príncipes, e os seus juízes, estavam de um e de outro lado da arca, perante os sacerdotes levitas, que levavam a arca da aliança do Senhor, assim estrangeiros como naturais; metade deles em frente do monte Gerizim, e a outra metade em frente do monte Ebal, como Moisés, servo do Senhor, ordenara, para abençoar primeiramente o povo de Israel.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ δικασταὶ καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς αὐτῶν παρεπορεύοντο ἔνθεν καὶ ἔνθεν τῆς κιβωτοῦ ἀπέναντι καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευῖται ἦραν τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου καὶ ὁ προσήλυτος καὶ ὁ αὐτόχθων οἳ ἦσαν ἥμισυ πλησίον ὄρους Γαριζιν καὶ οἳ ἦσαν ἥμισυ πλησίον ὄρους Γαιβαλ καθότι ἐνετείλατο Μωυσῆς ὁ θεράπων κυρίου εὐλογῆσαι τὸν λαὸν ἐν πρώτοις

text_en: After this, he read all the words of the blessing and the cursing , and all things that were written in the book of the law .
text_la: Post hæc legit omnia verba benedictionis et maledictionis, et cuncta quæ scripta erant in legis volumine.
text_pt: E depois leu em alta voz todas as palavras da lei, a bênção e a maldição, conforme a tudo o que está escrito no livro da lei.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα οὕτως ἀνέγνω Ἰησοῦς πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ νόμου τούτου τὰς εὐλογίας καὶ τὰς κατάρας κατὰ πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα ἐν τῷ νόμῳ Μωυσῆ

text_en: He left out nothing of those things which Moses had commanded, but he repeated all before all the people of Israel , with the women and children, and strangers, that dwelt among them.
text_la: Nihil ex his quæ Moyses jusserat, reliquit intactum, sed universa replicavit coram omni multitudine Israël, mulieribus ac parvulis, et advenis qui inter eos morabantur.
text_pt: Palavra nenhuma houve, de tudo o que Moisés ordenara, que Josué não lesse perante toda a congregação de Israel, e as mulheres, e os meninos, e os estrangeiros, que andavam no meio deles.
text_el: οὐκ ἦν ῥῆμα ἀπὸ πάντων ὧν ἐνετείλατο Μωυσῆς τῷ Ἰησοῖ ὃ οὐκ ἀνέγνω Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὰ ὦτα πάσης ἐκκλησίας υἱῶν Ισραηλ τοῖς ἀνδράσιν καὶ ταῖς γυναιξὶν καὶ τοῖς παιδίοις καὶ τοῖς προσηλύτοις τοῖς προσπορευομένοις τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: Now when these things were heard of, all the kings beyond the Jordan , that dwelt in the mountains, and in the plains, in the places near the sea, and on the coasts of the great sea, they also that dwell by Libanus, the Hethite , and the Amorrhite , the Chanaanite , the Pherezite, and the Hevite, and the Jebusite,
text_la: Quibus auditis, cuncti reges trans Jordanem, qui versabantur in montanis et campestribus, in maritimis ac littore magni maris, hi quoque qui habitabant juxta Libanum, Hethæus et Amorrhæus, Chananæus, Pherezæus, et Hevæus, et Jebusæus,
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo isto todos os reis, que estavam aquém do Jordão, nas montanhas, e nas campinas, em toda a costa do grande mar, em frente do Líbano, os heteus, e os amorreus, os cananeus, os perizeus, os heveus, e os jebuseus,
text_el: ὡς δ' ἤκουσαν οἱ βασιλεῖς τῶν Αμορραίων οἱ ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου οἱ ἐν τῇ ὀρεινῇ καὶ οἱ ἐν τῇ πεδινῇ καὶ οἱ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ παραλίᾳ τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς μεγάλης καὶ οἱ πρὸς τῷ Ἀντιλιβάνῳ καὶ οἱ Χετταῖοι καὶ οἱ Χαναναῖοι καὶ οἱ Φερεζαῖοι καὶ οἱ Ευαῖοι καὶ οἱ Αμορραῖοι καὶ οἱ Γεργεσαῖοι καὶ οἱ Ιεβουσαῖοι

text_en: gathered themselves together, to fight against Joshua and Israel with one mind, and one resolution.
text_la: congregati sunt pariter, ut pugnarent contra Josue et Israël uno animo, eademque sententia.
text_pt: Se ajuntaram eles de comum acordo, para pelejar contra Josué e contra Israel.
text_el: συνήλθοσαν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ἐκπολεμῆσαι Ἰησοῦν καὶ Ισραηλ ἅμα πάντες

text_en: But they that dwelt in Gabaon, hearing all that Joshua had done to Jericho and Hai:
text_la: At hi qui habitabant in Gabaon, audientes cuncta quæ fecerat Josue Jericho, et Hai,
text_pt: E os moradores de Gibeom, ouvindo o que Josué fizera com Jericó e com Ai,
text_el: καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες Γαβαων ἤκουσαν πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν κύριος τῇ Ιεριχω καὶ τῇ Γαι

text_en: Cunningly devising took for themselves provisions, laying old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles rent and sewed up again,
text_la: et callide cogitantes, tulerunt sibi cibaria, saccos veteres asinis imponentes, et utres vinarios scissos atque consutos,
text_pt: Usaram de astúcia, e foram e se fingiram embaixadores, e levando sacos velhos sobre os seus jumentos, e odres de vinho, velhos, e rotos, e remendados;
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν καί γε αὐτοὶ μετὰ πανουργίας καὶ ἐλθόντες ἐπεσιτίσαντο καὶ ἡτοιμάσαντο καὶ λαβόντες σάκκους παλαιοὺς ἐπὶ τῶν ὄνων αὐτῶν καὶ ἀσκοὺς οἴνου παλαιοὺς καὶ κατερρωγότας ἀποδεδεμένους

text_en: and very old shoes, which for a show of age were clouted with patches, and old garments upon them: the loaves also, which they carried for provisions by the way, were hard, and broken into pieces:
text_la: calceamentaque perantiqua quæ ad indicium vetustatis pittaciis consuta erant, induti veteribus vestimentis : panes quoque, quos portabant ob viaticum, duri erant, et in frustra comminuti:
text_pt: E nos seus pés sapatos velhos e remendados, e roupas velhas sobre si; e todo o pão que traziam para o caminho era seco e bolorento.
text_el: καὶ τὰ κοῖλα τῶν ὑποδημάτων αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ σανδάλια αὐτῶν παλαιὰ καὶ καταπεπελματωμένα ἐν τοῖς ποσὶν αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν πεπαλαιωμένα ἐπάνω αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ ἄρτος αὐτῶν τοῦ ἐπισιτισμοῦ ξηρὸς καὶ εὐρωτιῶν καὶ βεβρωμένος

text_en: And they went to Joshua , who then abode in the camp at Galgal, and said to him, and to all Israel with him: We have come from a far country, desiring to make peace with you. And the children of Israel answered them, and said:
text_la: perrexeruntque ad Josue, qui tunc morabatur in castris Galgalæ, et dixerunt ei, atque simul omni Israëli : De terra longinqua venimus, pacem vobiscum facere cupientes. Responderuntque viri Israël ad eos, atque dixerunt:
text_pt: E vieram a Josué, ao arraial, a Gilgal, e disseram a ele e aos homens de Israel: Viemos de uma terra distante; fazei, pois, agora, acordo conosco.
text_el: καὶ ἤλθοσαν πρὸς Ἰησοῦν εἰς τὴν παρεμβολὴν Ισραηλ εἰς Γαλγαλα καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς Ἰησοῦν καὶ Ισραηλ ἐκ γῆς μακρόθεν ἥκαμεν καὶ νῦν διάθεσθε ἡμῖν διαθήκην

text_en: Perhaps you dwell in the land which falls to our lot; if so, we can make no league with you.
text_la: Ne forte in terra, quæ nobis sorte debetur, habitetis, et non possimus fœdus inire vobiscum.
text_pt: E os homens de Israel responderam aos heveus: Porventura habiteis no meio de nós; como pois faremos acordo convosco?
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ πρὸς τὸν Χορραῖον ὅρα μὴ ἐν ἐμοὶ κατοικεῖς καὶ πῶς σοι διαθῶμαι διαθήκην

text_en: But they said to Joshua : We are your servants. Joshua said to them: Who are you? And whence came you?
text_la: At illi ad Josue : Servi, inquiunt, tui sumus. Quibus Josue ait : Quinam estis vos? et unde venistis?
text_pt: Então disseram a Josué: Nós somos teus servos. E disse-lhes Josué: Quem sois vós, e de onde vindes?
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς Ἰησοῦν οἰκέται σού ἐσμεν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς πόθεν ἐστὲ καὶ πόθεν παραγεγόνατε

text_en: They answered: From a very far country your servants have come in the name of the Lord your God . For we have heard the fame of his power, all the things that he did in Egypt .
text_la: Responderunt : De terra longinqua valde venerunt servi tui in nomine Domini Dei tui. Audivimus enim famam potentiæ ejus, cuncta quæ fecit in Ægypto,
text_pt: E lhe responderam: Teus servos vieram de uma terra mui distante, por causa do nome do Senhor teu Deus, porquanto ouvimos a sua fama, e tudo quanto fez no Egito;
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν ἐκ γῆς μακρόθεν σφόδρα ἥκασιν οἱ παῖδές σου ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου ἀκηκόαμεν γὰρ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ καὶ ὅσα ἐποίησεν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ

text_en: And to the two kings of the Amorrhites , that were beyond the Jordan , Sehon, king of Hesebon , and Og, king of Basan, that was in Astaroth:
text_la: et duobus regibus Amorrhæorum qui fuerunt trans Jordanem, Sehon regi Hesebon, et Og regi Basan, qui erat in Astaroth:
text_pt: E tudo quanto fez aos dois reis dos amorreus, que estavam além do Jordão, a Siom rei de Hesbom, e a Ogue, rei de Basã, que estava em Astarote.
text_el: καὶ ὅσα ἐποίησεν τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν τῶν Αμορραίων οἳ ἦσαν πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου τῷ Σηων βασιλεῖ Εσεβων καὶ τῷ Ωγ βασιλεῖ τῆς Βασαν ὃς κατῴκει ἐν Ασταρωθ καὶ ἐν Εδραϊν

text_en: And our ancients, and all the inhabitants of our country, said to us: Take with you victuals for a long way, and go meet them, and say: We are your servants, make a league with us.
text_la: dixeruntque nobis seniores, et omnes habitatores terræ nostræ : Tollite in manibus cibaria ob longissimam viam, et occurrite eis, et dicite : Servi vestri sumus : fœdus inite nobiscum.
text_pt: Por isso nossos anciãos e todos os moradores da nossa terra nos falaram, dizendo: Tomai em vossas mãos provisão para o caminho, e ide-lhes ao encontro e dizei-lhes: Nós somos vossos servos; fazei, pois, agora acordo conosco.
text_el: καὶ ἀκούσαντες εἶπαν πρὸς ἡμᾶς οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ἡμῶν καὶ πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν γῆν ἡμῶν λέγοντες λάβετε ἑαυτοῖς ἐπισιτισμὸν εἰς τὴν ὁδὸν καὶ πορεύθητε εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐρεῖτε πρὸς αὐτούς οἰκέται σού ἐσμεν καὶ νῦν διάθεσθε ἡμῖν διαθήκην

text_en: Behold, these loaves we took hot, when we set out from our houses to come to you, now they have become dry, and broken in pieces by being exceeding old.
text_la: En panes quando egressi sumus de domibus nostris, ut veniremus ad vos, calidos sumpsimus; nunc sicci facti sunt, et vetustate nimia comminuti.
text_pt: Este nosso pão tomamos quente das nossas casas para nossa provisão, no dia em que saímos para vir a vós; e ei-lo aqui agora já seco e bolorento;
text_el: οὗτοι οἱ ἄρτοι θερμοὺς ἐφωδιάσθημεν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἐξήλθομεν παραγενέσθαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς νῦν δὲ ἐξηράνθησαν καὶ γεγόνασιν βεβρωμένοι

text_en: These bottles of wine when we filled them were new, now they are rent and burst. These garments we have on, and the shoes we have on our feet, by reason of the very long journey, are worn out, and almost consumed.
text_la: Utres vini novos implevimus; nunc rupti sunt et soluti. Vestes et calceamenta quibus induimur, et quæ habemus in pedibus, ob longitudinem longioris viæ trita sunt, et pene consumpta.
text_pt: E estes odres, que enchemos de vinho, eram novos, e ei-los aqui já rotos; e estas nossas roupas e nossos sapatos já se têm envelhecido, por causa do mui longo caminho.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ ἀσκοὶ τοῦ οἴνου οὓς ἐπλήσαμεν καινούς καὶ οὗτοι ἐρρώγασιν καὶ τὰ ἱμάτια ἡμῶν καὶ τὰ ὑποδήματα ἡμῶν πεπαλαίωται ἀπὸ τῆς πολλῆς ὁδοῦ σφόδρα

text_en: They took therefore of their victuals, and consulted not the mouth of the Lord .
text_la: Susceperunt igitur de cibariis eorum, et os Domini non interrogaverunt.
text_pt: Então os homens de Israel tomaram da provisão deles e não pediram conselho ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβον οἱ ἄρχοντες τοῦ ἐπισιτισμοῦ αὐτῶν καὶ κύριον οὐκ ἐπηρώτησαν

text_en: And Joshua made peace with them, and entering into a league, promised that they should not be slain: the princes also of the multitude swore to them.
text_la: Fecitque Josue cum eis pacem, et inito fœdere pollicitus est quod non occiderentur : principes quoque multitudinis juraverunt eis.
text_pt: E Josué fez paz com eles, e fez um acordo com eles, que lhes daria a vida; e os príncipes da congregação lhes prestaram juramento.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Ἰησοῦς πρὸς αὐτοὺς εἰρήνην καὶ διέθετο πρὸς αὐτοὺς διαθήκην τοῦ διασῶσαι αὐτούς καὶ ὤμοσαν αὐτοῖς οἱ ἄρχοντες τῆς συναγωγῆς

text_en: Now three days after the league was made, they heard that they dwelt near, and they should be among them.
text_la: Post dies autem tres initi fœderis, audierunt quod in vicino habitarent, et inter eos futuri essent.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ao fim de três dias, depois de fazerem acordo com eles, ouviram que eram seus vizinhos, e que moravam no meio deles.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας μετὰ τὸ διαθέσθαι πρὸς αὐτοὺς διαθήκην ἤκουσαν ὅτι ἐγγύθεν αὐτῶν εἰσιν καὶ ὅτι ἐν αὐτοῖς κατοικοῦσιν

text_en: And the children of Israel removed the camp, and came into their cities on the third day, the names of which are, Gabaon, and Caphira, and Beroth , and Cariathiarim.
text_la: Moveruntque castra filii Israël, et venerunt in civitates eorum die tertio, quarum hæc vocabula sunt : Gabaon, et Caphira, et Beroth, et Cariathiarim.
text_pt: Porque, partindo os filhos de Israel, chegaram às cidades deles ao terceiro dia; e suas cidades eram Gibeom e Cefira, e Beerote, e Quiriate-Jearim.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ἦλθον εἰς τὰς πόλεις αὐτῶν αἱ δὲ πόλεις αὐτῶν Γαβαων καὶ Κεφιρα καὶ Βηρωθ καὶ πόλις Ιαριν

text_en: And they slew them not, because the princes of the multitude had sworn in the name of the Lord , the God of Israel . Then all the common people murmured against the princes.
text_la: Et non percusserunt eos, eo quod jurassent eis principes multitudinis in nomine Domini Dei Israël. Murmuravit itaque omne vulgus contra principes.
text_pt: E os filhos de Israel não os feriram; porquanto os príncipes da congregação lhes juraram pelo Senhor Deus de Israel; por isso toda a congregação murmurava contra os príncipes.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐμαχέσαντο αὐτοῖς οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ὅτι ὤμοσαν αὐτοῖς πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες κύριον τὸν θεὸν Ισραηλ καὶ διεγόγγυσαν πᾶσα ἡ συναγωγὴ ἐπὶ τοῖς ἄρχουσιν

text_en: And they answered them: We have sworn to them in the name of the Lord , the God of Israel , and therefore we may not touch them.
text_la: Qui responderunt eis : Juravimus illis in nomine Domini Dei Israël, et idcirco non possumus eos contingere.
text_pt: Então todos os príncipes disseram a toda a congregação: Nós juramos-lhes pelo Senhor Deus de Israel, pelo que não lhes podemos tocar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ ἄρχοντες πάσῃ τῇ συναγωγῇ ἡμεῖς ὠμόσαμεν αὐτοῖς κύριον τὸν θεὸν Ισραηλ καὶ νῦν οὐ δυνησόμεθα ἅψασθαι αὐτῶν

text_en: But this we will do to them: Let their lives be saved, lest the wrath of the Lord be stirred up against us, if we should be forsworn:
text_la: Sed hoc faciemus eis : reserventur quidem ut vivant, ne contra nos ira Domini concitetur, si pejeraverimus:
text_pt: Isto, porém, lhes faremos: conservar-lhes-emos a vida, para que não haja grande ira sobre nós, por causa do juramento que já lhes fizemos.
text_el: τοῦτο ποιήσομεν ζωγρῆσαι αὐτούς καὶ περιποιησόμεθα αὐτούς καὶ οὐκ ἔσται καθ' ἡμῶν ὀργὴ διὰ τὸν ὅρκον ὃν ὠμόσαμεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: But so let them live, as to serve the whole multitude in hewing wood, and bringing in water. As they were speaking these things,
text_la: sed sic vivant, ut in usus universæ multitudinis ligna cædant, aquasque comportent. Quibus hæc loquentibus,
text_pt: Disseram-lhes, pois, os príncipes: Vivam, e sejam rachadores de lenha e tiradores de água para toda a congregação, como os príncipes lhes disseram.
text_el: ζήσονται καὶ ἔσονται ξυλοκόποι καὶ ὑδροφόροι πάσῃ τῇ συναγωγῇ καθάπερ εἶπαν αὐτοῖς οἱ ἄρχοντες

text_en: Joshua called the Gabaonites, and said to them: Why would you impose upon us, saying: We dwell very far off from you, whereas you are in the midst of us?
text_la: vocavit Gabaonitas Josue, et dixit eis : Cur nos decipere fraude voluistis, ut diceretis : Procul valde habitamus a vobis, cum in medio nostri sitis?
text_pt: E Josué os chamou, e falou-lhes dizendo: Por que nos enganastes dizendo: Mui longe de vós habitamos, morando vós no meio de nós?
text_el: καὶ συνεκάλεσεν αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς διὰ τί παρελογίσασθέ με λέγοντες μακρὰν ἀπὸ σοῦ ἐσμεν σφόδρα ὑμεῖς δὲ ἐγχώριοί ἐστε τῶν κατοικούντων ἐν ἡμῖν

text_en: Therefore you shall be under a curse , and your race shall always be hewers of wood, and carriers of water, into the house of my God .
text_la: itaque sub maledictione eritis, et non deficiet de stirpe vestra ligna cædens, aquasque comportans in domum Dei mei.
text_pt: Agora, pois, sereis malditos; e dentre vós não deixará de haver servos, nem rachadores de lenha, nem tiradores de água, para a casa do meu Deus.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἐπικατάρατοί ἐστε οὐ μὴ ἐκλίπῃ ἐξ ὑμῶν δοῦλος οὐδὲ ξυλοκόπος ἐμοὶ καὶ τῷ θεῷ μου

text_en: They answered: It was told us, your servants, that the Lord your God had promised his servant Moses , to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants thereof. Therefore we feared exceedingly and provided for our lives, compelled by the dread we had of you, and we took this counsel.
text_la: Qui responderunt : Nuntiatum est nobis servis tuis, quod promisisset Dominus Deus tuus Moysi servo suo ut traderet vobis omnem terram, et disperderet cunctos habitatores ejus. Timuimus igitur valde, et providimus animabus nostris, vestro terrore compulsi, et hoc consilium inivimus.
text_pt: Então responderam a Josué, e disseram: Porquanto com certeza foi anunciado aos teus servos que o Senhor teu Deus ordenou a Moisés, seu servo, que a vós daria toda esta terra, e destruiria todos os moradores da terra diante de vós, tememos muito por nossas vidas por causa de vós; por isso fizemos assim.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν τῷ Ἰησοῖ λέγοντες ἀνηγγέλη ἡμῖν ὅσα συνέταξεν κύριος ὁ θεός σου Μωυσῇ τῷ παιδὶ αὐτοῦ δοῦναι ὑμῖν τὴν γῆν ταύτην καὶ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι ἡμᾶς καὶ πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἀπὸ προσώπου ὑμῶν καὶ ἐφοβήθημεν σφόδρα περὶ τῶν ψυχῶν ἡμῶν ἀπὸ προσώπου ὑμῶν καὶ ἐποιήσαμεν τὸ πρᾶγμα τοῦτο

text_en: And now we are in your hand: deal with us as it seems good and right unto you.
text_la: Nunc autem in manu tua sumus : quod tibi bonum et rectum videtur, fac nobis.
text_pt: E eis que agora estamos na tua mão; faze-nos aquilo que te pareça bom e reto.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ὑποχείριοι ὑμῖν ὡς ἀρέσκει ὑμῖν καὶ ὡς δοκεῖ ὑμῖν ποιήσατε ἡμῖν

text_en: So Joshua did as he had said, and delivered them from the hand of the children of Israel , that they should not be slain.
text_la: Fecit ergo Josue ut dixerat, et liberavit eos de manu filiorum Israël, ut non occiderentur.
text_pt: Assim pois lhes fez, e livrou-os das mãos dos filhos de Israel, e não os mataram.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν αὐτοῖς οὕτως καὶ ἐξείλατο αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐκ χειρῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ οὐκ ἀνεῖλον αὐτούς

text_en: And he gave orders in that day, that they should be in the service of all the people, and of the altar of the Lord , hewing wood, and carrying water, until this present time, in the place which the Lord has chosen.
text_la: Decrevitque in illo die eos esse in ministerio cuncti populi, et altaris Domini, cædentes ligna, et aquas comportantes, usque in præsens tempus, in loco quem Dominus elegisset.
text_pt: E naquele dia, Josué os fez rachadores de lenha e tiradores de água para a congregação e para o altar do Senhor, até ao dia de hoje, no lugar que ele escolhesse.
text_el: καὶ κατέστησεν αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ξυλοκόπους καὶ ὑδροφόρους πάσῃ τῇ συναγωγῇ καὶ τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ τοῦ θεοῦ διὰ τοῦτο ἐγένοντο οἱ κατοικοῦντες Γαβαων ξυλοκόποι καὶ ὑδροφόροι τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας καὶ εἰς τὸν τόπον ὃν ἐὰν ἐκλέξηται κύριος

text_en: When Adonisedec, king of Jerusalem , had heard these things, to wit, that Joshua had taken Hai, and had destroyed it, (for as he had done to Jericho and the king thereof, so did he to Hai and its king) and that the Gabaonites had gone over to Israel , and were their confederates,
text_la: Quæ cum audisset Adonisedec rex Jerusalem, quod scilicet cepisset Josue Hai, et subvertisset eam (sicut enim fecerat Jericho et regi ejus, sic fecit Hai et regi illius), et quod transfugissent Gabaonitæ ad Israël, et essent fœderati eorum,
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo Adoni-Zedeque, rei de Jerusalém, que Josué tomara a Ai, e a tinha destruído totalmente, e fizera a Ai, e ao seu rei, como tinha feito a Jericó e ao seu rei, e que os moradores de Gibeom fizeram paz com os israelitas, e estavam no meio deles,
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἤκουσεν Αδωνιβεζεκ βασιλεὺς Ιερουσαλημ ὅτι ἔλαβεν Ἰησοῦς τὴν Γαι καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσεν αὐτήν ὃν τρόπον ἐποίησαν τὴν Ιεριχω καὶ τὸν βασιλέα αὐτῆς οὕτως ἐποίησαν τὴν Γαι καὶ τὸν βασιλέα αὐτῆς καὶ ὅτι αὐτομόλησαν οἱ κατοικοῦντες Γαβαων πρὸς Ἰησοῦν καὶ πρὸς Ισραηλ

text_en: he was exceedingly afraid. For Gabaon was a great city, and one of the royal cities, and greater than the town of Hai, and all its fighting men were most valiant .
text_la: timuit valde. Urbs enim magna erat Gabaon, et una civitatum regalium, et major oppido Hai, omnesque bellatores ejus fortissimi.
text_pt: Temeram muito, porque Gibeom era uma cidade grande, como uma das cidades reais, e ainda maior do que Ai, e todos os seus homens valentes.
text_el: καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν ἐν αὐτοῖς σφόδρα ᾔδει γὰρ ὅτι μεγάλη πόλις Γαβαων ὡσεὶ μία τῶν μητροπόλεων καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες αὐτῆς ἰσχυροί

text_en: Therefore Adonisedec, king of Jerusalem , sent to Oham, king of Hebron , and to Pharam, king of Jerimoth, and to Japhia, king of Lachis, and to Dabir, king of Eglon, saying:
text_la: Misit ergo Adonisedec rex Jerusalem ad Oham regem Hebron, et ad Pharam regem Jerimoth, ad Japhia quoque regem Lachis, et ad Dabir regem Eglon, dicens:
text_pt: Pelo que Adoni-Zedeque, rei de Jerusalém, enviou a Hoão, rei de Hebrom, e a Pirão, rei de Jarmute, e a Jafia, rei de Laquis e a Debir, rei de Eglom, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Αδωνιβεζεκ βασιλεὺς Ιερουσαλημ πρὸς Αιλαμ βασιλέα Χεβρων καὶ πρὸς Φιδων βασιλέα Ιεριμουθ καὶ πρὸς Ιεφθα βασιλέα Λαχις καὶ πρὸς Δαβιρ βασιλέα Οδολλαμ λέγων

text_en: Come up to me, and bring help, that we may take Gabaon, because it has gone over to Joshua , and to the children of Israel .
text_la: Ad me ascendite, et ferte præsidium, ut expugnemus Gabaon, quare transfugerit ad Josue, et ad filios Israël.
text_pt: Subi a mim, e ajudai-me, e firamos a Gibeom, porquanto fez paz com Josué e com os filhos de Israel.
text_el: δεῦτε ἀνάβητε πρός με καὶ βοηθήσατέ μοι καὶ ἐκπολεμήσωμεν Γαβαων αὐτομόλησαν γὰρ πρὸς Ἰησοῦν καὶ πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ

text_en: So the five kings of the Amorrhites being assembled together, went up: the king of Jerusalem , the king of Hebron , the king of Jerimoth, the king of Lachis, the king of Eglon, they and their armies, and camped about Gabaon, laying siege to it.
text_la: Congregati igitur ascenderunt quinque reges Amorrhæorum : rex Jerusalem, rex Hebron, rex Jerimoth, rex Lachis, rex Eglon, simul cum exercitibus suis : et castrametati sunt circa Gabaon, oppugnantes eam.
text_pt: Então se ajuntaram, e subiram cinco reis dos amorreus, o rei de Jerusalém, o rei de Hebrom, o rei de Jarmute, o rei de Laquis, o rei de Eglom, eles e todos os seus exércitos; e sitiaram a Gibeom e pelejaram contra ela.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβησαν οἱ πέντε βασιλεῖς τῶν Ιεβουσαίων βασιλεὺς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ βασιλεὺς Χεβρων καὶ βασιλεὺς Ιεριμουθ καὶ βασιλεὺς Λαχις καὶ βασιλεὺς Οδολλαμ αὐτοὶ καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς αὐτῶν καὶ περιεκάθισαν τὴν Γαβαων καὶ ἐξεπολιόρκουν αὐτήν

text_en: But the inhabitants of the city of Gabaon, which was besieged, sent to Joshua , who then abode in the camp at Galgal, and said to him: Withdraw not your hands from helping your servants: come up quickly, and save us, and bring us succour: for all the kings of the Amorrhites , who dwell in the mountains, are gathered together against us.
text_la: Habitatores autem Gabaon urbis obsessæ miserunt ad Josue, qui tunc morabatur in castris apud Galgalam, et dixerunt ei : Ne retrahas manus tuas ab auxilio servorum tuorum : ascende cito, et libera nos, ferque præsidium : convenerunt enim adversum nos omnes reges Amorrhæorum, qui habitant in montanis.
text_pt: Enviaram, pois, os homens de Gibeom a Josué, ao arraial de Gilgal, dizendo: Não retires as tuas mãos de teus servos; sobe apressadamente a nós, e livra-nos e ajuda-nos, porquanto todos os reis dos amorreus, que habitam na montanha, se ajuntaram contra nós.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλαν οἱ κατοικοῦντες Γαβαων πρὸς Ἰησοῦν εἰς τὴν παρεμβολὴν Ισραηλ εἰς Γαλγαλα λέγοντες μὴ ἐκλύσῃς τὰς χεῖράς σου ἀπὸ τῶν παίδων σου ἀνάβηθι πρὸς ἡμᾶς τὸ τάχος καὶ ἐξελοῦ ἡμᾶς καὶ βοήθησον ἡμῖν ὅτι συνηγμένοι εἰσὶν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς πάντες οἱ βασιλεῖς τῶν Αμορραίων οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν ὀρεινήν

text_en: And Joshua went up from Galgal, and all the army of the warriors with him, most valiant men .
text_la: Ascenditque Josue de Galgalis, et omnis exercitus bellatorum cum eo, viri fortissimi.
text_pt: Então subiu Josué, de Gilgal, ele e toda a gente de guerra com ele, e todos os homens valorosos.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη Ἰησοῦς ἐκ Γαλγαλων αὐτὸς καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁ πολεμιστὴς μετ' αὐτοῦ πᾶς δυνατὸς ἐν ἰσχύι

text_en: But the Lord said to Joshua : Fear them not: for I have delivered them into your hands: none of them shall be able to stand against you.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Josue : Ne timeas eos : in manus enim tuas tradidi illos : nullus ex eis tibi resistere poterit.
text_pt: E o Senhor disse a Josué: Não os temas, porque os tenho dado na tua mão; nenhum deles te poderá resistir.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Ἰησοῦν μὴ φοβηθῇς αὐτούς εἰς γὰρ τὰς χεῖράς σου παραδέδωκα αὐτούς οὐχ ὑπολειφθήσεται ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐθεὶς ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν

text_en: So Joshua going up from Galgal all the night, came upon them suddenly.
text_la: Irruit itaque Josue super eos repente, tota nocte ascendens de Galgalis.
text_pt: E Josué lhes sobreveio de repente, porque toda a noite veio subindo desde Gilgal.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιπαρεγένετο ἐπ' αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς ἄφνω ὅλην τὴν νύκτα εἰσεπορεύθη ἐκ Γαλγαλων

text_en: And the Lord troubled them, at the sight of Israel : and he slew them with a great slaughter, in Gabaon, and pursued them by the way of the ascent to Bethoron, and cut them off all the way to Azeca and Maceda.
text_la: Et conturbavit eos Dominus a facie Israël : contrivitque plaga magna in Gabaon, ac persecutus est eos per viam ascensus Bethoron, et percussit usque Azeca et Maceda.
text_pt: E o Senhor os conturbou diante de Israel, e os feriu com grande matança em Gibeom; e perseguiu-os pelo caminho que sobe a Bete-Horom, e feriu-os até Azeca e a Maquedá.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέστησεν αὐτοὺς κύριος ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ συνέτριψεν αὐτοὺς κύριος σύντριψιν μεγάλην ἐν Γαβαων καὶ κατεδίωξαν αὐτοὺς ὁδὸν ἀναβάσεως Ωρωνιν καὶ κατέκοπτον αὐτοὺς ἕως Αζηκα καὶ ἕως Μακηδα

text_en: And when they were fleeing from the children of Israel , and were in the descent of Bethoron, the Lord cast down upon them great stones from heaven , as far as Azeca: and many more were killed with the hailstones, than were slain by the swords of the children of Israel .
text_la: Cumque fugerent filios Israël, et essent in descensu Bethoron, Dominus misit super eos lapides magnos de cælo usque ad Azeca : et mortui sunt multo plures lapidibus grandinis, quam quos gladio percusserant filii Israël.
text_pt: E sucedeu que fugindo eles de diante de Israel, à descida de Bete-Horom, o Senhor lançou sobre eles, do céu, grandes pedras, até Azeca, e morreram; e foram muitos mais os que morreram das pedras da saraiva do que os que os filhos de Israel mataram à espada.
text_el: ἐν τῷ δὲ φεύγειν αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἐπὶ τῆς καταβάσεως Ωρωνιν καὶ κύριος ἐπέρριψεν αὐτοῖς λίθους χαλάζης ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἕως Αζηκα καὶ ἐγένοντο πλείους οἱ ἀποθανόντες διὰ τοὺς λίθους τῆς χαλάζης ἢ οὓς ἀπέκτειναν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ μαχαίρᾳ ἐν τῷ πολέμῳ

text_en: Then Joshua spoke to the Lord , in the day that he delivered the Amorrhite in the sight of the children of Israel , and he said before them: Move not, O sun, toward Gabaon, nor you, O moon, toward the valley of Ajalon.
text_la: Tunc locutus est Josue Domino, in die qua tradidit Amorrhæum in conspectu filiorum Israël, dixitque coram eis : Sol, contra Gabaon ne movearis, et luna contra vallem Ajalon.
text_pt: Então Josué falou ao Senhor, no dia em que o Senhor deu os amorreus nas mãos dos filhos de Israel, e disse na presença dos israelitas: Sol, detém-te em Gibeom, e tu, lua, no vale de Ajalom.
text_el: τότε ἐλάλησεν Ἰησοῦς πρὸς κύριον ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ παρέδωκεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν Αμορραῖον ὑποχείριον Ισραηλ ἡνίκα συνέτριψεν αὐτοὺς ἐν Γαβαων καὶ συνετρίβησαν ἀπὸ προσώπου υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν Ἰησοῦς στήτω ὁ ἥλιος κατὰ Γαβαων καὶ ἡ σελήνη κατὰ φάραγγα Αιλων

text_en: And the sun and the moon stood still, till the people revenged themselves of their enemies. Is not this written in the book of the just ? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven , and hasted not to go down the space of one day.
text_la: Steteruntque sol et luna, donec ulcisceretur se gens de inimicis suis. Nonne scriptum est hoc in libro justorum? Stetit itaque sol in medio cæli, et non festinavit occumbere spatio unius diei.
text_pt: E o sol se deteve, e a lua parou, até que o povo se vingou de seus inimigos. Isto não está escrito no livro de Jasher? O sol, pois, se deteve no meio do céu, e não se apressou a pôr-se, quase um dia inteiro.
text_el: καὶ ἔστη ὁ ἥλιος καὶ ἡ σελήνη ἐν στάσει ἕως ἠμύνατο ὁ θεὸς τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτῶν καὶ ἔστη ὁ ἥλιος κατὰ μέσον τοῦ οὐρανοῦ οὐ προεπορεύετο εἰς δυσμὰς εἰς τέλος ἡμέρας μιᾶς

text_en: There was not before, nor after, so long a day, the Lord obeying the voice of a man , and fighting for Israel .
text_la: Non fuit antea nec postea tam longa dies, obediente Domino voci hominis, et pugnante pro Israël.
text_pt: E não houve dia semelhante a este, nem antes nem depois dele, ouvindo o Senhor assim a voz de um homem; porque o Senhor pelejava por Israel.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐγένετο ἡμέρα τοιαύτη οὐδὲ τὸ πρότερον οὐδὲ τὸ ἔσχατον ὥστε ἐπακοῦσαι θεὸν ἀνθρώπου ὅτι κύριος συνεπολέμησεν τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: And Joshua returned, with all Israel , into the camp of Galgal.
text_la: Reversusque est Josue cum omni Israël in castra Galgalæ.
text_pt: E voltou Josué, e todo o Israel com ele, ao arraial, em Gilgal.

text_en: For the five kings were fled, and had hid themselves in a cave of the city of Maceda.
text_la: Fugerant enim quinque reges et se absconderant in spelunca urbis Maceda.
text_pt: Aqueles cinco reis, porém, fugiram, e se esconderam numa cova em Maquedá.
text_el: καὶ ἔφυγον οἱ πέντε βασιλεῖς οὗτοι καὶ κατεκρύβησαν εἰς τὸ σπήλαιον τὸ ἐν Μακηδα

text_en: And it was told Joshua , that the five kings were found hid in a cave of the city of Maceda.
text_la: Nuntiatumque est Josue quod inventi essent quinque reges latentes in spelunca urbis Maceda.
text_pt: E foi anunciado a Josué, dizendo: Acharam-se os cinco reis escondidos numa cova em Maquedá.
text_el: καὶ ἀπηγγέλη τῷ Ἰησοῦ λέγοντες εὕρηνται οἱ πέντε βασιλεῖς κεκρυμμένοι ἐν τῷ σπηλαίῳ τῷ ἐν Μακηδα

text_en: And he commanded them that were with him, saying: Roll great stones to the mouth of the cave, and set careful men to keep them shut up:
text_la: Qui præcepit sociis, et ait : Volvite saxa ingentia ad os speluncæ, et ponite viros industrios, qui clausos custodiant:
text_pt: Disse, pois, Josué: Arrastai grandes pedras à boca da cova, e ponde sobre ela homens que os guardem;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰησοῦς κυλίσατε λίθους ἐπὶ τὸ στόμα τοῦ σπηλαίου καὶ καταστήσατε ἄνδρας φυλάσσειν ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: And stay you not, but pursue after the enemies, and kill all the hindermost of them as they flee, and do not allow them whom the Lord God has delivered into your hands, to shelter themselves in their cities.
text_la: vos autem nolite stare, sed persequimini hostes, et extremos quosque fugientium cædite : nec dimittatis eos urbium suarum intrare præsidia, quos tradidit Dominus Deus in manus vestras.
text_pt: Porém vós não vos detenhais; persegui os vossos inimigos, e atacai os que vão ficando atrás; não os deixeis entrar nas suas cidades, porque o Senhor vosso Deus já vo-los deu na vossa mão.
text_el: ὑμεῖς δὲ μὴ ἑστήκατε καταδιώκοντες ὀπίσω τῶν ἐχθρῶν ὑμῶν καὶ καταλάβετε τὴν οὐραγίαν αὐτῶν καὶ μὴ ἀφῆτε εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὰς πόλεις αὐτῶν παρέδωκεν γὰρ αὐτοὺς κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν εἰς τὰς χεῖρας ἡμῶν

text_en: So the enemies being slain with a great slaughter, and almost utterly consumed, they that were able to escape from Israel , entered into fenced cities.
text_la: Cæsis ergo adversariis plaga magna, et usque ad internecionem pene consumptis, hi qui Israël effugere potuerunt, ingressi sunt civitates munitas.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, acabando Josué e os filhos de Israel de os ferir com grande matança, até consumi-los, e os que ficaram deles se retiraram às cidades fortificadas,
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς κατέπαυσεν Ἰησοῦς καὶ πᾶς υἱὸς Ισραηλ κόπτοντες αὐτοὺς κοπὴν μεγάλην σφόδρα ἕως εἰς τέλος καὶ οἱ διασῳζόμενοι διεσώθησαν εἰς τὰς πόλεις τὰς ὀχυράς

text_en: And all the army returned to Joshua , in Maceda, where the camp then was, in good health, and without the loss of any one: and no man dared move his tongue against the children of Israel .
text_la: Reversusque est omnis exercitus ad Josue in Maceda, ubi tunc erant castra, sani et integro numero : nullusque contra filios Israël mutire ausus est.
text_pt: Todo o povo voltou em paz a Josué, ao arraial em Maquedá; não havendo ninguém que movesse a sua língua contra os filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεστράφη πᾶς ὁ λαὸς πρὸς Ἰησοῦν εἰς Μακηδα ὑγιεῖς καὶ οὐκ ἔγρυξεν οὐθεὶς τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ τῇ γλώσσῃ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Joshua gave orders, saying: Open the mouth of the cave, and bring forth to me the five kings that lie hid therein.
text_la: Præcepitque Josue, dicens : Aperite os speluncæ, et producite ad me quinque reges, qui in ea latitant.
text_pt: Depois disse Josué: Abri a boca da cova, e trazei-me para fora aqueles cinco reis.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰησοῦς ἀνοίξατε τὸ σπήλαιον καὶ ἐξαγάγετε τοὺς πέντε βασιλεῖς τούτους ἐκ τοῦ σπηλαίου

text_en: And the ministers did as they were commanded: and they brought out to him the five kings out of the cave: the king of Jerusalem , the king of Hebron , the king of Jerimoth, the king of Lachis, the king of Eglon.
text_la: Feceruntque ministri ut sibi fuerat imperatum : et eduxerunt ad eum quinque reges de spelunca, regem Jerusalem, regem Hebron, regem Jerimoth, regem Lachis, regem Eglon.
text_pt: Fizeram, pois, assim, e trouxeram-lhe aqueles cinco reis para fora da cova: o rei de Jerusalém, o rei de Hebrom, o rei de Jarmute, o rei de Laquis e o rei de Eglom.
text_el: καὶ ἐξηγάγοσαν τοὺς πέντε βασιλεῖς ἐκ τοῦ σπηλαίου τὸν βασιλέα Ιερουσαλημ καὶ τὸν βασιλέα Χεβρων καὶ τὸν βασιλέα Ιεριμουθ καὶ τὸν βασιλέα Λαχις καὶ τὸν βασιλέα Οδολλαμ

text_en: And when they were brought out to him, he called all the men of Israel , and said to the chiefs of the army that were with him: Go, and set your feet on the necks of these kings. And when they had gone, and put their feet upon the necks of them lying under them,
text_la: Cumque educti essent ad eum, vocavit omnes viros Israël, et ait ad principes exercitus qui secum erant : Ite, et ponite pedes super colla regum istorum. Qui cum perrexissent, et subjectorum colla pedibus calcarent,
text_pt: E sucedeu que, trazendo aqueles reis a Josué, este chamou todos os homens de Israel, e disse aos capitães dos homens de guerra, que foram com ele: Chegai, ponde os vossos pés sobre os pescoços destes reis. E chegaram, e puseram os seus pés sobre os pescoços deles.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεὶ ἐξήγαγον αὐτοὺς πρὸς Ἰησοῦν καὶ συνεκάλεσεν Ἰησοῦς πάντα Ισραηλ καὶ τοὺς ἐναρχομένους τοῦ πολέμου τοὺς συμπορευομένους αὐτῷ λέγων αὐτοῖς προπορεύεσθε καὶ ἐπίθετε τοὺς πόδας ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τοὺς τραχήλους αὐτῶν καὶ προσελθόντες ἐπέθηκαν τοὺς πόδας αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τοὺς τραχήλους αὐτῶν

text_en: he said again to them: Fear not, neither be dismayed, take courage , and be strong: for so will the Lord do to all your enemies, against whom you fight.
text_la: rursum ait ad eos : Nolite timere, nec paveatis : confortamini, et estote robusti : sic enim faciet Dominus cunctis hostibus vestris, adversum quos dimicatis.
text_pt: Então Josué lhes disse: Não temais, nem vos espanteis; esforçai-vos e animai-vos; porque assim o fará o Senhor a todos os vossos inimigos, contra os quais pelejardes.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς μὴ φοβηθῆτε αὐτοὺς μηδὲ δειλιάσητε ἀνδρίζεσθε καὶ ἰσχύετε ὅτι οὕτως ποιήσει κύριος πᾶσι τοῖς ἐχθροῖς ὑμῶν οὓς ὑμεῖς καταπολεμεῖτε αὐτούς

text_en: And Joshua struck, and slew them, and hanged them upon five gibbets; and they hung until the evening.
text_la: Percussitque Josue, et interfecit eos, atque suspendit super quinque stipites : fueruntque suspensi usque ad vesperum.
text_pt: E, depois disto, Josué os feriu, e os matou, e os enforcou em cinco madeiros; e ficaram enforcados nos madeiros até à tarde.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἐκρέμασεν αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ πέντε ξύλων καὶ ἦσαν κρεμάμενοι ἐπὶ τῶν ξύλων ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: And when the sun was down, he commanded the soldiers to take them down from the gibbets. And after they were taken down, they cast them into the cave, where they had lain hid, and put great stones at the mouth thereof, which remain until this day.
text_la: Cumque occumberet sol, præcepit sociis ut deponerent eos de patibulis. Qui depositos projecerunt in speluncam in qua latuerant, et posuerunt super os ejus saxa ingentia, quæ permanent usque in præsens.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ao pôr do sol, deu Josué ordem que os tirassem dos madeiros; e lançaram-nos na cova onde se esconderam; e puseram grandes pedras à boca da cova, que ainda ali estão até o dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη πρὸς ἡλίου δυσμὰς ἐνετείλατο Ἰησοῦς καὶ καθεῖλον αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῶν ξύλων καὶ ἔρριψαν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸ σπήλαιον εἰς ὃ κατεφύγοσαν ἐκεῖ καὶ ἐπεκύλισαν λίθους ἐπὶ τὸ σπήλαιον ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας

text_en: The same day Joshua took Maceda, and destroyed it with the edge of the sword, and killed the king and all the inhabitants thereof: he left not in it the least remains. And he did to the king of Maceda, as he had done to the king of Jericho .
text_la: Eodem quoque die, Macedam cepit Josue, et percussit eam in ore gladii, regemque illius interfecit, et omnes habitatores ejus : non dimisit in ea saltem parvas reliquias. Fecitque regi Maceda sicut fecerat regi Jericho.
text_pt: E naquele mesmo dia tomou Josué a Maquedá, e feriu-a a fio de espada, bem como ao seu rei; totalmente a destruiu com todos que nela havia, sem nada deixar; e fez ao rei de Maquedá como fizera ao rei de Jericó.
text_el: καὶ τὴν Μακηδα ἐλάβοσαν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ ἐφόνευσαν αὐτὴν ἐν στόματι ξίφους καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσαν πᾶν ἐμπνέον ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ οὐ κατελείφθη ἐν αὐτῇ οὐδεὶς διασεσῳσμένος καὶ διαπεφευγώς καὶ ἐποίησαν τῷ βασιλεῖ Μακηδα ὃν τρόπον ἐποίησαν τῷ βασιλεῖ Ιεριχω

text_en: And he passed from Maceda with all Israel to Lebna, and fought against it:
text_la: Transivit autem cum omni Israël de Maceda in Lebna, et pugnabat contra eam:
text_pt: Então Josué, e todo o Israel com ele, passou de Maquedá a Libna e pelejou contra ela.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν Ἰησοῦς καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐκ Μακηδα εἰς Λεβνα καὶ ἐπολιόρκει Λεβνα

text_en: And the Lord delivered it with the king thereof into the hands of Israel : and they destroyed the city with the edge of the sword, and all the inhabitants thereof. They left not in it any remains. And they did to the king of Lebna, as they had done to the king of Jericho .
text_la: quam tradidit Dominus cum rege suo in manus Israël : percusseruntque urbem in ore gladii, et omnes habitatores ejus : non dimiserunt in ea ullas reliquias. Feceruntque regi Lebna sicut fecerant regi Jericho.
text_pt: E também o Senhor a deu na mão de Israel, a ela e a seu rei, e a feriu a fio de espada, a ela e a todos que nela estavam; sem nada deixar; e fez ao seu rei como fizera ao rei de Jericó.
text_el: καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτὴν κύριος εἰς χεῖρας Ισραηλ καὶ ἔλαβον αὐτὴν καὶ τὸν βασιλέα αὐτῆς καὶ ἐφόνευσαν αὐτὴν ἐν στόματι ξίφους καὶ πᾶν ἐμπνέον ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ οὐ κατελείφθη ἐν αὐτῇ οὐδὲ εἷς διασεσῳσμένος καὶ διαπεφευγώς καὶ ἐποίησαν τῷ βασιλεῖ αὐτῆς ὃν τρόπον ἐποίησαν τῷ βασιλεῖ Ιεριχω

text_en: From Lebna he passed unto Lachis, with all Israel : and investing it with his army, besieged it.
text_la: De Lebna transivit in Lachis cum omni Israël : et exercitu per gyrum disposito, oppugnabat eam.
text_pt: Então Josué, e todo o Israel com ele, passou de Libna a Laquis; e a sitiou, e pelejou contra ela;
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν Ἰησοῦς καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐκ Λεβνα εἰς Λαχις καὶ περιεκάθισεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐπολιόρκει αὐτήν

text_en: And the Lord delivered Lachis into the hands of Israel , and he took it the following day, and put it to the sword, and every soul that was in it, as he had done to Lebna.
text_la: Tradiditque Dominus Lachis in manus Israël, et cepit eam die altero, atque percussit in ore gladii, omnemque animam quæ fuerat in ea, sicut fecerat Lebna.
text_pt: E o Senhor deu a Laquis nas mãos de Israel, e tomou-a no dia seguinte e a feriu a fio de espada, a ela e a todos os que nela estavam, conforme a tudo o que fizera a Libna.
text_el: καὶ παρέδωκεν κύριος τὴν Λαχις εἰς τὰς χεῖρας Ισραηλ καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτὴν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ δευτέρᾳ καὶ ἐφόνευσαν αὐτὴν ἐν στόματι ξίφους καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσαν αὐτήν ὃν τρόπον ἐποίησαν τὴν Λεβνα

text_en: At that time Horam, king of Gazer, came up to succour Lachis: and Joshua slew him with all his people so as to leave none alive.
text_la: Eo tempore ascendit Horam rex Gazer, ut auxiliaretur Lachis : quem percussit Josue cum omni populo ejus usque ad internecionem.
text_pt: Então Horão, rei de Gezer, subiu a ajudar a Laquis, porém Josué o feriu, a ele e ao seu povo, até não lhe deixar nem sequer um.
text_el: τότε ἀνέβη Αιλαμ βασιλεὺς Γαζερ βοηθήσων τῇ Λαχις καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν Ἰησοῦς ἐν στόματι ξίφους καὶ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἕως τοῦ μὴ καταλειφθῆναι αὐτῶν σεσῳσμένον καὶ διαπεφευγότα

text_en: And he passed from Lachis to Eglon, and surrounded it,
text_la: Transivitque de Lachis in Eglon, et circumdedit,
text_pt: E Josué, e todo o Israel com ele, passou de Laquis a Eglom, e a sitiaram, e pelejaram contra ela.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν Ἰησοῦς καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐκ Λαχις εἰς Οδολλαμ καὶ περιεκάθισεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐπολιόρκησεν αὐτήν

text_en: and took it the same day: and put to the sword all the souls that were in it, according to all that he had done to Lachis.
text_la: atque expugnavit eam eadem die : percussitque in ore gladii omnes animas quæ erant in ea, juxta omnia quæ fecerat Lachis.
text_pt: E no mesmo dia a tomaram, e a feriram a fio de espada; e a todos os que nela estavam, destruiu totalmente no mesmo dia, conforme a tudo o que fizera a Laquis.
text_el: καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτὴν κύριος ἐν χειρὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτὴν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ ἐφόνευσεν αὐτὴν ἐν στόματι ξίφους καὶ πᾶν ἐμπνέον ἐν αὐτῇ ἐφόνευσαν ὃν τρόπον ἐποίησαν τῇ Λαχις

text_en: He went up also with all Israel from Eglon to Hebron , and fought against it:
text_la: Ascendit quoque cum omni Israël de Eglon in Hebron, et pugnavit contra eam:
text_pt: Depois Josué, e todo o Israel com ele, subiu de Eglom a Hebrom, e pelejaram contra ela.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν Ἰησοῦς καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ μετ' αὐτοῦ εἰς Χεβρων καὶ περιεκάθισεν αὐτήν

text_en: Took it, and destroyed it with the edge of the sword: the king also thereof, and all the towns of that country, and all the souls that dwelt in it: he left not therein any remains: as he had done to Eglon, so did he also to Hebron , putting to the sword all that he found in it.
