text_la: cepit eam, et percussit in ore gladii, regem quoque ejus, et omnia oppida regionis illius, universasque animas quæ in ea fuerant commoratæ : non reliquit in ea ullas reliquias : sicut fecerat Eglon, sic fecit et Hebron, cuncta quæ in ea reperit consumens gladio.
text_pt: E a tomaram, e a feriram ao fio de espada, assim ao seu rei como a todas as suas cidades; e a todos os que nelas estavam, a ninguém deixou com vida, conforme a tudo o que fizera a Eglom; e a destruiu totalmente, a ela e a todos os que nela estavam.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὴν ἐν στόματι ξίφους καὶ πᾶν ἐμπνέον ὅσα ἦν ἐν αὐτῇ οὐκ ἦν διασεσῳσμένος ὃν τρόπον ἐποίησαν τὴν Οδολλαμ ἐξωλέθρευσαν αὐτὴν καὶ ὅσα ἦν ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: Returning from thence to Dabir,
text_la: Inde reversus in Dabir,
text_pt: Então Josué, e todo o Israel com ele, tornou a Debir, e pelejou contra ela.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν Ἰησοῦς καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ εἰς Δαβιρ καὶ περικαθίσαντες αὐτὴν

text_en: he took it, and destroyed it: the king also thereof, and all the towns round about, he destroyed with the edge of the sword: he left not in it any remains: as he had done to Hebron and Lebna, and to their kings, so did he to Dabir, and to the king thereof.
text_la: cepit eam atque vastavit : regem quoque ejus atque omnia per circuitum oppida percussit in ore gladii : non dimisit in ea ullas reliquias : sicut fecerat Hebron et Lebna et regibus earum, sic fecit Dabir et regi illius.
text_pt: E tomou-a com o seu rei, e a todas as suas cidades, e as feriu a fio de espada, e a todos os que nelas estavam destruiu totalmente; nada deixou; como fizera a Hebrom, assim fez a Debir e ao seu rei, e como fizera a Libna e ao seu rei.
text_el: ἔλαβον αὐτὴν καὶ τὸν βασιλέα αὐτῆς καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς καὶ ἐπάταξαν αὐτὴν ἐν στόματι ξίφους καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσαν αὐτὴν καὶ πᾶν ἐμπνέον ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ οὐ κατέλιπον αὐτῇ οὐδένα διασεσῳσμένον ὃν τρόπον ἐποίησαν τὴν Χεβρων καὶ τῷ βασιλεῖ αὐτῆς οὕτως ἐποίησαν τῇ Δαβιρ καὶ τῷ βασιλεῖ αὐτῆς

text_en: So Joshua conquered all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the plain, and of Asedoth, with their kings: he left not any remains therein, but slew all that breathed, as the Lord , the God of Israel , had commanded him.
text_la: Percussit itaque Josue omnem terram montanam et meridianam atque campestrem, et Asedoth, cum regibus suis : non dimisit in ea ullas reliquias, sed omne quod spirare poterat interfecit, sicut præceperat ei Dominus Deus Israël,
text_pt: Assim feriu Josué toda aquela terra, as montanhas, o sul, e as campinas, e as descidas das águas, e a todos os seus reis; nada deixou; mas tudo o que tinha fôlego destruiu, como ordenara o Senhor Deus de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν Ἰησοῦς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν τῆς ὀρεινῆς καὶ τὴν Ναγεβ καὶ τὴν πεδινὴν καὶ τὴν Ασηδωθ καὶ τοὺς βασιλεῖς αὐτῆς οὐ κατέλιπον αὐτῶν σεσῳσμένον καὶ πᾶν ἐμπνέον ζωῆς ἐξωλέθρευσεν ὃν τρόπον ἐνετείλατο κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ

text_en: From Cadesbarne even to Gaza . All the land of Gosen even to Gabaon,
text_la: a Cadesbarne usque Gazam. Omnem terram Gosen usque Gabaon,
text_pt: E Josué os feriu desde Cades-Barnéia, até Gaza, como também toda a terra de Gósen, e até Gibeom.
text_el: ἀπὸ Καδης Βαρνη ἕως Γάζης πᾶσαν τὴν Γοσομ ἕως τῆς Γαβαων

text_en: and all their kings, and their lands he took and wasted at one onset: for the Lord the God of Israel fought for him.
text_la: universosque reges, et regiones eorum uno impetu cepit atque vastavit : Dominus enim Deus Israël pugnavit pro eo.
text_pt: E de uma vez tomou Josué todos estes reis, e as suas terras; porquanto o Senhor Deus de Israel pelejava por Israel.
text_el: καὶ πάντας τοὺς βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν καὶ τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν ἐπάταξεν Ἰησοῦς εἰς ἅπαξ ὅτι κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ συνεπολέμει τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: And he returned with all Israel to the place of the camp in Galgal.
text_la: Reversusque est cum omni Israël ad locum castrorum in Galgala.
text_pt: Então Josué, e todo o Israel com ele, voltou ao arraial em Gilgal.

text_en: And when Jabin king of Asor had heard these things, he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Semeron, and to the king of Achsaph:
text_la: Quæ cum audisset Jabin rex Asor, misit ad Jobab regem Madon, et ad regem Semeron, atque ad regem Achsaph:
text_pt: Sucedeu depois disto que, ouvindo-o Jabim, rei de Hazor, enviou mensageiros a Jobabe, rei de Madom, e ao rei de Sinrom, e ao rei de Acsafe;
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἤκουσεν Ιαβιν βασιλεὺς Ασωρ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς Ιωβαβ βασιλέα Μαρρων καὶ πρὸς βασιλέα Συμοων καὶ πρὸς βασιλέα Αζιφ

text_en: And to the kings of the north, that dwelt in the mountains and in the plains over against the south side of Ceneroth, and in the levels and the countries of Dor by the sea side:
text_la: ad reges quoque aquilonis, qui habitabant in montanis et in planitie contra meridiem Ceneroth, in campestribus quoque et in regionibus Dor juxta mare:
text_pt: E aos reis, que estavam ao norte, nas montanhas, e na campina para o sul de Quinerete, e nas planícies, e nas elevações de Dor, do lado do mar;
text_el: καὶ πρὸς τοὺς βασιλεῖς τοὺς κατὰ Σιδῶνα τὴν μεγάλην εἰς τὴν ὀρεινὴν καὶ εἰς τὴν Ραβα ἀπέναντι Κενερωθ καὶ εἰς τὸ πεδίον καὶ εἰς Ναφεδδωρ

text_en: To the Chanaanites also on the east and on the west, and the Amorrhite , and the Hethite , and the Pherezite, and the Jebusite in the mountains: to the Hevite also who dwelt at the foot of Hermon in the land of Maspha .
text_la: Chananæum quoque ab oriente et occidente, et Amorrhæum atque Hethæum ac Pherezæum et Jebusæum in montanis : Hevæum quoque qui habitabat ad radices Hermon in terra Maspha.
text_pt: Ao cananeu do oriente e do ocidente; e ao amorreu, e ao heteu, e ao perizeu, e ao jebuseu nas montanhas; e ao heveu ao pé de Hermom, na terra de Mizpá.
text_el: καὶ εἰς τοὺς παραλίους Χαναναίους ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ εἰς τοὺς παραλίους Αμορραίους καὶ Ευαίους καὶ Ιεβουσαίους καὶ Φερεζαίους τοὺς ἐν τῷ ὄρει καὶ τοὺς Χετταίους τοὺς ὑπὸ τὴν Αερμων εἰς γῆν Μασσηφα

text_en: And they all came out with their troops, a people exceeding numerous as the sand that is on the sea shore, their horses also and chariots a very great multitude,
text_la: Egressique sunt omnes cum turmis suis, populus multus nimis sicut arena quæ est in littore maris, equi quoque et currus immensæ multitudinis.
text_pt: Saíram pois estes, e todos os seus exércitos com eles, muito povo, em multidão como a areia que está na praia do mar; e muitíssimos cavalos e carros.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθον αὐτοὶ καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν μετ' αὐτῶν ὥσπερ ἡ ἄμμος τῆς θαλάσσης τῷ πλήθει καὶ ἵπποι καὶ ἅρματα πολλὰ σφόδρα

text_en: and all these kings assembled together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel .
text_la: Conveneruntque omnes reges isti in unum ad aquas Merom, ut pugnarent contra Israël.
text_pt: Todos estes reis se ajuntaram, e vieram e se acamparam junto às águas de Merom, para pelejarem contra Israel.
text_el: καὶ συνῆλθον πάντες οἱ βασιλεῖς οὗτοι καὶ παρεγένοντο ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐπὶ τοῦ ὕδατος Μαρρων πολεμῆσαι τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: And the Lord said to Joshua : Fear them not: for tomorrow at this same hour I will deliver all these to be slain in the sight of Israel : you shall hamstring their horses, and you shall burn their chariots with fire.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Josue : Ne timeas eos : cras enim hac eadem hora ego tradam omnes istos vulnerandos in conspectu Israël : equos eorum subnervabis, et currus igne combures.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Josué: Não temas diante deles; porque amanhã, a esta mesma hora, eu os darei todos feridos diante dos filhos de Israel; os seus cavalos jarretarás, e os seus carros queimarás a fogo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Ἰησοῦν μὴ φοβηθῇς ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν ὅτι αὔριον ταύτην τὴν ὥραν ἐγὼ παραδίδωμι τετροπωμένους αὐτοὺς ἐναντίον τοῦ Ισραηλ τοὺς ἵππους αὐτῶν νευροκοπήσεις καὶ τὰ ἅρματα αὐτῶν κατακαύσεις ἐν πυρί

text_en: And Joshua came, and all the army with him, against them to the waters of Merom on a sudden, and fell upon them.
text_la: Venitque Josue, et omnis exercitus cum eo, adversus illos ad aquas Merom subito, et irruerunt super eos,
text_pt: E Josué, e todos os homens de guerra com ele, veio apressadamente sobre eles às águas de Merom, e atacou-os de repente.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Ἰησοῦς καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὁ πολεμιστὴς ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τὸ ὕδωρ Μαρρων ἐξάπινα καὶ ἐπέπεσαν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ὀρεινῇ

text_en: And the Lord delivered them into the hands of Israel . And they defeated them, and chased them as far as the great Sidon and the waters of Maserophot, and the field of Masphe, which is on the east thereof. He slew them all, so as to leave no remains of them:
text_la: tradiditque illos Dominus in manus Israël. Qui percusserunt eos, et persecuti sunt usque ad Sidonem magnam, et aquas Maserephoth, campumque Masphe, qui est ad orientalem illius partem. Ita percussit omnes, ut nullas dimitteret ex eis reliquias:
text_pt: E o Senhor os deu nas mãos de Israel; e eles os feriram, e os perseguiram até à grande Sidom, e até Misrefote-Maim, e até ao vale de Mizpá ao oriente; feriram até não lhes deixarem nenhum.
text_el: καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς κύριος ὑποχειρίους Ισραηλ καὶ κόπτοντες αὐτοὺς κατεδίωκον ἕως Σιδῶνος τῆς μεγάλης καὶ ἕως Μασερων καὶ ἕως τῶν πεδίων Μασσωχ κατ' ἀνατολὰς καὶ κατέκοψαν αὐτοὺς ἕως τοῦ μὴ καταλειφθῆναι αὐτῶν διασεσῳσμένον

text_en: And he did as the Lord had commanded him, he hamstringed their horses and burned their chariots.
text_la: fecitque sicut præceperat ei Dominus : equos eorum subnervavit, currusque combussit igni.
text_pt: E fez-lhes Josué como o Senhor lhe dissera; os seus cavalos jarretou, e os seus carros queimou a fogo.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς ὃν τρόπον ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ κύριος τοὺς ἵππους αὐτῶν ἐνευροκόπησεν καὶ τὰ ἅρματα αὐτῶν ἐνέπρησεν ἐν πυρί

text_en: And presently turning back he took Asor: and slew the king thereof with the sword. Now Asor of old was the head of all these kingdoms.
text_la: Reversusque statim cepit Asor, et regem ejus percussit gladio. Asor enim antiquitus inter omnia regna hæc principatum tenebat.
text_pt: E naquele mesmo tempo voltou Josué, e tomou a Hazor, e feriu à espada ao seu rei; porquanto Hazor antes era a cabeça de todos estes reinos.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεστράφη Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ καὶ κατελάβετο Ασωρ καὶ τὸν βασιλέα αὐτῆς ἦν δὲ Ασωρ τὸ πρότερον ἄρχουσα πασῶν τῶν βασιλειῶν τούτων

text_en: And he cut off all the souls that abode there: he left not in it any remains, but utterly destroyed all, and burned the city itself with fire.
text_la: Percussitque omnes animas quæ ibidem morabantur : non dimisit in ea ullas reliquias, sed usque ad internecionem universa vastavit, ipsamque urbem peremit incendio.
text_pt: E a todos os que nela estavam, feriram ao fio da espada, e totalmente os destruíram; nada restou do que tinha fôlego, e a Hazor queimou a fogo.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέκτειναν πᾶν ἐμπνέον ἐν αὐτῇ ἐν ξίφει καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσαν πάντας καὶ οὐ κατελείφθη ἐν αὐτῇ ἐμπνέον καὶ τὴν Ασωρ ἐνέπρησαν ἐν πυρί

text_en: And he took and put to the sword and destroyed all the cities round about, and their kings, as Moses the servant of God had commanded him.
text_la: Et omnes per circuitum civitates, regesque earum, cepit, percussit atque delevit, sicut præceperat ei Moyses famulus Domini.
text_pt: E Josué tomou todas as cidades destes reis, e todos os seus reis, e os feriu ao fio da espada, destruindo-os totalmente, como ordenara Moisés servo do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ πάσας τὰς πόλεις τῶν βασιλέων καὶ τοὺς βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν ἔλαβεν Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἀνεῖλεν αὐτοὺς ἐν στόματι ξίφους καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσαν αὐτούς ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν Μωυσῆς ὁ παῖς κυρίου

text_en: Except the cities that were on hills and high places, the rest Israel burned: only Asor that was very strong he consumed with fire.
text_la: Absque urbibus, quæ erant in collibus et in tumulis sitæ, ceteras succendit Israël : unam tantum Asor munitissimam flamma consumpsit.
text_pt: Tão-somente não queimaram os israelitas as cidades que estavam sobre os seus outeiros; a não ser Hazor, a qual Josué queimou.
text_el: ἀλλὰ πάσας τὰς πόλεις τὰς κεχωματισμένας οὐκ ἐνέπρησεν Ισραηλ πλὴν Ασωρ μόνην ἐνέπρησεν Ἰησοῦς

text_en: And the children of Israel divided among themselves all the spoil of these cities and the cattle, killing all the men .
text_la: Omnemque prædam istarum urbium ac jumenta diviserunt sibi filii Israël, cunctis hominibus interfectis.
text_pt: E todos os despojos destas cidades, e o gado, os filhos de Israel tomaram para si; tão-somente a todos os homens feriram ao fio da espada, até que os destruíram; nada do que tinha fôlego deixaram com vida.
text_el: καὶ πάντα τὰ σκῦλα αὐτῆς ἐπρονόμευσαν ἑαυτοῖς οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ αὐτοὺς δὲ πάντας ἐξωλέθρευσαν ἐν στόματι ξίφους ἕως ἀπώλεσεν αὐτούς οὐ κατέλιπον ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐδὲ ἓν ἐμπνέον

text_en: As the Lord had commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua , and he accomplished all: he left not one thing undone of all the commandments which the Lord had commanded Moses .
text_la: Sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi servo suo, ita præcepit Moyses Josue, et ille universa complevit : non præteriit de universis mandatis, nec unum quidem verbum quod jusserat Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: Como ordenara o Senhor a Moisés, seu servo, assim Moisés ordenou a Josué; e assim Josué o fez; nem uma só palavra tirou de tudo o que o Senhor ordenara a Moisés.
text_el: ὃν τρόπον συνέταξεν κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ τῷ παιδὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ Μωυσῆς ὡσαύτως ἐνετείλατο τῷ Ἰησοῖ καὶ οὕτως ἐποίησεν Ἰησοῦς οὐ παρέβη οὐδὲν ἀπὸ πάντων ὧν συνέταξεν αὐτῷ Μωυσῆς

text_en: So Joshua took all the country of the hills, and of the south, and the land of Gosen, and the plains and the west country, and the mountain of Israel , and the plains thereof:
text_la: Cepit itaque Josue omnem terram montanam et meridianam, terramque Gosen, et planitiem, et occidentalem plagam, montemque Israël, et campestria ejus,
text_pt: Assim Josué tomou toda aquela terra, as montanhas, e todo o sul, e toda a terra de Gósen, e as planícies, e as campinas, e as montanhas de Israel, e as suas planícies.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ἰησοῦς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν τὴν ὀρεινὴν καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν Ναγεβ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Γοσομ καὶ τὴν πεδινὴν καὶ τὴν πρὸς δυσμαῖς καὶ τὸ ὄρος Ισραηλ καὶ τὰ ταπεινά

text_en: And part of the mountain that goes up to Seir as far as Baalgad, by the plain of Libanus under mount Hermon : all their kings he took, smote and slew.
text_la: et partem montis, quæ ascendit Seir usque Baalgad, per planitiem Libani subter montem Hermon : omnes reges eorum cepit, percussit, et occidit.
text_pt: Desde o monte Halaque, que sobe a Seir, até Baal-Gade, no vale do Líbano, ao pé do monte de Hermom; também tomou todos os seus reis, e os feriu e os matou.
text_el: τὰ πρὸς τῷ ὄρει ἀπὸ ὄρους Αχελ καὶ ὃ προσαναβαίνει εἰς Σηιρ καὶ ἕως Βααλγαδ καὶ τὰ πεδία τοῦ Λιβάνου ὑπὸ τὸ ὄρος τὸ Αερμων καὶ πάντας τοὺς βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν ἔλαβεν καὶ ἀνεῖλεν αὐτοὺς καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν

text_en: Joshua made war a long time against these kings.
text_la: Multo tempore pugnavit Josue contra reges istos.
text_pt: Por muito tempo Josué fez guerra contra todos estes reis.
text_el: καὶ πλείους ἡμέρας ἐποίησεν Ἰησοῦς πρὸς τοὺς βασιλεῖς τούτους τὸν πόλεμον

text_en: There was not a city that delivered itself to the children of Israel , except the Hevite, who dwelt in Gabaon: for he took all by fight.
text_la: Non fuit civitas quæ se traderet filiis Israël, præter Hevæum, qui habitabat in Gabaon : omnes enim bellando cepit.
text_pt: Não houve cidade que fizesse paz com os filhos de Israel, senão os heveus, moradores de Gibeom; por guerra as tomaram todas.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἦν πόλις ἣν οὐκ ἔλαβεν Ισραηλ πάντα ἐλάβοσαν ἐν πολέμῳ

text_en: For it was the sentence of the Lord , that their hearts should be hardened, and they should fight against Israel , and fall, and should not deserve any clemency, and should be destroyed as the Lord had commanded Moses .
text_la: Domini enim sententia fuerat, ut indurarentur corda eorum, et pugnarent contra Israël, et caderent, et non mererentur ullam clementiam, ac perirent, sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi.
text_pt: Porquanto do Senhor vinha o endurecimento de seus corações, para saírem à guerra contra Israel, para que fossem totalmente destruídos e não achassem piedade alguma; mas para os destruir a todos como o Senhor tinha ordenado a Moisés.
text_el: ὅτι διὰ κυρίου ἐγένετο κατισχῦσαι αὐτῶν τὴν καρδίαν συναντᾶν εἰς πόλεμον πρὸς Ισραηλ ἵνα ἐξολεθρευθῶσιν ὅπως μὴ δοθῇ αὐτοῖς ἔλεος ἀλλ' ἵνα ἐξολεθρευθῶσιν ὃν τρόπον εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν

text_en: At that time Joshua came and cut off the Enacims from the mountains, from Hebron , and Dabir, and Anab, and from all the mountain of Juda and Israel , and destroyed their cities.
text_la: In illo tempore venit Josue, et interfecit Enacim de montanis, Hebron, et Dabir, et Anab, et de omni monte Juda et Israël, urbesque eorum delevit.
text_pt: Naquele tempo veio Josué, e extirpou os anaquins das montanhas de Hebrom, de Debir, de Anabe e de todas as montanhas de Judá e de todas as montanhas de Israel; Josué os destruiu totalmente com as suas cidades.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσεν τοὺς Ενακιμ ἐκ τῆς ὀρεινῆς ἐκ Χεβρων καὶ ἐκ Δαβιρ καὶ ἐξ Αναβωθ καὶ ἐκ παντὸς γένους Ισραηλ καὶ ἐκ παντὸς ὄρους Ιουδα σὺν ταῖς πόλεσιν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσεν αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς

text_en: He left not any of the stock of the Enacims, in the land of the children of Israel : except the cities of Gaza , and Geth, and Azotus , in which alone they were left.
text_la: Non reliquit ullum de stirpe Enacim, in terra filiorum Israël : absque civitatibus Gaza, et Geth, et Azoto, in quibus solis relicti sunt.
text_pt: Nenhum dos anaquins foi deixado na terra dos filhos de Israel; somente ficaram alguns em Gaza, em Gate, e em Asdode.
text_el: οὐ κατελείφθη τῶν Ενακιμ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἀλλὰ πλὴν ἐν Γάζῃ καὶ ἐν Γεθ καὶ ἐν Ασεδωθ κατελείφθη

text_en: So Joshua took all the land, as the Lord spoke to Moses , and delivered it in possession to the children of Israel , according to their divisions and tribes . And the land rested from wars .
text_la: Cepit ergo Josue omnem terram, sicut locutus est Dominus ad Moysen, et tradidit eam in possessionem filiis Israël secundum partes et tribus suas : quievitque terra a præliis.
text_pt: Assim Josué tomou toda esta terra, conforme a tudo o que o Senhor tinha dito a Moisés; e Josué a deu em herança aos filhos de Israel, conforme as suas divisões, segundo as suas tribos; e a terra descansou da guerra.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ἰησοῦς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν καθότι ἐνετείλατο κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς ἐν κληρονομίᾳ Ισραηλ ἐν μερισμῷ κατὰ φυλὰς αὐτῶν καὶ ἡ γῆ κατέπαυσεν πολεμουμένη

text_en: These are the kings, whom the children of Israel slew and possessed their land beyond the Jordan towards the rising of the sun, from the torrent Arnon unto mount Hermon , and all the east country that looks towards the wilderness .
text_la: Hi sunt reges, quos percusserunt filii Israël, et possederunt terram eorum trans Jordanem ad solis ortum, a torrente Arnon usque ad montem Hermon, et omnem orientalem plagam, quæ respicit solitudinem.
text_pt: Estes, pois, são os reis da terra, aos quais os filhos de Israel feriram e cujas terras possuíram além do Jordão para o nascente do sol, desde o ribeiro de Arnom, até ao monte de Hermom, e toda a planície do oriente:
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς οὓς ἀνεῖλον οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ κατεκληρονόμησαν τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἀφ' ἡλίου ἀνατολῶν ἀπὸ φάραγγος Αρνων ἕως τοῦ ὄρους Αερμων καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Αραβα ἀπ' ἀνατολῶν

text_en: Sehon king of the Amorrhites , who dwelt in Hesebon , and had dominion from Aroer, which is seated upon the bank of the torrent Arnon, and of the middle part in the valley, and of half Galaad, as far as the torrent Jaboc, which is the border of the children of Ammon .
text_la: Sehon rex Amorrhæorum, qui habitavit in Hesebon, dominatus est ab Aroër, quæ sita est super ripam torrentis Arnon, et mediæ partis in valle, dimidiæque Galaad, usque ad torrentem Jaboc, qui est terminus filiorum Ammon.
text_pt: Siom, rei dos amorreus, que habitava em Hesbom e que dominava desde Aroer, que está à beira do ribeiro de Arnom, e desde o meio do ribeiro, e a metade de Gileade, e até ao ribeiro de Jaboque, o termo dos filhos de Amom.
text_el: Σηων τὸν βασιλέα τῶν Αμορραίων ὃς κατῴκει ἐν Εσεβων κυριεύων ἀπὸ Αροηρ ἥ ἐστιν ἐν τῇ φάραγγι κατὰ μέρος τῆς φάραγγος καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ τῆς Γαλααδ ἕως Ιαβοκ ὅρια υἱῶν Αμμων

text_en: And from the wilderness , to the sea of Ceneroth towards the east, and to the sea of the wilderness , which is the most salt sea , on the east side by the way that leads to Bethsimoth: and on the south side that lies under Asedoth, Phasga .
text_la: Et a solitudine usque ad mare Ceneroth contra orientem, et usque ad mare deserti, quod est mare salsissimum, ad orientalem plagam per viam quæ ducit Bethsimoth : et ab australi parte, quæ subjacet Asedoth, Phasga.
text_pt: E desde a campina até ao mar de Quinerete para o oriente, e até ao mar da campina, o Mar Salgado para o oriente, pelo caminho de Bete-Jesimote; e desde o sul, abaixo de Asdote-Pisga.
text_el: καὶ Αραβα ἕως τῆς θαλάσσης Χενερεθ κατ' ἀνατολὰς καὶ ἕως τῆς θαλάσσης Αραβα θάλασσαν τῶν ἁλῶν ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν ὁδὸν τὴν κατὰ Ασιμωθ ἀπὸ Θαιμαν τὴν ὑπὸ Ασηδωθ Φασγα

text_en: The border of Og the king of Basan, of the remnant of the Raphaims who dwelt in Astaroth, and in Edrai, and had dominion in mount Hermon , and in Salecha, and in all Basan, unto the borders
text_la: Terminus Og regis Basan, de reliquiis Raphaim, qui habitavit in Astaroth, et in Edrai, et dominatus est in monte Hermon, et in Salecha, atque in universa Basan, usque ad terminos
text_pt: Como também o termo de Ogue, rei de Basã que era do restante dos gigantes e que habitava em Astarote e em Edrei;
text_el: καὶ Ωγ βασιλεὺς Βασαν ὑπελείφθη ἐκ τῶν γιγάντων ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν Ασταρωθ καὶ ἐν Εδραϊν

text_en: of Gessuri and Machati, and of half Galaad: the borders of Sehon the king of Hesebon .
text_la: Gessuri, et Machati, et dimidiæ partis Galaad : terminos Sehon regis Hesebon.
text_pt: E dominava no monte Hermom, e em Salcá, e em toda a Basã, até ao termo dos gesureus e dos maacateus, e metade de Gileade, termo de Siom, rei de Hesbom.
text_el: ἄρχων ἀπὸ ὄρους Αερμων καὶ ἀπὸ Σελχα καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν Βασαν ἕως ὁρίων Γεσουρι καὶ τὴν Μαχατι καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ Γαλααδ ὁρίων Σηων βασιλέως Εσεβων

text_en: Moses the servant of the Lord , and the children of Israel slew them, and Moses delivered their land in possession to the Rubenites , and Gadites , and the half tribe of Manasses .
text_la: Moyses famulus Domini et filii Israël percusserunt eos, tradiditque terram eorum Moyses in possessionem Rubenitis, et Gaditis, et dimidiæ tribui Manasse.
text_pt: A estes Moisés, servo do Senhor, e os filhos de Israel, feriram; e Moisés, servo do Senhor, deu esta terra em possessão aos rubenitas, e aos gaditas, e à meia tribo de Manassés.
text_el: Μωυσῆς ὁ παῖς κυρίου καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐπάταξαν αὐτούς καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὴν Μωυσῆς ἐν κληρονομίᾳ Ρουβην καὶ Γαδ καὶ τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς Μανασση

text_en: These are the kings of the land, whom Joshua and the children of Israel slew beyond the Jordan on the west side from Baalgad in the field of Libanus, unto the mount , part of which goes up into Seir: and Joshua delivered it in possession to the tribes of Israel , to every one their divisions,
text_la: Hi sunt reges terræ, quos percussit Josue et filii Israël trans Jordanem ad occidentalem plagam, a Baalgad in campo Libani, usque ad montem cujus pars ascendit in Seir : tradiditque eam Josue in possessionem tribubus Israël, singulis partes suas,
text_pt: E estes são os reis da terra aos quais Josué e os filhos de Israel feriram aquém do Jordão para o ocidente, desde Baal-Gade, no vale do Líbano, até ao monte Halaque, que sobe a Seir; e Josué a deu às tribos de Israel em possessão, segundo as suas divisões.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ βασιλεῖς τῶν Αμορραίων οὓς ἀνεῖλεν Ἰησοῦς καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου παρὰ θάλασσαν Βααλγαδ ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ τοῦ Λιβάνου καὶ ἕως τοῦ ὄρους Χελχα ἀναβαινόντων εἰς Σηιρ καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὴν Ἰησοῦς ταῖς φυλαῖς Ισραηλ κληρονομεῖν κατὰ κλῆρον αὐτῶν

text_en: as well in the mountains as in the plains and the champaign countries. In Asedoth, and in the wilderness , and in the south was the Hethite and the Amorrhite , the Chanaanite and the Pherezite, the Hevite and the Jebusite.
text_la: tam in montanis quam in planis atque campestribus. In Asedoth, et in solitudine, ac in meridie, Hethæus fuit et Amorrhæus, Chananæus, et Pherezæus, Hevæus et Jebusæus.
text_pt: O que havia nas montanhas, e nas planícies, e nas campinas, e nas descidas das águas, e no deserto, e para o sul: o heteu, o amorreu, e o cananeu, o perizeu, o heveu, e o jebuseu.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ὄρει καὶ ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ καὶ ἐν Αραβα καὶ ἐν Ασηδωθ καὶ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ ἐν Ναγεβ τὸν Χετταῖον καὶ τὸν Αμορραῖον καὶ τὸν Χαναναῖον καὶ τὸν Φερεζαῖον καὶ τὸν Ευαῖον καὶ τὸν Ιεβουσαῖον

text_en: The king of Jericho one: the king of Hai, which is on the side of Bethel , one:
text_la: Rex Jericho unus : rex Hai, quæ est ex latere Bethel, unus:
text_pt: O rei de Jericó, um; o rei de Ai, que está ao lado de Betel, outro;
text_el: τὸν βασιλέα Ιεριχω καὶ τὸν βασιλέα τῆς Γαι ἥ ἐστιν πλησίον Βαιθηλ

text_en: The king of Jerusalem one, the king of Hebron one,
text_la: rex Jerusalem unus, rex Hebron unus,
text_pt: O rei de Jerusalém, outro; o rei de Hebrom, outro;
text_el: βασιλέα Ιερουσαλημ βασιλέα Χεβρων

text_en: the king of Jerimoth one, you king of Lachis one,
text_la: rex Jerimoth unus, rex Lachis unus,
text_pt: O rei de Jarmute, outro; o rei de Laquis, outro;
text_el: βασιλέα Ιεριμουθ βασιλέα Λαχις

text_en: the king of Eglon one, the king of Gazer one,
text_la: rex Eglon unus, rex Gazer unus,
text_pt: O rei de Eglom, outro; o rei de Geser, outro;
text_el: βασιλέα Αιλαμ βασιλέα Γαζερ

text_en: the king of Dabir one, the king of Gader one,
text_la: rex Dabir unus, rex Gader unus,
text_pt: O rei de Debir, outro; o rei de Geder, outro;
text_el: βασιλέα Δαβιρ βασιλέα Γαδερ

text_en: the king of Herma one, the king of Hered one,
text_la: rex Herma unus, rex Hered unus,
text_pt: O rei de Hormá, outro; o rei de Harade, outro;
text_el: βασιλέα Ερμαθ βασιλέα Αραθ

text_en: the king of Lebna one, the king of Odullam one,
text_la: rex Lebna unus, rex Odullam unus,
text_pt: O rei de Libna, outro; o rei de Adulão, outro;
text_el: βασιλέα Λεβνα βασιλέα Οδολλαμ

text_en: the king of Maceda one, the king of Bethel one,
text_la: rex Maceda unus, rex Bethel unus,
text_pt: O rei de Maquedá, outro; o rei de Betel, outro;
text_el: βασιλέα Μακηδα

text_en: the king of Taphua one, the king of Opher one,
text_la: rex Taphua unus, rex Opher unus,
text_pt: O rei de Tapua, outro; o rei de Hefer, outro;
text_el: βασιλέα Ταφουγ βασιλέα Οφερ

text_en: the king of Aphec one, the king of Saron one,
text_la: rex Aphec unus, rex Saron unus,
text_pt: O rei de Afeque, outro; o rei de Lassarom, outro;
text_el: βασιλέα Αφεκ τῆς Σαρων

text_en: the king of Madon one, the king of Asor one,
text_la: rex Madon unus, rex Asor unus,
text_pt: O rei de Madom, outro; o rei de Hazor, outro;
text_el: βασιλέα Ασωρ

text_en: the king of Semeron one, the king of Achsaph one,
text_la: rex Semeron unus, rex Achsaph unus,
text_pt: O rei de Sinrom-Meron, outro; o rei de Acsafe, outro;
text_el: βασιλέα Συμοων βασιλέα Μαρρων βασιλέα Αζιφ

text_en: the king of Thenac one, the king of Mageddo one,
text_la: rex Thenac unus, rex Mageddo unus,
text_pt: O rei de Taanaque, outro; o rei de Megido, outro;
text_el: βασιλέα Καδης βασιλέα Ταναχ

text_en: the king of Cades one, the king of Jachanan of Carmel one,
text_la: rex Cades unus, rex Jachanan Carmeli unus,
text_pt: O rei de Quedes, outro; o rei de Jocneão do Carmelo, outro;
text_el: βασιλέα Μαγεδων βασιλέα Ιεκοναμ τοῦ Χερμελ

text_en: the king of Dor, and of the province of Dor one, the king of the nations of Galgal one,
text_la: rex Dor et provinciæ Dor unus, rex gentium Galgal unus,
text_pt: O rei de Dor no outeiro de Dor, outro; o rei de Goim em Gilgal, outro;
text_el: βασιλέα Δωρ τοῦ Ναφεδδωρ βασιλέα Γωιμ τῆς Γαλιλαίας

text_en: the king of Thersa one: all the kings thirty and one.
text_la: rex Thersa unus : omnes reges triginta unus.
text_pt: O rei de Tirza, outro; trinta e um reis ao todo.
text_el: βασιλέα Θαρσα πάντες οὗτοι βασιλεῖς εἴκοσι ἐννέα

text_en: Joshua was old, and far advanced in years, and the Lord said to him: You are grown old, and advanced in age, and there is a very large country left, which is not yet divided by lot:
text_la: Josue senex provectæque ætatis erat, et dixit Dominus ad eum : Senuisti, et longævus es, terraque latissima derelicta est, quæ necdum sorte divisa est:
text_pt: Era, porém, Josué já velho, entrado em dias; e disse-lhe o SENHOR: Já estás velho, entrado em dias; e ainda muitíssima terra ficou para possuir.
text_el: καὶ Ἰησοῦς πρεσβύτερος προβεβηκὼς τῶν ἡμερῶν καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Ἰησοῦν σὺ προβέβηκας τῶν ἡμερῶν καὶ ἡ γῆ ὑπολέλειπται πολλὴ εἰς κληρονομίαν

text_en: To wit, all Galilee , Philistia , and all Gessuri.
text_la: omnis videlicet Galilæa, Philisthiim, et universa Gessuri.
text_pt: A terra que ainda fica é esta: Todos os termos dos filisteus e toda a Gesur;
text_el: καὶ αὕτη ἡ γῆ ἡ καταλελειμμένη ὅρια Φυλιστιιμ ὁ Γεσιρι καὶ ὁ Χαναναῖος

text_en: From the troubled river, that waters Egypt , unto the border of Accaron northward: the land of Chanaan , which is divided among the lords of the Philistines , the Gazites , the Azotians , the Ascalonites , the Gethites, and the Accronites .
text_la: A fluvio turbido, qui irrigat Ægyptum, usque ad terminos Accaron contra aquilonem : terra Chanaan, quæ in quinque regulos Philisthiim dividitur, Gazæos, et Azotios, Ascalonitas, Gethæos, et Accaronitas.
text_pt: Desde Sior, que está em frente ao Egito, até ao termo de Ecrom para o norte, que se diz ser dos cananeus; cinco príncipes dos filisteus; o gazeu, e o asdodeu, o asqueloneu, o giteu, e o ecroneu, e os aveus;
text_el: ἀπὸ τῆς ἀοικήτου τῆς κατὰ πρόσωπον Αἰγύπτου ἕως τῶν ὁρίων Ακκαρων ἐξ εὐωνύμων τῶν Χαναναίων προσλογίζεται ταῖς πέντε σατραπείαις τῶν Φυλιστιιμ τῷ Γαζαίῳ καὶ τῷ Ἀζωτίῳ καὶ τῷ Ἀσκαλωνίτῃ καὶ τῷ Γεθθαίῳ καὶ τῷ Ακκαρωνίτῃ καὶ τῷ Ευαίῳ

text_en: And on the south side are the Hevites, all the land of Chanaan , and Maara of the Sidonians as far as Apheca, and the borders of the Amorrhite ,
text_la: Ad meridiem vero sunt Hevæi, omnis terra Chanaan, et Maara Sidoniorum, usque Apheca et terminos Amorrhæi,
text_pt: Desde o sul, toda a terra dos cananeus, e Meara, que é dos sidônios; até Afeca, até ao termo dos amorreus;
text_el: ἐκ Θαιμαν καὶ πάσῃ γῇ Χανααν ἐναντίον Γάζης καὶ οἱ Σιδώνιοι ἕως Αφεκ ἕως τῶν ὁρίων τῶν Αμορραίων

text_en: and his confines. The country also of Libanus towards the east from Baalgad under mount Hermon to the entering into Emath.
text_la: ejusque confinia. Libani quoque regio contra orientem, a Baalgad sub monte Hermon, donec ingrediaris Emath;
text_pt: Como também a terra dos gebalitas, e todo o Líbano, para o nascente do sol, desde Baal-Gade, ao pé do monte Hermom, até a entrada de Hamate;
text_el: καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Γαβλι Φυλιστιιμ καὶ πάντα τὸν Λίβανον ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν ἡλίου ἀπὸ Γαλγαλ ὑπὸ τὸ ὄρος τὸ Αερμων ἕως τῆς εἰσόδου Εμαθ

text_en: Of all that dwell in the mountains from Libanus, to the waters of Maserephoth, and all the Sidonians . I am he that will cut them off from before the face of the children of Israel . So let their land come in as a part of the inheritance of Israel , as I have commanded you.
text_la: omnium qui habitant in monte a Libano usque ad aquas Maserephoth, universique Sidonii. Ego sum qui delebo eos a facie filiorum Israël. Veniat ergo in partem hæreditatis Israël, sicut præcepi tibi.
text_pt: Todos os que habitam nas montanhas desde o Líbano até Misrefote-Maim, todos os sidônios; eu os lançarei de diante dos filhos de Israel; tão-somente reparte a terra em herança a Israel, como já te mandei.
text_el: πᾶς ὁ κατοικῶν τὴν ὀρεινὴν ἀπὸ τοῦ Λιβάνου ἕως τῆς Μασερεφωθμαιμ πάντας τοὺς Σιδωνίους ἐγὼ αὐτοὺς ἐξολεθρεύσω ἀπὸ προσώπου Ισραηλ ἀλλὰ διάδος αὐτὴν ἐν κλήρῳ τῷ Ισραηλ ὃν τρόπον σοι ἐνετειλάμην

text_en: And now divide the land in possession to the nine tribes , and to the half tribe of Manasses ,
text_la: Et nunc divide terram in possessionem novem tribubus, et dimidiæ tribui Manasse,
text_pt: Reparte, pois, agora esta terra por herança às nove tribos, e à meia tribo de Manassés,
text_el: καὶ νῦν μέρισον τὴν γῆν ταύτην ἐν κληρονομίᾳ ταῖς ἐννέα φυλαῖς καὶ τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς Μανασση ἀπὸ τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἕως τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς μεγάλης κατὰ δυσμὰς ἡλίου δώσεις αὐτήν ἡ θάλασσα ἡ μεγάλη ὁριεῖ

text_en: with whom Ruben and Gad have possessed the land, which Moses the servant of the Lord delivered to them beyond the river Jordan , on the east side.
text_la: cum qua Ruben et Gad possederunt terram, quam tradidit eis Moyses famulus Domini trans fluenta Jordanis, ad orientalem plagam.
text_pt: Com a qual os rubenitas e os gaditas já receberam a sua herança, além do Jordão para o oriente, assim como já lhes tinha dado Moisés, servo do Senhor.
text_el: ταῖς δὲ δύο φυλαῖς καὶ τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς Μανασση τῷ Ρουβην καὶ τῷ Γαδ ἔδωκεν Μωυσῆς ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου κατ' ἀνατολὰς ἡλίου δέδωκεν αὐτὴν Μωυσῆς ὁ παῖς κυρίου

text_en: From Aroer, which is upon the bank of the torrent Arnon, and in the midst of the valley and all the plains of Medaba, as far as Dibon :
text_la: Ab Aroër, quæ sita est in ripa torrentis Arnon, et in vallis medio, universaque campestria Medaba, usque Dibon,
text_pt: Desde Aroer, que está à beira do ribeiro de Arnom, e a cidade que está no meio do vale, e toda a campina de Medeba até Dibom;
text_el: ἀπὸ Αροηρ ἥ ἐστιν ἐπὶ τοῦ χείλους χειμάρρου Αρνων καὶ τὴν πόλιν τὴν ἐν μέσῳ τῆς φάραγγος καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν Μισωρ ἀπὸ Μαιδαβα ἕως Δαιβαν

text_en: And all the cities of Sehon, king of the Amorrhites , who reigned in Hesebon , unto the borders of the children of Ammon .
text_la: et cunctas civitates Sehon regis Amorrhæi, qui regnavit in Hesebon, usque ad terminos filiorum Ammon,
text_pt: E todas as cidades de Siom, rei dos amorreus, que reinou em Hesbom, até ao termo dos filhos de Amom;
text_el: πάσας τὰς πόλεις Σηων βασιλέως Αμορραίων ὃς ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Εσεβων ἕως τῶν ὁρίων υἱῶν Αμμων

text_en: And Galaad, and the borders of Gessuri and Machati, and all mount Hermon , and all Basan as far as Salecha,
text_la: et Galaad, ac terminum Gessuri et Machati, et omnem montem Hermon, et universam Basan, usque ad Salecha,
text_pt: E Gileade, e o termo dos gesureus, e dos maacateus, e todo o monte Hermom, e toda a Basã até Salcá;
text_el: καὶ τὴν Γαλααδίτιδα καὶ τὰ ὅρια Γεσιρι καὶ τοῦ Μαχατι πᾶν ὄρος Αερμων καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν Βασανῖτιν ἕως Σελχα

text_en: all the kingdom of Og in Basan, who reigned in Astaroth and Edrai, he was of the remains of the Raphaims: and Moses overthrew and destroyed them.
text_la: omne regnum Og in Basan, qui regnavit in Astaroth et Edrai, ipse fuit de reliquiis Raphaim : percussitque eos Moyses, atque delevit.
text_pt: Todo o reino de Ogue em Basã, que reinou em Astarote e em Edrei; este ficou do restante dos gigantes que Moisés feriu e expulsou.
text_el: πᾶσαν τὴν βασιλείαν Ωγ ἐν τῇ Βασανίτιδι ὃς ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ασταρωθ καὶ ἐν Εδραϊν οὗτος κατελείφθη ἀπὸ τῶν γιγάντων καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν Μωυσῆς καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσεν

text_en: And the children of Israel would not destroy Gessuri and Machati and they have dwelt in the midst of Israel , until this present day.
text_la: Nolueruntque disperdere filii Israël Gessuri et Machati : et habitaverunt in medio Israël usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: Porém os filhos de Israel não expulsaram os gesureus, nem os maacateus; antes Gesur e Maacate ficaram habitando no meio de Israel até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐξωλέθρευσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τὸν Γεσιρι καὶ τὸν Μαχατι καὶ τὸν Χαναναῖον καὶ κατῴκει βασιλεὺς Γεσιρι καὶ ὁ Μαχατι ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας

text_en: But to the tribe of Levi he gave no possession: but the sacrifices and victims of you Lord God of Israel , are his inheritance, as he spoke to him.
text_la: Tribui autem Levi non dedit possessionem : sed sacrificia et victimæ Domini Dei Israël, ipsa est ejus hæreditas, sicut locutus est illi.
text_pt: Tão-somente à tribo de Levi não deu herança; os sacrifícios queimados do Senhor Deus de Israel são a sua herança, como já lhe tinha falado.
text_el: πλὴν τῆς φυλῆς Λευι οὐκ ἐδόθη κληρονομία κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ οὗτος αὐτῶν κληρονομία καθὰ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς κύριος καὶ οὗτος ὁ καταμερισμός ὃν κατεμέρισεν Μωυσῆς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἐν Αραβωθ Μωαβ ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου κατὰ Ιεριχω

text_en: And Moses gave a possession to the children of Ruben according to their kindreds.
text_la: Dedit ergo Moyses possessionem tribui filiorum Ruben juxta cognationes suas.
text_pt: Assim Moisés deu à tribo dos filhos de Rúben, conforme as suas famílias.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν Μωυσῆς τῇ φυλῇ Ρουβην κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν

text_en: And their border was from Aroer, which is on the bank of the torrent Arnon, and in the midst of the valley of the same torrent: all the plain, that leads to Medaba,
text_la: Fuitque terminus eorum ab Aroër, quæ sita est in ripa torrentis Arnon, et in valle ejusdem torrentis media : universam planitiem, quæ ducit Medaba,
text_pt: E foi o seu limite desde Aroer, que está à beira do ribeiro de Arnom, e a cidade que está no meio do vale, e toda a campina até Medeba;
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη αὐτῶν τὰ ὅρια ἀπὸ Αροηρ ἥ ἐστιν κατὰ πρόσωπον φάραγγος Αρνων καὶ ἡ πόλις ἡ ἐν τῇ φάραγγι Αρνων καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν Μισωρ

text_en: and Hesebon , and all their villages , which are in the plains. Dibon also, and Bamothbaal, and the town of Baalmaon,
text_la: et Hesebon, cunctosque viculos earum, qui sunt in campestribus : Dibon quoque et Bamothbaal, et oppidum Baalmaon,
text_pt: Hesbom e todas as suas cidades, que estão na campina; Dibom, e Bamote-Baal, e Bete-Baal-Meom;
text_el: ἕως Εσεβων καὶ πάσας τὰς πόλεις τὰς οὔσας ἐν τῇ Μισωρ καὶ Δαιβων καὶ Βαμωθβααλ καὶ οἴκου Βεελμων

text_en: and Jassa, and Cidimoth, and Mephaath,
text_la: et Jassa, et Cedimoth, et Mephaath,
text_pt: E Jasa e Quedemote, e Mefaate;
text_el: καὶ Ιασσα καὶ Κεδημωθ καὶ Μεφααθ

text_en: and Cariathaim, and Sabama, and Sarathasar in the mountain of the valley.
text_la: et Cariathaim, et Sabama, et Sarathasar in monte convallis.
text_pt: E Quiriataim e Sibma, e Zerete-Saar, no monte do vale;
text_el: καὶ Καριαθαιμ καὶ Σεβαμα καὶ Σεραδα καὶ Σιωρ ἐν τῷ ὄρει Εμακ

text_en: Bethphogor and Asedoth, Phasga and Bethiesimoth,
text_la: Bethphogor et Asedoth, Phasga et Bethiesimoth,
text_pt: Bete-Peor, e Asdote-Pisga, Bete-Jesimote;
text_el: καὶ Βαιθφογωρ καὶ Ασηδωθ Φασγα καὶ Βαιθασιμωθ

text_en: and all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdoms of Sehon king of the Amorrhites , that reigned in Hesebon , whom Moses slew with the princes of Madian : Hevi, and Recem, and Sur and Hur, and Rebe, dukes of Sehon inhabitants of the land.
text_la: et omnes urbes campestres, universaque regna Sehon regis Amorrhæi, qui regnavit in Hesebon, quem percussit Moyses cum principibus Madian : Hevæum, et Recem, et Sur, et Hur, et Rebe duces Sehon habitatores terræ.
text_pt: E todas as cidades da campina, e todo o reino de Siom, rei dos amorreus, que reinou em Hesbom, a quem Moisés feriu, como também aos príncipes de Midiã, Evi, e Requém, e Zur, e Hur, e Reba, príncipes de Siom, moradores da terra.
text_el: καὶ πάσας τὰς πόλεις τοῦ Μισωρ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Σηων βασιλέως τῶν Αμορραίων ὃν ἐπάταξεν Μωυσῆς αὐτὸν καὶ τοὺς ἡγουμένους Μαδιαμ καὶ τὸν Ευι καὶ τὸν Ροκομ καὶ τὸν Σουρ καὶ τὸν Ουρ καὶ τὸν Ροβε ἄρχοντας παρὰ Σηων καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν γῆν

text_en: Balaam also the son of Beor the soothsayer , the children of Israel slew with the sword among the rest that were slain.
text_la: Et Balaam filium Beor ariolum occiderunt filii Israël gladio cum ceteris interfectis.
text_pt: Também os filhos de Israel mataram à espada a Balaão, filho de Beor, o adivinho, com os outros que por eles foram mortos.
text_el: καὶ τὸν Βαλααμ τὸν τοῦ Βεωρ τὸν μάντιν ἀπέκτειναν ἐν τῇ ῥοπῇ

text_en: And the river Jordan was the border of the children of Ruben . This is the possession of the Rubenites , by their kindreds, of cities and villages .
text_la: Factusque est terminus filiorum Ruben Jordanis fluvius. Hæc est possessio Rubenitarum per cognationes suas urbium et viculorum.
text_pt: E o termo dos filhos de Rúben ficou sendo o Jordão e os seus limites; esta foi a herança dos filhos de Rúben, segundo as suas famílias, as cidades, e as suas aldeias.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ τὰ ὅρια Ρουβην Ιορδάνης ὅριον αὕτη ἡ κληρονομία υἱῶν Ρουβην κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν αἱ πόλεις αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν

text_en: And Moses gave to the tribe of Gad and to his children by their kindreds a possession, of which this is the division.
text_la: Deditque Moyses tribui Gad et filiis ejus per cognationes suas possessionem, cujus hæc divisio est.
text_pt: E deu Moisés à tribo de Gade, aos filhos de Gade, segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: ἔδωκεν δὲ Μωυσῆς τοῖς υἱοῖς Γαδ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν

text_en: The border of Jaser, and all the cities of Galaad, and half the land of the children of Ammon : as far as Aroer which is over against Rabba:
text_la: Terminus Jaser, et omnes civitates Galaad, et dimidiam partem terræ filiorum Ammon, usque ad Aroër, quæ est contra Rabba,
text_pt: E foi o seu termo Jazer, e todas as cidades de Gileade, e metade da terra dos filhos de Amom, até Aroer, que está em frente de Rabá.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο τὰ ὅρια αὐτῶν Ιαζηρ πᾶσαι αἱ πόλεις Γαλααδ καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ γῆς υἱῶν Αμμων ἕως Αροηρ ἥ ἐστιν κατὰ πρόσωπον Ραββα

text_en: And from Hesebon unto Ramoth, Masphe and Betonim: and from Manaim unto the borders of Dabir.
text_la: et ab Hesebon usque Ramoth, Masphe et Betonim : et a Manaim usque ad terminos Dabir.
text_pt: E desde Hesbom até Ramate-Mizpá e Betonim, e desde Maanaim até ao termo de Debir;
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ Εσεβων ἕως Ραμωθ κατὰ τὴν Μασσηφα καὶ Βοτανιν καὶ Μααναιν ἕως τῶν ὁρίων Δαβιρ

text_en: And in the valley Betharan and Bethnemra, and Socoth, and Saphon the other part of the kingdom of Sehon king of Hesebon : the limit of this also is the Jordan , as far as the uttermost part of the sea of Cenereth beyond the Jordan on the east side,
text_la: In valle quoque Betharan, et Bethnemra, et Socoth, et Saphon reliquam partem regni Sehon regis Hesebon : hujus quoque finis, Jordanis est, usque ad extremam partem maris Cenereth trans Jordanem ad orientalem plagam.
text_pt: E no vale Bete-Arã, e Bete-Nimra, e Sucote, Zafom, que ficara do restante do reino de Siom, em Hesbom, o Jordão e o seu termo, até a extremidade do mar de Quinerete além do Jordão para o oriente.
text_el: καὶ ἐν Εμεκ Βαιθαραμ καὶ Βαιθαναβρα καὶ Σοκχωθα καὶ Σαφαν καὶ τὴν λοιπὴν βασιλείαν Σηων βασιλέως Εσεβων καὶ ὁ Ιορδάνης ὁριεῖ ἕως μέρους τῆς θαλάσσης Χενερεθ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἀπ' ἀνατολῶν

text_en: this is the possession of the children of Gad by their families , their cities, and villages .
text_la: Hæc est possessio filiorum Gad per familias suas, civitates et villæ earum.
text_pt: Esta é a herança dos filhos de Gade segundo as suas famílias, as cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ κληρονομία υἱῶν Γαδ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν αἱ πόλεις αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν

text_en: He gave also to the half tribe of Manasses and his children possession according to their kindreds,
text_la: Dedit et dimidiæ tribui Manasse, filiisque ejus juxta cognationes suas, possessionem,
text_pt: Deu também Moisés herança à meia tribo de Manassés; e deu à meia tribo dos filhos de Manassés, segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν Μωυσῆς τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς Μανασση κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν

text_en: the beginning whereof is this: from Manaim all Basan, and all the kingdoms of Og king of Basan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Basan, threescore towns.
text_la: cujus hoc principium est : a Manaim universam Basan, et cuncta regna Og regis Basan, omnesque vicos Jair, qui sunt in Basan, sexaginta oppida:
text_pt: De maneira que o seu termo foi desde Maanaim, todo o Basã, todo o reino de Ogue, rei de Basã, e todas as aldeias de Jair, que estão em Basã, sessenta cidades,
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο τὰ ὅρια αὐτῶν ἀπὸ Μααναιμ καὶ πᾶσα βασιλεία Βασανι καὶ πᾶσα βασιλεία Ωγ βασιλέως Βασαν καὶ πάσας τὰς κώμας Ιαϊρ αἵ εἰσιν ἐν τῇ Βασανίτιδι ἑξήκοντα πόλεις

text_en: And half Galaad, and Astaroth, and Edrai, cities of the kingdom of Og in Basan: to the children of Machir, the son of Manasses , to one half of the children of Machir according to their kindreds.
text_la: et dimidiam partem Galaad, et Astaroth, et Edrai, urbes regni Og in Basan : filiis Machir, filii Manasse, dimidiæ parti filiorum Machir juxta cognationes suas.
text_pt: E metade de Gileade, e Astarote, e Edrei, cidades do reino de Ogue em Basã, deu aos filhos de Maquir, filho de Manassés, a saber, à metade dos filhos de Maquir, segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ τῆς Γαλααδ καὶ ἐν Ασταρωθ καὶ ἐν Εδραϊν πόλεις βασιλείας Ωγ ἐν Βασανίτιδι καὶ ἐδόθησαν τοῖς υἱοῖς Μαχιρ υἱοῦ Μανασση καὶ τοῖς ἡμίσεσιν υἱοῖς Μαχιρ υἱοῦ Μανασση κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν

text_en: This possession Moses divided in the plains of Moab , beyond the Jordan , over against Jericho on the east side,
text_la: Hanc possessionem divisit Moyses in campestribus Moab trans Jordanem contra Jericho ad orientalem plagam.
text_pt: Isto é o que Moisés repartiu em herança nas campinas de Moabe, além do Jordão para o oriente de Jericó.
text_el: οὗτοι οὓς κατεκληρονόμησεν Μωυσῆς πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἐν Αραβωθ Μωαβ ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου κατὰ Ιεριχω ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν

text_en: but to the tribe of Levi he gave no possession: because the Lord the God of Israel himself is their possession, as he spoke to them.
text_la: Tribui autem Levi non dedit possessionem : quoniam Dominus Deus Israël ipse est possessio ejus, ut locutus est illi.
text_pt: Porém, à tribo de Levi, Moisés não deu herança; o Senhor Deus de Israel é a sua herança, como já lhe tinha falado.

text_en: This is what the children of Israel possessed in the land of Chanaan , which Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the princes of the families by the tribes of Israel gave to them.
text_la: Hoc est quod possederunt filii Israël in terra Chanaan, quam dederunt eis Eleazar sacerdos, et Josue filius Nun, et principes familiarum per tribus Israël:
text_pt: Isto, pois, é o que os filhos de Israel tiveram em herança, na terra de Canaã, o que Eleazar, o sacerdote, e Josué, filho de Num, e os cabeças dos pais das tribos dos filhos de Israel lhes fizeram repartir,
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ κατακληρονομήσαντες υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ γῇ Χανααν οἷς κατεκληρονόμησεν αὐτοῖς Ελεαζαρ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ τοῦ Ναυη καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες πατριῶν φυλῶν τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: Dividing all by lot, as the Lord had commanded the hand of Moses , to the nine tribes , and the half tribe .
text_la: sorte omnia dividentes, sicut præceperat Dominus in manu Moysi, novem tribubus, et dimidiæ tribui.
text_pt: Por sorte da sua herança, como o Senhor ordenara, pelo ministério de Moisés, acerca das nove tribos e da meia tribo.
text_el: κατὰ κλήρους ἐκληρονόμησαν ὃν τρόπον ἐνετείλατο κύριος ἐν χειρὶ Ἰησοῦ ταῖς ἐννέα φυλαῖς καὶ τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς

text_en: For to two tribes and a half Moses had given possession beyond the Jordan : besides the Levites , who received no land among their brethren:
text_la: Duabus enim tribubus, et dimidiæ, dederat Moyses trans Jordanem possessionem : absque Levitis, qui nihil terræ acceperunt inter fratres suos:
text_pt: Porquanto às duas tribos e à meia tribo já dera Moisés herança além do Jordão; mas aos levitas não tinha dado herança entre eles.
text_el: ἀπὸ τοῦ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ τοῖς Λευίταις οὐκ ἔδωκεν κλῆρον ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: But in their place succeeded the children of Joseph divided into two tribes , of Manasses and Ephraim: neither did the Levites receive other portion of land, but cities to dwell in, and their suburbs to feed their beasts and flocks.
text_la: sed in eorum successerunt locum filii Joseph in duas divisi tribus, Manasse et Ephraim : nec acceperunt Levitæ aliam in terra partem, nisi urbes ad habitandum, et suburbana earum ad alenda jumenta et pecora sua.
text_pt: Porque os filhos de José eram duas tribos, Manassés e Efraim, e aos levitas não se deu herança na terra, senão cidades em que habitassem, e os seus arrabaldes para seu gado e para seus bens.
text_el: ὅτι ἦσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ιωσηφ δύο φυλαί Μανασση καὶ Εφραιμ καὶ οὐκ ἐδόθη μερὶς ἐν τῇ γῇ τοῖς Λευίταις ἀλλ' ἢ πόλεις κατοικεῖν καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῶν τοῖς κτήνεσιν καὶ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν

text_en: As the Lord had commanded Moses so did the children of Israel , and they divided the land.
text_la: Sicut præceperat Dominus Moysi, ita fecerunt filii Israël, et diviserunt terram.
text_pt: Como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés, assim fizeram os filhos de Israel, e repartiram a terra.
text_el: ὃν τρόπον ἐνετείλατο κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ οὕτως ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐμέρισαν τὴν γῆν

text_en: Then the children of Juda came to Joshua in Galgal, and Caleb the son of Jephone the Cenezite spoke to him: You know what the Lord spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and you in Cadesbarne .
text_la: Accesserunt itaque filii Juda ad Josue in Galgala, locutusque est ad eum Caleb filius Jephone Cenezæus : Nosti quid locutus sit Dominus ad Moysen hominem Dei de me et te in Cadesbarne.
text_pt: Então os filhos de Judá chegaram a Josué em Gilgal; e Calebe, filho de Jefoné o quenezeu, lhe disse: Tu sabes o que o Senhor falou a Moisés, homem de Deus, em Cades-Barnéia por causa de mim e de ti.
text_el: καὶ προσήλθοσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ιουδα πρὸς Ἰησοῦν ἐν Γαλγαλ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Χαλεβ ὁ τοῦ Ιεφοννη ὁ Κενεζαῖος σὺ ἐπίστῃ τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἄνθρωπον τοῦ θεοῦ περὶ ἐμοῦ καὶ σοῦ ἐν Καδης Βαρνη

text_en: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me from Cadesbarne , to view the land, and I brought him word again as to me seemed true ,
text_la: Quadraginta annorum eram quando misit me Moyses famulus Domini de Cadesbarne, ut considerarem terram, nuntiavique ei quod mihi verum videbatur.
text_pt: Quarenta anos tinha eu, quando Moisés, servo do Senhor, me enviou de Cades-Barnéia a espiar a terra; e eu lhe trouxe resposta, como sentia no meu coração;
text_el: τεσσαράκοντα γὰρ ἐτῶν ἤμην ὅτε ἀπέστειλέν με Μωυσῆς ὁ παῖς τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκ Καδης Βαρνη κατασκοπεῦσαι τὴν γῆν καὶ ἀπεκρίθην αὐτῷ λόγον κατὰ τὸν νοῦν αὐτοῦ

text_en: but my brethren, that had gone up with me, discouraged the heart of the people: and I nevertheless followed the Lord my God .
text_la: Fratres autem mei, qui ascenderant mecum, dissolverunt cor populi : et nihilominus ego secutus sum Dominum Deum meum.
text_pt: Mas meus irmãos, que subiram comigo, fizeram derreter o coração do povo; eu porém perseverei em seguir ao Senhor meu Deus.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἀδελφοί μου οἱ ἀναβάντες μετ' ἐμοῦ μετέστησαν τὴν καρδίαν τοῦ λαοῦ ἐγὼ δὲ προσετέθην ἐπακολουθῆσαι κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ μου

text_en: And Moses swore in that day, saying: The land which your foot has trodden upon shall be your possession, and your children for ever, because you have followed the Lord my God .
text_la: Juravitque Moyses in die illo, dicens : Terra, quam calcavit pes tuus, erit possessio tua, et filiorum tuorum in æternum : quia secutus es Dominum Deum meum.
text_pt: Então Moisés naquele dia jurou, dizendo: Certamente a terra que pisou o teu pé será tua, e de teus filhos, em herança perpetuamente; pois perseveraste em seguir ao Senhor meu Deus.
text_el: καὶ ὤμοσεν Μωυσῆς ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ λέγων ἡ γῆ ἐφ' ἣν ἐπέβης σοὶ ἔσται ἐν κλήρῳ καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ὅτι προσετέθης ἐπακολουθῆσαι ὀπίσω κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: The Lord therefore has granted me life, as he promised until this present day, It is forty and five years since the Lord spoke this word to Moses , when Israel journeyed through the wilderness : this day I am eighty-five years old,
text_la: Concessit ergo Dominus vitam mihi, sicut pollicitus est, usque in præsentem diem. Quadraginta et quinque anni sunt, ex quo locutus est Dominus verbum istud ad Moysen, quando ambulabat Israël per solitudinem : hodie octoginta quinque annorum sum,
text_pt: E agora eis que o Senhor me conservou em vida, como disse; quarenta e cinco anos são passados, desde que o Senhor falou esta palavra a Moisés, andando Israel ainda no deserto; e agora eis que hoje tenho já oitenta e cinco anos;
text_el: καὶ νῦν διέθρεψέν με κύριος ὃν τρόπον εἶπεν τοῦτο τεσσαρακοστὸν καὶ πέμπτον ἔτος ἀφ' οὗ ἐλάλησεν κύριος τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ ἐπορεύθη Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ σήμερον ὀγδοήκοντα καὶ πέντε ἐτῶν

text_en: as strong as I was at that time when I was sent to view the land: the strength of that time continues in me until this day, as well to fight as to march.
text_la: sic valens ut eo valebam tempore quando ad explorandum missus sum : illius in me temporis fortitudo usque hodie perseverat, tam ad bellandum quam ad gradiendum.
text_pt: E ainda hoje estou tão forte como no dia em que Moisés me enviou; qual era a minha força então, tal é agora a minha força, tanto para a guerra como para sair e entrar.
text_el: ἔτι εἰμὶ σήμερον ἰσχύων ὡσεὶ ὅτε ἀπέστειλέν με Μωυσῆς ὡσαύτως ἰσχύω νῦν ἐξελθεῖν καὶ εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὸν πόλεμον

text_en: Give me therefore this mountain, which the Lord promised , in your hearing also, wherein are the Enacims, and cities great and strong: if so be the Lord will be with me, and I shall be able to destroy them, as he promised me.
text_la: Da ergo mihi montem istum, quem pollicitus est Dominus, te quoque audiente, in quo Enacim sunt, et urbes magnæ atque munitæ : si forte sit Dominus mecum, et potuero delere eos, sicut promisit mihi.
text_pt: Agora, pois, dá-me este monte de que o Senhor falou aquele dia; pois naquele dia tu ouviste que estavam ali os anaquins, e grandes e fortes cidades. Porventura o Senhor será comigo, para os expulsar, como o Senhor disse.
text_el: καὶ νῦν αἰτοῦμαί σε τὸ ὄρος τοῦτο καθὰ εἶπεν κύριος τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ὅτι σὺ ἀκήκοας τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ νυνὶ δὲ οἱ Ενακιμ ἐκεῖ εἰσιν πόλεις ὀχυραὶ καὶ μεγάλαι ἐὰν οὖν κύριος μετ' ἐμοῦ ᾖ ἐξολεθρεύσω αὐτούς ὃν τρόπον εἶπέν μοι κύριος

text_en: And Joshua blessed him, and gave him Hebron in possession.
text_la: Benedixitque ei Josue, et tradidit ei Hebron in possessionem:
text_pt: E Josué o abençoou, e deu a Calebe, filho de Jefoné, a Hebrom em herança.
text_el: καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτὸν Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἔδωκεν τὴν Χεβρων τῷ Χαλεβ υἱῷ Ιεφοννη υἱοῦ Κενεζ ἐν κλήρῳ

text_en: And from that time Hebron belonged to Caleb the son of Jephone the Cenezite , until this present day: because he followed the Lord the God of Israel .
text_la: atque ex eo fuit Hebron Caleb filio Jephone Cenezæo usque in præsentem diem, quia secutus est Dominum Deum Israël.
text_pt: Portanto Hebrom ficou sendo herança de Calebe, filho de Jefoné o quenezeu, até ao dia de hoje, porquanto perseverara em seguir ao Senhor Deus de Israel.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐγενήθη ἡ Χεβρων τῷ Χαλεβ τῷ τοῦ Ιεφοννη τοῦ Κενεζαίου ἐν κλήρῳ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης διὰ τὸ αὐτὸν ἐπακολουθῆσαι τῷ προστάγματι κυρίου θεοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: The name of Hebron before was called Cariath-Arbe: Adam the greatest among the Enacims was laid there and the land rested from wars.
text_la: Nomen Hebron ante vocabatur Cariath Arbe : Adam maximus ibi inter Enacim situs est : et terra cessavit a præliis.
text_pt: E antes o nome de Hebrom era Quiriate-Arba, porque Arba foi o maior homem entre os anaquins. E a terra repousou da guerra.
text_el: τὸ δὲ ὄνομα τῆς Χεβρων ἦν τὸ πρότερον πόλις Αρβοκ μητρόπολις τῶν Ενακιμ αὕτη καὶ ἡ γῆ ἐκόπασεν τοῦ πολέμου

text_en: Now the lot of the children of Juda by their kindreds was this: From the frontier of Edom , to the desert of Sin southward, and to the uttermost part of the south coast.
text_la: Igitur sors filiorum Judæ per cognationes suas ista fuit : a termino Edom, desertum Sin, contra meridiem, et usque ad extremam partem australis plagæ.
text_pt: A sorte que coube à tribo dos filhos de Judá, segundo as suas famílias, foi até ao termo de Edom, o deserto de Zim, para o sul, na extremidade do lado meridional.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο τὰ ὅρια φυλῆς Ιουδα κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῶν ὁρίων τῆς Ιδουμαίας ἀπὸ τῆς ἐρήμου Σιν ἕως Καδης πρὸς λίβα

text_en: Its beginning was from the top of the most salt sea , and from the bay thereof, that looks to the south.
text_la: Initium ejus a summitate maris salsissimi, et a lingua ejus, quæ respicit meridiem.
text_pt: E foi o seu termo para o sul, desde a extremidade do Mar Salgado, desde a baía que olha para o sul;
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη αὐτῶν τὰ ὅρια ἀπὸ λιβὸς ἕως μέρους τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς ἁλυκῆς ἀπὸ τῆς λοφιᾶς τῆς φερούσης ἐπὶ λίβα

text_en: And it goes out towards the ascent of the Scorpion, and passes on to Sina : and ascends into Cadesbarne , and reaches into Esron, going up to Addar, and compassing Carcaa.
text_la: Egrediturque contra ascensum Scorpionis, et pertransit in Sina : ascenditque in Cadesbarne, et pervenit in Esron, ascendens ad Addar, et circuiens Carcaa,
text_pt: E sai para o sul, até à subida de Acrabim, e passa a Zim, e sobe do sul a Cades-Barnéia, e passa por Hezrom, e sobe a Adar, e vira para Carca;
text_el: καὶ διαπορεύεται ἀπέναντι τῆς προσαναβάσεως Ακραβιν καὶ ἐκπεριπορεύεται Σεννα καὶ ἀναβαίνει ἀπὸ λιβὸς ἐπὶ Καδης Βαρνη καὶ ἐκπορεύεται Ασωρων καὶ προσαναβαίνει εἰς Αδδαρα καὶ περιπορεύεται τὴν κατὰ δυσμὰς Καδης

text_en: And from thence passing along into Asemona, and reaching the torrent of Egypt : and the bounds thereof shall be the great sea, this shall be the limit of the south coast.
text_la: atque inde pertransiens in Asemona, et perveniens ad torrentem Ægypti : eruntque termini ejus mare magnum. Hic erit finis meridianæ plagæ.
text_pt: E passa Azmom, e sai ao ribeiro do Egito, e as saídas deste termo vão até ao mar; este será o vosso termo do lado do sul.
text_el: καὶ πορεύεται ἐπὶ Ασεμωνα καὶ διεκβαλεῖ ἕως φάραγγος Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἔσται αὐτοῦ ἡ διέξοδος τῶν ὁρίων ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν τοῦτό ἐστιν αὐτῶν ὅρια ἀπὸ λιβός

text_en: But on the east side the beginning shall be the most salt sea even to the end of the Jordan : and towards the north from the bay of the sea unto the same river Jordan .
text_la: Ab oriente vero erit initium, mare salsissimum usque ad extrema Jordanis : et ea quæ respiciunt ad aquilonem, a lingua maris usque ad eumdem Jordanis fluvium.
text_pt: O termo, porém, para o oriente será o Mar Salgado, até à foz do Jordão; e o termo para o norte será da baía do mar, desde a foz do Jordão.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ὅρια ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν πᾶσα ἡ θάλασσα ἡ ἁλυκὴ ἕως τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ τὰ ὅρια αὐτῶν ἀπὸ βορρᾶ καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς λοφιᾶς τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ μέρους τοῦ Ιορδάνου

text_en: And the border goes up into Beth-Hagla, and passes by the north into Beth-Araba: going up to the stone of Boen the son of Ruben .
text_la: Ascenditque terminus in Beth Hagla, et transit ab aquilone in Beth Araba, ascendens ad lapidem Boën filii Ruben:
text_pt: E este termo subirá até Bete-Hogla, e passará do norte a Bete-Arabá, e este termo subirá até à pedra de Boã, filho de Rúben.
text_el: ἐπιβαίνει τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ Βαιθαγλα καὶ παραπορεύεται ἀπὸ βορρᾶ ἐπὶ Βαιθαραβα καὶ προσαναβαίνει τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ λίθον Βαιων υἱοῦ Ρουβην

text_en: And reaching as far as the borders of Debara from the valley of Achor , and so northward looking towards Galgal, which is opposite to the ascent of Adommin, on the south side of the torrent, and the border passes the waters that are called the fountain of the sun: and the goings out thereof shall be at the fountain Rogel.
text_la: et tendens usque ad terminos Debera de valle Achor, contra aquilonem respiciens Galgala, quæ est ex adverso ascensionis Adommim, ab australi parte torrentis : transitque aquas, quæ vocantur fons solis : et erunt exitus ejus ad fontem Rogel.
text_pt: Subirá mais este termo a Debir desde o vale de Acor, indo para o norte rumo a Gilgal, a qual está em frente da subida de Adumim, que está para o sul do ribeiro; então este termo continua até às águas de En-Semes; e as suas saídas estão do lado de En-Rogel.
text_el: καὶ προσαναβαίνει τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ τὸ τέταρτον τῆς φάραγγος Αχωρ καὶ καταβαίνει ἐπὶ Γαλγαλ ἥ ἐστιν ἀπέναντι τῆς προσβάσεως Αδδαμιν ἥ ἐστιν κατὰ λίβα τῇ φάραγγι καὶ διεκβαλεῖ ἐπὶ τὸ ὕδωρ πηγῆς ἡλίου καὶ ἔσται αὐτοῦ ἡ διέξοδος πηγὴ Ρωγηλ

text_en: And it goes up by the valley of the son of Ennom on the side of the Jebusite towards the south, the same is Jerusalem : and thence ascending to the top of the mountain, which is over against Geennom to the west in the end of the valley of Raphaim, northward.
text_la: Ascenditque per convallem filii Ennom ex latere Jebusæi ad meridiem, hæc est Jerusalem : et inde se erigens ad verticem montis, qui est contra Geennom ad occidentem in summitate vallis Raphaim contra aquilonem:
text_pt: E este termo sobe pelo vale do filho de Hinom, do lado sul dos jebuseus (esta é Jerusalém) e sobe este termo até ao cume do monte que está diante do vale de Hinom para o ocidente, que está no fim do vale dos refains do lado do norte.
text_el: καὶ ἀναβαίνει τὰ ὅρια εἰς φάραγγα Ονομ ἐπὶ νώτου Ιεβους ἀπὸ λιβός αὕτη ἐστὶν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ διεκβάλλει τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ κορυφὴν ὄρους ἥ ἐστιν κατὰ πρόσωπον φάραγγος Ονομ πρὸς θαλάσσης ἥ ἐστιν ἐκ μέρους γῆς Ραφαϊν ἐπὶ βορρᾶ

text_en: And it passes on from the top of the mountain to the fountain of the water of Nephtoa: and reaches to the towns of mount Ephron: and it bends towards Baala, which is Cariathiarim, that is to say, the city of the woods.
text_la: pertransitque a vertice montis usque ad fontem aquæ Nephtoa : et pervenit usque ad vicos montis Ephron : inclinaturque in Baala, quæ est Cariathiarim, id est, urbs silvarum.
text_pt: Então este termo vai desde a altura do monte até à fonte das águas de Neftoa; e sai até às cidades do monte de Efrom; vai mais este termo até Baalá (esta é Quiriate-Jearim).
text_el: καὶ διεκβάλλει τὸ ὅριον ἀπὸ κορυφῆς τοῦ ὄρους ἐπὶ πηγὴν ὕδατος Ναφθω καὶ διεκβάλλει εἰς τὸ ὄρος Εφρων καὶ ἐξάξει τὸ ὅριον εἰς Βααλ αὕτη ἐστὶν πόλις Ιαριμ

text_en: And it compasses from Baala westward unto mount Seir: and passes by the side of mount Jarim to the north into Cheslon: and goes down into Bethsames, and passes into Thamna.
text_la: Et circuit de Baala contra occidentem, usque ad montem Seir : transitque juxta latus montis Jarim ad aquilonem in Cheslon : et descendit in Bethsames, transitque in Thamna.
text_pt: Então volta este termo desde Baalá para o ocidente, até às montanhas de Seir, e passa ao lado do monte de Jearim do lado do norte (esta é Quesalom) e desce a Bete-Semes, e passa por Timna;
text_el: καὶ περιελεύσεται ὅριον ἀπὸ Βααλ ἐπὶ θάλασσαν καὶ παρελεύσεται εἰς ὄρος Ασσαρες ἐπὶ νώτου πόλιν Ιαριμ ἀπὸ βορρᾶ αὕτη ἐστὶν Χασλων καὶ καταβήσεται ἐπὶ Πόλιν ἡλίου καὶ παρελεύσεται ἐπὶ λίβα

text_en: And reaches northward to a part of Accaron at the side: and bends to Sechrona, and passes mount Baala: and comes into Jebneel, and is bounded westward with the great sea.
text_la: Et pervenit contra aquilonem partis Accaron ex latere : inclinaturque Sechrona, et transit montem Baala : pervenitque in Jebneel, et magni maris contra occidentem fine concluditur.
text_pt: Sai este termo mais ao lado de Ecrom, para o norte, e este termo vai a Sicrom e passa o monte de Baalá, e sai em Jabneel; e assim este termo finda no mar.
text_el: καὶ διεκβαλεῖ τὸ ὅριον κατὰ νώτου Ακκαρων ἐπὶ βορρᾶν καὶ διεκβαλεῖ τὰ ὅρια εἰς Σακχαρωνα καὶ παρελεύσεται ὄρος τῆς Βαλα καὶ διεκβαλεῖ ἐπὶ Ιαβνηλ καὶ ἔσται ἡ διέξοδος τῶν ὁρίων ἐπὶ θάλασσαν

text_en: These are the borders round about of the children of Juda in their kindreds.
text_la: Hi sunt termini filiorum Juda per circuitum in cognationibus suis.
text_pt: Será, porém, o termo do lado do ocidente o Mar Grande, e suas adjacências; este é o termo dos filhos de Judá ao redor, segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: καὶ τὰ ὅρια αὐτῶν ἀπὸ θαλάσσης ἡ θάλασσα ἡ μεγάλη ὁριεῖ ταῦτα τὰ ὅρια υἱῶν Ιουδα κύκλῳ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν

text_en: But to Caleb the son of Jephone he gave a portion in the midst of the children of Juda , as the Lord had commanded him: Cariath-Arbe the father of Enac, which is Hebron .
text_la: Caleb vero filio Jephone dedit partem in medio filiorum Juda, sicut præceperat ei Dominus : Cariath Arbe patris Enac, ipsa est Hebron.
text_pt: Mas a Calebe, filho de Jefoné, deu uma parte no meio dos filhos de Judá, conforme a ordem do Senhor a Josué; a saber, a cidade de Arba, que é Hebrom; este Arba era pai de Anaque.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Χαλεβ υἱῷ Ιεφοννη ἔδωκεν μερίδα ἐν μέσῳ υἱῶν Ιουδα διὰ προστάγματος τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς τὴν πόλιν Αρβοκ μητρόπολιν Ενακ αὕτη ἐστὶν Χεβρων

text_en: And Caleb destroyed out of it the three sons of Enac, Sesai and Ahiman, and Tholmai of the race of Enac.
text_la: Delevitque ex ea Caleb tres filios Enac, Sesai et Ahiman et Tholmai de stirpe Enac.
text_pt: E Calebe expulsou dali os três filhos de Anaque: Sesai, e Aimã, e Talmai, gerados de Anaque.
text_el: καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσεν ἐκεῖθεν Χαλεβ υἱὸς Ιεφοννη τοὺς τρεῖς υἱοὺς Ενακ τὸν Σουσι καὶ τὸν Θολμι καὶ τὸν Αχιμα

text_en: And going up from thence he came to the inhabitants of Dabir, which before was called Cariath-Sepher, that is to say, the city of letters.
text_la: Atque inde conscendens venit ad habitatores Dabir, quæ prius vocabatur Cariath Sepher, id est, civitas litterarum.
text_pt: E dali subiu aos habitantes de Debir; e fora antes o nome de Debir, Quiriate-Sefer.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη ἐκεῖθεν Χαλεβ ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Δαβιρ τὸ δὲ ὄνομα Δαβιρ ἦν τὸ πρότερον Πόλις γραμμάτων

text_en: And Caleb said: He that shall smite Cariath-Sepher, and take it, I will give him Axa my daughter to wife .
text_la: Dixitque Caleb : Qui percusserit Cariath Sepher, et ceperit eam, dabo ei Axam filiam meam uxorem.
text_pt: E disse Calebe: Quem ferir a Quiriate-Sefer, e a tomar, lhe darei a minha filha Acsa por mulher.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Χαλεβ ὃς ἐὰν λάβῃ καὶ ἐκκόψῃ τὴν Πόλιν τῶν γραμμάτων καὶ κυριεύσῃ αὐτῆς δώσω αὐτῷ τὴν Αχσαν θυγατέρα μου εἰς γυναῖκα

text_en: And Othoniel the son of Cenez, the younger brother of Caleb , took it: and he gave him Axa his daughter to wife .
text_la: Cepitque eam Othoniel filius Cenez frater Caleb junior: deditque ei Axam filiam suam uxorem.
text_pt: Tomou-a, pois, Otniel, filho de Quenaz, irmão de Calebe; e deu-lhe a sua filha Acsa por mulher.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτὴν Γοθονιηλ υἱὸς Κενεζ ἀδελφὸς Χαλεβ ὁ νεώτερος καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ τὴν Αχσαν θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ αὐτῷ γυναῖκα

text_en: And as they were going together, she was moved by her husband to ask a field of her father , and she sighed as she sat on her ass. And Caleb said to her: What ails you?
text_la: Quæ, cum pergerent simul, suasa est a viro suo ut peteret a patre suo agrum. Suspiravitque ut sedebat in asino : cui Caleb : Quid habes? inquit.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, vindo ela a ele, o persuadiu que pedisse um campo a seu pai; e ela desceu do seu jumento; então Calebe lhe disse: Que é que tens?
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εἰσπορεύεσθαι αὐτὴν καὶ συνεβουλεύσατο αὐτῷ λέγουσα αἰτήσομαι τὸν πατέρα μου ἀγρόν καὶ ἐβόησεν ἐκ τοῦ ὄνου καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Χαλεβ τί ἐστίν σοι

text_en: But she answered: Give me a blessing : you have given me a southern and dry land, give me also a land that is watered. And Caleb gave her the upper and the nether watery ground.
text_la: At illa respondit : Da mihi benedictionem : terram australem et arentem dedisti mihi; junge et irriguam. Dedit itaque ei Caleb irriguum superius et inferius.
text_pt: E ela disse: Dá-me uma bênção; pois me deste terra seca, dá-me também fontes de águas. Então lhe deu as fontes superiores e as fontes inferiores.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ δός μοι εὐλογίαν ὅτι εἰς γῆν Ναγεβ δέδωκάς με δός μοι τὴν Γολαθμαιν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῇ Χαλεβ τὴν Γολαθμαιν τὴν ἄνω καὶ τὴν Γολαθμαιν τὴν κάτω

text_en: This is the possession of the tribe of the children of Juda by their kindreds.
text_la: Hæc est possessio tribus filiorum Juda per cognationes suas.
text_pt: Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Judá, segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ κληρονομία φυλῆς υἱῶν Ιουδα

text_en: And the cities from the uttermost parts of the children of Juda by the borders of Edom to the south, were Cabseel and Eder and Jagur,
text_la: Erantque civitates ab extremis partibus filiorum Juda juxta terminos Edom a meridie : Cabseel et Eder et Jagur,
text_pt: São, pois, as cidades da tribo dos filhos de Judá, até ao termo de Edom, no extremo sul: Cabzeel, e Eder, e Jagur.
text_el: ἐγενήθησαν δὲ αἱ πόλεις αὐτῶν πόλις πρώτη φυλῆς υἱῶν Ιουδα ἐφ' ὁρίων Εδωμ ἐπὶ τῆς ἐρήμου Καιβαισελεηλ καὶ Αρα καὶ Ασωρ

text_en: and Cina and Dimona and Adada,
text_la: et Cyna et Dimona et Adada,
text_pt: E Quiná, e Dimona, e Adada,
text_el: καὶ Ικαμ καὶ Ρεγμα καὶ Αρουηλ

text_en: and Cades and Asor and Jethnam,
text_la: et Cades et Asor et Jethnam,
text_pt: E Quedes, e Hazor, e Itnã,
text_el: καὶ Καδης καὶ Ασοριωναιν

text_en: Ziph and Telem and Baloth,
text_la: Ziph et Telem et Baloth,
text_pt: Zife, e Telem, e Bealote,
text_el: καὶ Μαιναμ καὶ Βαλμαιναν καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: New Asor and Carioth, Hesron, which is Asor.
text_la: Asor nova et Carioth, Hesron, hæc est Asor;
text_pt: E Hazor-Hadata, e Queriote-Hezrom (que é Hazor),
text_el: καὶ αἱ πόλεις Ασερων αὕτη Ασωρ

text_en: Amam, Sama and Molada,
text_la: Amam, Sama, et Molada,
text_pt: Amã e Sema, e Moladá,
text_el: καὶ Σην καὶ Σαλμαα καὶ Μωλαδα

text_en: and Asergadda and Hassemon and Bethphelet,
text_la: et Asergadda et Hassemon et Bethphelet,
text_pt: E Hazar-Gada, e Hesmom, e Bete-Palete,
text_el: καὶ Σερι καὶ Βαιφαλαδ

text_en: and Hasersual and Bersabee and Baziothia,
text_la: et Hasersual et Bersabee et Baziothia,
text_pt: E Hazar-Sual, e Berseba, e Biziotiá,
text_el: καὶ Χολασεωλα καὶ Βηρσαβεε καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν

text_en: and Baala and Jim and Esem,
text_la: et Baala et Jim et Esem,
text_pt: Baalá, e Iim, e Azem,
text_el: Βαλα καὶ Βακωκ καὶ Ασομ

text_en: and Eltholad and Cesil and Harma,
text_la: et Eltholad et Cesil et Harma,
text_pt: E Eltolade, e Quesil, e Hormá.
text_el: καὶ Ελβωυδαδ καὶ Βαιθηλ καὶ Ερμα

text_en: and Siceleg and Medemena and Sensenna,
text_la: et Siceleg et Medemena et Sensenna,
text_pt: E Ziclague, e Madmana, e Sansana,
text_el: καὶ Σεκελακ καὶ Μαχαριμ καὶ Σεθεννακ

text_en: Lebaoth and Selim and Aen and Remmon: all the cities twenty-nine, and their villages .
text_la: Lebaoth et Selim et Aën et Remon. Omnes civitates viginti novem, et villæ earum.
text_pt: E Lebaote, e Silim, e Aim, e Rimom; todas as cidades e as suas aldeias, vinte e nove.
text_el: καὶ Λαβως καὶ Σαλη καὶ Ερωμωθ πόλεις κθ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: But in the plains: Estaol and Sarea and Asena,
text_la: In campestribus vero : Estaol et Sarea et Asena,
text_pt: Nas planícies: Estaol, e Zorá, e Asná,
text_el: ἐν τῇ πεδινῇ Ασταωλ καὶ Ραα καὶ Ασσα

text_en: and Zanoe and Engannim and Taphua and Enaim,
text_la: et Zanoë et Ængannim et Taphua et Enaim,
text_pt: E Zanoa, e En-Ganim, Tapua, e Enã.
text_el: καὶ Ραμεν καὶ Τανω καὶ Ιλουθωθ καὶ Μαιανι

text_en: and Jerimoth and Adullam , Socho and Azeca,
text_la: et Jerimoth et Adullam, Socho et Azeca,
text_pt: E Jarmute, e Adulão, Socó, e Azeca,
text_el: καὶ Ιερμουθ καὶ Οδολλαμ καὶ Μεμβρα καὶ Σαωχω καὶ Αζηκα

text_en: and Saraim and Adithaim and Gedera and Gederothaim: fourteen cities, and their villages .
text_la: et Saraim et Adithaim et Gedera et Gederothaim : urbes quatuordecim, et villæ earum.
text_pt: E Saaraim, e Aditaim, e Gederá, e Gederotaim; catorze cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: καὶ Σακαριμ καὶ Γαδηρα καὶ αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῆς πόλεις δέκα τέσσαρες καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: Sanan and Hadassa and Magdalgad,
text_la: Sanan et Hadassa et Magdalgad,
text_pt: Zenã, e Hadasa, e Migdal-Gade,
text_el: Σεννα καὶ Αδασαν καὶ Μαγαδαγαδ

text_en: Delean and Masepha and Jecthel,
text_la: Delean et Masepha et Jecthel,
text_pt: E Dileã, e Mizpe, e Jocteel,
text_el: καὶ Δαλαλ καὶ Μασφα καὶ Ιακαρεηλ

text_en: Lachis and Bascath and Eglon,
text_la: Lachis et Bascath et Eglon,
text_pt: Laquis, e Bozcate, e Eglom,
text_el: καὶ Λαχης καὶ Βασηδωθ καὶ Ιδεαδαλεα

text_en: Chebbon and Leheman and Cethlis,
text_la: Chebbon et Leheman et Cethlis,
text_pt: E Cabom, e Laamás, e Quitlis,
text_el: καὶ Χαβρα καὶ Μαχες καὶ Μααχως

text_en: and Gideroth and Bethdagon and Naama and Maceda: sixteen cities, and their villages .
text_la: et Gideroth et Bethdagon et Naama et Maceda : civitates sedecim, et villæ earum.
text_pt: E Gederote, Bete-Dagom, e Naamá, e Maquedá, dezesseis cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: καὶ Γεδδωρ καὶ Βαγαδιηλ καὶ Νωμαν καὶ Μακηδαν πόλεις δεκαὲξ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: Labana and Ether and Asan,
text_la: Labana et Ether et Asan,
text_pt: Libna, e Eter, e Asã,
text_el: Λεμνα καὶ Ιθακ

text_en: Jephtha and Esna and Nesib,
text_la: Jephtha et Esna et Nesib,
text_pt: E Iftá, e Asná, e Nezibe,
text_el: καὶ Ανωχ καὶ Ιανα καὶ Νασιβ

text_en: and Ceila and Achzib and Maresa: nine cities, and their villages .
text_la: et Ceila et Achzib et Maresa : civitates novem, et villæ earum.
text_pt: E Queila, e Aczibe, e Maressa; nove cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: καὶ Κεϊλαμ καὶ Ακιεζι καὶ Κεζιβ καὶ Βαθησαρ καὶ Αιλων πόλεις δέκα καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: Accaron with the towns and villages thereof.
text_la: Accaron cum vicis et villulis suis.
text_pt: Ecrom, com suas vilas, e as suas aldeias.
text_el: Ακκαρων καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς καὶ αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν

text_en: From Accaron even to the sea: all places that lie towards Azotus and the villages thereof.
text_la: Ab Accaron usque ad mare: omnia quæ vergunt ad Azotum et viculos ejus.
text_pt: Desde Ecrom, e até ao mar, todas as que estão do lado de Asdode, e as suas aldeias.
text_el: ἀπὸ Ακκαρων Γεμνα καὶ πᾶσαι ὅσαι εἰσὶν πλησίον Ασηδωθ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: Azotus with its towns and villages . Gaza with its towns and villages , even to the torrent of Egypt , and the great sea that is the border thereof.
text_la: Azotus cum vicis et villulis suis. Gaza cum vicis et villulis suis, usque ad torrentem Ægypti, et mare magnum terminus ejus.
text_pt: Asdode, com as suas vilas e as suas aldeias; Gaza, com as suas vilas e as suas aldeias, até ao rio do Egito, e o Mar Grande e o seu termo.
text_el: Ασιεδωθ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς καὶ αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῆς Γάζα καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς καὶ αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῆς ἕως τοῦ χειμάρρου Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἡ θάλασσα ἡ μεγάλη διορίζει

text_en: And in the mountain Samir and Jether and Socoth,
text_la: Et in monte: Samir et Jether et Socoth
text_pt: E nas montanhas: Samir, Jatir, e Socó.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῇ ὀρεινῇ Σαμιρ καὶ Ιεθερ καὶ Σωχα

text_en: and Danna and Cariath-senna, this is Dabir:
text_la: et Danna et Cariathsenna, hæc est Dabir:
text_pt: E Daná, e Quiriate-Saná (que é Debir),
text_el: καὶ Ρεννα καὶ Πόλις γραμμάτων αὕτη Δαβιρ

text_en: Anab and Istemo and Anim,
text_la: Anab et Istemo et Anim,
text_pt: E Anabe, Estemó, e Anim,
text_el: καὶ Ανων καὶ Εσκαιμαν καὶ Αισαμ

text_en: Gosen and Olon and Gilo: eleven cities and their villages .
text_la: Gosen et Olon et Gilo : civitates undecim et villæ earum.
text_pt: E Gósen, e Holom, e Giló; onze cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: καὶ Γοσομ καὶ Χαλου καὶ Χαννα πόλεις ἕνδεκα καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: Arab and Ruma and Esaan,
text_la: Arab et Ruma et Esaan,
text_pt: Arabe, e Dumá e Esã,
text_el: Αιρεμ καὶ Ρεμνα καὶ Σομα

text_en: and Janum and Beththaphua and Apheca,
text_la: et Janum et Beththaphua et Apheca,
text_pt: E Janim, e Bete-Tapua e Afeca,
text_el: καὶ Ιεμαϊν καὶ Βαιθαχου καὶ Φακουα

text_en: Athmatha and Cariath-Arbe, this is Hebron and Sior: nine cities and their villages .
text_la: Athmatha, et Cariath Arbe, hæc est Hebron, et Sior : civitates novem, et villæ earum.
text_pt: E Hunta, e Quiriate-Arba (que é Hebrom), e Zior; nove cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: καὶ Ευμα καὶ πόλις Αρβοκ αὕτη ἐστὶν Χεβρων καὶ Σωρθ πόλεις ἐννέα καὶ αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν

text_en: Maon and Carmel and Ziph and Jota,
text_la: Maon et Carmel et Ziph et Jota,
text_pt: Maom, Carmelo, e Zife, e Jutá,
text_el: Μαωρ καὶ Χερμελ καὶ Οζιβ καὶ Ιταν

text_en: Jezrael and Jucadam and Zanoe,
text_la: Jezraël et Jucadam et Zanoë,
text_pt: E Jizreel, e Jocdeão, e Zanoa,
text_el: καὶ Ιαριηλ καὶ Ιαρικαμ καὶ Ζακαναϊμ

text_en: Accain, Gabaa and Thamna: ten cities and their villages .
text_la: Accain, Gabaa et Thamna : civitates decem et villæ earum.
text_pt: Caim, Gibeá, e Timna; dez cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: καὶ Γαβαα καὶ Θαμναθα πόλεις ἐννέα καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: Halhul, and Bessur, and Gedor ,
text_la: Halhul, et Besur, et Gedor,
text_pt: Halul, Bete-Zur, e Gedor,
text_el: Αλουα καὶ Βαιθσουρ καὶ Γεδδων

text_en: Mareth, and Bethanoth, and Eltecon: six cities and their villages .
text_la: Mareth, et Bethanoth, et Eltecon : civitates sex et villæ earum.
text_pt: E Maarate, e Bete-Anote, e Eltecom; seis cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: καὶ Μαγαρωθ καὶ Βαιθαναμ καὶ Θεκουμ πόλεις ἓξ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: Cariathbaal, the same is Cariathiarim the city of woods, and Arebba: two cities and their villages .
text_la: Cariathbaal, hæc est Cariathiarim urbs silvarum, et Arebba : civitates duæ, et villæ earum.
text_pt: Quiriate-Baal (que é Quiriate-Jearim), e Rabá; duas cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: Καριαθβααλ αὕτη ἡ πόλις Ιαριμ καὶ Σωθηβα πόλεις δύο καὶ αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν

text_en: In the desert Betharaba, Meddin and Sachacha,
text_la: In deserto Betharaba, Meddin, et Sachacha,
text_pt: No deserto: Bete-Arabá, Midim, e Secacá,
text_el: καὶ Βαδδαργις καὶ Θαραβααμ καὶ Αινων καὶ Αιχιοζα

text_en: and Nebsan, and the city of salt, and Engaddi : six cities and their villages .
text_la: et Nebsan, et civitas salis, et Engaddi : civitates sex, et villæ earum.
text_pt: E Nibsã, e a Cidade do Sal, e En-Gedi; seis cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: καὶ Ναφλαζων καὶ αἱ πόλεις Σαδωμ καὶ Ανκαδης πόλεις ἑπτὰ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: But the children of Juda could not destroy the Jebusite that dwelt in Jerusalem : and the Jebusite dwelt with the children of Juda in Jerusalem until this present day.
text_la: Jebusæum autem habitatorem Jerusalem non potuerunt filii Juda delere : habitavitque Jebusæus cum filiis Juda in Jerusalem usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: Não puderam, porém, os filhos de Judá expulsar os jebuseus que habitavam em Jerusalém; assim habitaram os jebuseus com os filhos de Judá em Jerusalém, até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ ὁ Ιεβουσαῖος κατῴκει ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνάσθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ιουδα ἀπολέσαι αὐτούς καὶ κατῴκησαν οἱ Ιεβουσαῖοι ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης

text_en: And the lot of the sons of Joseph fell from the Jordan over against Jericho and the waters thereof, on the east: the wilderness which goes up from Jericho to the mountain of Bethel :
text_la: Cecidit quoque sors filiorum Joseph ab Jordane contra Jericho et aquas ejus ab oriente: solitudo quæ ascendit de Jericho ad montem Bethel:
text_pt: Saiu depois a sorte dos filhos de José, desde o Jordão, na direção de Jericó, junto às águas de Jericó, para o oriente, estendendo-se pelo deserto que sobe de Jericó pelas montanhas de Betel.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο τὰ ὅρια υἱῶν Ιωσηφ ἀπὸ τοῦ Ιορδάνου τοῦ κατὰ Ιεριχω ἀπ' ἀνατολῶν καὶ ἀναβήσεται ἀπὸ Ιεριχω εἰς τὴν ὀρεινὴν τὴν ἔρημον εἰς Βαιθηλ Λουζα

text_en: And goes out from Bethel to Luza: and passes the border of Archi, to Ataroth,
text_la: et egreditur de Bethel Luza : transitque terminum Archi, Ataroth:
text_pt: E de Betel vai para Luz, e passa ao termo dos arquitas, até Atarote,
text_el: καὶ ἐξελεύσεται εἰς Βαιθηλ καὶ παρελεύσεται ἐπὶ τὰ ὅρια τοῦ Χαταρωθι

text_en: and goes down westward, by the border of Jephleti, unto the borders of Beth-horon the nether, and to Gazer: and the countries of it are ended by the great sea:
text_la: et descendit ad occidentem juxta terminum Jephleti, usque ad terminos Beth-horon inferioris, et Gazer : finiunturque regiones ejus mari magno:
