text_pt: E desce do lado do ocidente ao termo de Jafleti, até ao termo de Bete-Horom de baixo, e até Gezer, indo terminar no mar.
text_el: καὶ διελεύσεται ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν ἐπὶ τὰ ὅρια Απταλιμ ἕως τῶν ὁρίων Βαιθωρων τὴν κάτω καὶ ἔσται ἡ διέξοδος αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν

text_en: And Manasses and Ephraim the children of Joseph possessed it.
text_la: possederuntque filii Joseph, Manasses et Ephraim.
text_pt: Assim alcançaram a sua herança os filhos de José, Manassés e Efraim.
text_el: καὶ ἐκληρονόμησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ιωσηφ Εφραιμ καὶ Μανασση

text_en: And the border of the children of Ephraim was according to their kindreds: and their possession towards the east was Ataroth-addar unto Beth-horon the upper.
text_la: Et factus est terminus filiorum Ephraim per cognationes suas : et possessio eorum contra orientem Ataroth Addar usque Beth-horon superiorem.
text_pt: E foi o termo dos filhos de Efraim, segundo as suas famílias, como se segue: o termo da sua herança para o oriente era Atarote-Adar até Bete-Horom de cima;
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ὅρια υἱῶν Εφραιμ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν καὶ ἐγενήθη τὰ ὅρια τῆς κληρονομίας αὐτῶν ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν Αταρωθ καὶ Εροκ ἕως Βαιθωρων τὴν ἄνω καὶ Γαζαρα

text_en: And the confines go out unto the sea: but Machmethath looks to the north, and it goes round the borders eastward into Thanath-selo: and passes along on the east side to Janoe.
text_la: Egrediunturque confinia in mare : Machmethath vero aquilonem respicit, et circuit terminos contra orientem in Thanathselo : et pertransit ab oriente Janoë.
text_pt: E sai este termo para o ocidente junto a Micmetá, desde o norte, e torna este termo para o oriente até Taanate-Siló, e passa por ela desde o oriente a Janoa;
text_el: καὶ διελεύσεται τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν εἰς Ικασμων ἀπὸ βορρᾶ Θερμα περιελεύσεται ἐπὶ ἀνατολὰς εἰς Θηνασα καὶ Σελλησα καὶ παρελεύσεται ἀπ' ἀνατολῶν εἰς Ιανωκα

text_en: And it goes down from Janoe into Ataroth and Naaratha: and it comes to Jericho , and goes out to the Jordan .
text_la: Descenditque de Janoë in Ataroth et Naaratha : et pervenit in Jericho, egrediturque ad Jordanem.
text_pt: E desce desde Janoa a Atarote e a Naarate e toca em Jericó, terminando no Jordão.
text_el: καὶ εἰς Μαχω καὶ Αταρωθ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν καὶ ἐλεύσεται ἐπὶ Ιεριχω καὶ διεκβαλεῖ ἐπὶ τὸν Ιορδάνην

text_en: From Taphua it passes on towards the sea into the valley of reeds, and the goings out thereof are at the most salt sea . This is the possession of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families .
text_la: De Taphua pertransit contra mare in vallem arundineti, suntque egressus ejus in mare salsissimum. Hæc est possessio tribus filiorum Ephraim per familias suas.
text_pt: De Tapua vai este termo para o ocidente ao ribeiro de Caná, terminando no mar; esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Efraim, segundo as suas famílias,
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ Ταφου πορεύσεται τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ θάλασσαν ἐπὶ Χελκανα καὶ ἔσται ἡ διέξοδος αὐτῶν ἐπὶ θάλασσαν αὕτη ἡ κληρονομία φυλῆς Εφραιμ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν

text_en: And there were cities with their villages separated for the children of Ephraim in the midst of the possession of the children of Manasses .
text_la: Urbesque separatæ sunt filiis Ephraim in medio possessionis filiorum Manasse, et villæ earum.
text_pt: Mais as cidades que se separaram para os filhos de Efraim no meio da herança dos filhos de Manassés; todas aquelas cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: καὶ αἱ πόλεις αἱ ἀφορισθεῖσαι τοῖς υἱοῖς Εφραιμ ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς κληρονομίας υἱῶν Μανασση πᾶσαι αἱ πόλεις καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: And the children of Ephraim slew not the Chanaanite , who dwelt in Gazer: and the Chanaanite dwelt in the midst of Ephraim until this day, paying tribute.
text_la: Et non interfecerunt filii Ephraim Chananæum, qui habitabat in Gazer : habitavitque Chananæus in medio Ephraim usque in diem hanc tributarius.
text_pt: E não expulsaram aos cananeus que habitavam em Gezer; e os cananeus habitam no meio dos efraimitas até ao dia de hoje; porém, sendo-lhes tributários.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἀπώλεσεν Εφραιμ τὸν Χαναναῖον τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐν Γαζερ καὶ κατῴκει ὁ Χαναναῖος ἐν τῷ Εφραιμ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης ἕως ἀνέβη Φαραω βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐνέπρησεν αὐτὴν ἐν πυρί καὶ τοὺς Χαναναίους καὶ τοὺς Φερεζαίους καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν Γαζερ ἐξεκέντησαν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὴν Φαραω ἐν φερνῇ τῇ θυγατρὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And this lot fell to the tribe of Manasses (for he is the firstborn of Joseph ) to Machir the firstborn of Manasses the father of Galaad, who was a warlike man , and had for possession Galaad and Basan.
text_la: Cecidit autem sors tribui Manasse (ipse enim est primogenitus Joseph) : Machir primogenito Manasse patri Galaad, qui fuit vir pugnator, habuitque possessionem Galaad et Basan:
text_pt: Também coube sorte à tribo de Manassés, porquanto era o primogênito de José. Maquir, o primogênito de Manassés, pai de Gileade, porquanto era homem de guerra, teve a Gileade e Basã;
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο τὰ ὅρια φυλῆς υἱῶν Μανασση ὅτι οὗτος πρωτότοκος τῷ Ιωσηφ τῷ Μαχιρ πρωτοτόκῳ Μανασση πατρὶ Γαλααδ ἀνὴρ γὰρ πολεμιστὴς ἦν ἐν τῇ Γαλααδίτιδι καὶ ἐν τῇ Βασανίτιδι

text_en: And to the rest of the children of Manasses according to their families : to the children of Abiezer, and to the children of Helec, and to the children of Esriel, and to the children of Sechem , and to the children of Hepher, and to the children of Semida: these are the male children of Manasses the son of Joseph , by their kindreds.
text_la: et reliquis filiorum Manasse juxta familias suas, filiis Abiezer, et filiis Helec, et filiis Esriel, et filiis Sechem, et filiis Hepher, et filiis Semida. Isti sunt filii Manasse filii Joseph, mares, per cognationes suas.
text_pt: Também os demais filhos de Manassés tiveram a sua parte, segundo as suas famílias, a saber: Os filhos de Abiezer, e os filhos de Heleque, e os filhos de Asriel, e os filhos de Siquém, e os filhos de Hefer, e os filhos de Semida; esses são os filhos de Manassés, filho de José, segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη τοῖς υἱοῖς Μανασση τοῖς λοιποῖς κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ιεζερ καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Κελεζ καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ιεζιηλ καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Συχεμ καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Συμαριμ καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Οφερ οὗτοι οἱ ἄρσενες κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν

text_en: But Salphaad the son of Hepher the son of Galaad the son of Machir the son of Manasses had no sons, but only daughters: whose names are these, Maala and Noa and Hegla and Melcha and Thersa.
text_la: Salphaad vero filio Hepher filii Galaad filii Machir filii Manasse non erant filii, sed solæ filiæ : quarum ista sunt nomina : Maala et Noa et Hegla et Melcha et Thersa.
text_pt: Zelofeade, porém, filho de Hefer, filho de Gileade, filho de Maquir, filho de Manassés, não teve filhos, mas só filhas; e estes são os nomes de suas filhas: Maalá, Noa, Hogla, Milca e Tirza.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Σαλπααδ υἱῷ Οφερ οὐκ ἦσαν αὐτῷ υἱοὶ ἀλλ' ἢ θυγατέρες καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν θυγατέρων Σαλπααδ Μααλα καὶ Νουα καὶ Εγλα καὶ Μελχα καὶ Θερσα

text_en: And they came in the presence of Eleazar the priest and of Joshua the son of Nun , and of the princes, saying: The Lord commanded by the hand of Moses , that a possession should be given us in the midst of our brethren. And he gave them according to the commandment of the Lord a possession amongst the brethren of their father.
text_la: Veneruntque in conspectu Eleazari sacerdotis, et Josue filii Nun, et principum, dicentes : Dominus præcepit per manum Moysi, ut daretur nobis possessio in medio fratrum nostrorum. Deditque eis juxta imperium Domini possessionem in medio fratrum patris earum.
text_pt: Estas, pois, chegaram diante de Eleazar, o sacerdote, e diante de Josué, filho de Num, e diante dos príncipes, dizendo: O Senhor ordenou a Moisés que se nos desse herança no meio de nossos irmãos, pelo que, conforme a ordem do Senhor, lhes deu herança no meio dos irmãos de seu pai.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησαν ἐναντίον Ελεαζαρ τοῦ ἱερέως καὶ ἐναντίον Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἐναντίον τῶν ἀρχόντων λέγουσαι ὁ θεὸς ἐνετείλατο διὰ χειρὸς Μωυσῆ δοῦναι ἡμῖν κληρονομίαν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἡμῶν καὶ ἐδόθη αὐταῖς διὰ προστάγματος κυρίου κλῆρος ἐν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν

text_en: And there fell ten portions to Manasses , beside the land of Galaad and Basan beyond the Jordan .
text_la: Et ceciderunt funiculi Manasse, decem, absque terra Galaad et Basan trans Jordanem.
text_pt: E couberam a Manassés dez quinhões, afora a terra de Gileade e Basã, que está além do Jordão;
text_el: καὶ ἔπεσεν ὁ σχοινισμὸς αὐτῶν ἀπὸ Ανασσα καὶ πεδίον Λαβεκ ἐκ τῆς Γαλααδ ἥ ἐστιν πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου

text_en: For the daughters of Manasses possessed inheritance in the midst of his sons. And the land of Galaad fell to the lot of the rest of the children of Manasses .
text_la: Filiæ enim Manasse possederunt hæreditatem in medio filiorum ejus. Terra autem Galaad cecidit in sortem filiorum Manasse qui reliqui erant.
text_pt: Porque as filhas de Manassés receberam herança entre os filhos dele; e os outros filhos de Manassés ficaram com a terra de Gileade.
text_el: ὅτι θυγατέρες υἱῶν Μανασση ἐκληρονόμησαν κλῆρον ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν ἡ δὲ γῆ Γαλααδ ἐγενήθη τοῖς υἱοῖς Μανασση τοῖς καταλελειμμένοις

text_en: And the border of Manasses was from Aser , Machmethath which looks towards Sichem : and it goes out on the right hand by the inhabitants of the fountain of Taphua.
text_la: Fuitque terminus Manasse ab Aser, Machmethath quæ respicit Sichem : et egreditur ad dexteram juxta habitatores fontis Taphuæ.
text_pt: E o termo de Manassés foi desde Aser até Micmetá, que está defronte de Siquém; e estende-se este termo à direita até os moradores de En-Tapua.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ὅρια υἱῶν Μανασση Δηλαναθ ἥ ἐστιν κατὰ πρόσωπον υἱῶν Αναθ καὶ πορεύεται ἐπὶ τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ Ιαμιν καὶ Ιασσιβ ἐπὶ πηγὴν Θαφθωθ

text_en: For the lot of Manasses took in the land of Taphua, which is on the borders of Manasses , and belongs to the children of Ephraim.
text_la: Etenim in sorte Manasse ceciderat terra Taphuæ, quæ est juxta terminos Manasse filiorum Ephraim.
text_pt: Tinha Manassés a terra de Tapua; porém Tapua, junto ao termo de Manassés, pertencia aos filhos de Efraim.
text_el: τῷ Μανασση ἔσται καὶ Θαφεθ ἐπὶ τῶν ὁρίων Μανασση τοῖς υἱοῖς Εφραιμ

text_en: And the border goes down to the valley of the reeds, to the south of the torrent of the cities of Ephraim, which are in the midst of the cities of Manasses : the border of Manasses is on the north side of the torrent, and the outgoings of it are at the sea :
text_la: Descenditque terminus vallis arundineti in meridiem torrentis civitatum Ephraim, quæ in medio sunt urbium Manasse : terminus Manasse ab aquilone torrentis, et exitus ejus pergit ad mare:
text_pt: Então descia este termo ao ribeiro de Caná. A Efraim couberam as cidades ao sul do ribeiro, entre as cidades de Manassés; e o termo de Manassés estava ao norte do ribeiro, indo terminar no mar.
text_el: καὶ καταβήσεται τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ φάραγγα Καρανα ἐπὶ λίβα κατὰ φάραγγα Ιαριηλ τερέμινθος τῷ Εφραιμ ἀνὰ μέσον πόλεως Μανασση καὶ ὅρια Μανασση ἐπὶ τὸν βορρᾶν εἰς τὸν χειμάρρουν καὶ ἔσται αὐτοῦ ἡ διέξοδος θάλασσα

text_en: So that the possession of Ephraim is on the south, and on the north that of Manasses , and the sea is the border of both, and they are joined together in the tribe of Aser on the north, and in the tribe of Issachar on the east.
text_la: ita ut possessio Ephraim sit ab austro, et ab aquilone Manasse, et utramque claudat mare, et conjungantur sibi in tribu Aser ab aquilone, et in tribu Issachar ab oriente.
text_pt: Efraim ao sul, e Manassés ao norte, e o mar é o seu termo; pelo norte tocam em Aser, e pelo oriente em Issacar.
text_el: ἀπὸ λιβὸς τῷ Εφραιμ καὶ ἐπὶ βορρᾶν Μανασση καὶ ἔσται ἡ θάλασσα ὅρια αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ Ασηρ συνάψουσιν ἐπὶ βορρᾶν καὶ τῷ Ισσαχαρ ἀπ' ἀνατολῶν

text_en: And the inheritance of Manasses in Issachar and in Aser , was Bethsan and its villages , and Jeblaam with its villages , and the inhabitants of Dor, with the towns thereof: the inhabitants also of Endor with the villages thereof: and in like manner the inhabitants of Thenac with the villages thereof: and the inhabitants of Mageddo with their villages , and the third part of the city of Nopheth.
text_la: Fuitque hæreditas Manasse in Issachar et in Aser, Bethsan et viculi ejus, et Jeblaam cum viculis suis, et habitatores Dor cum oppidis suis, habitatores quoque Endor cum viculis suis : similiterque habitatores Thenac cum viculis suis, et habitatores Mageddo cum viculis suis, et tertia pars urbis Nopheth.
text_pt: Porque em Issacar e em Aser tinha Manassés a Bete-Seã e as suas vilas, e Ibleã e as suas vilas, e os habitantes de Dor e as suas vilas, e os habitantes de En-Dor e as suas vilas, e os habitantes de Taanaque e as suas vilas, e os habitantes de Megido e as suas vilas; três outeiros.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται Μανασση ἐν Ισσαχαρ καὶ ἐν Ασηρ Βαιθσαν καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Δωρ καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Μαγεδδω καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ τρίτον τῆς Ναφετα καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς

text_en: Neither could the children of Manasses overthrow these cities, but the Chanaanite began to dwell in his land.
text_la: Nec potuerunt filii Manasse has civitates subvertere, sed cœpit Chananæus habitare in terra sua.
text_pt: E os filhos de Manassés não puderam expulsar os habitantes daquelas cidades; porquanto os cananeus queriam habitar na mesma terra.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνάσθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Μανασση ἐξολεθρεῦσαι τὰς πόλεις ταύτας καὶ ἤρχετο ὁ Χαναναῖος κατοικεῖν ἐν τῇ γῇ ταύτῃ

text_en: But after that the children of Israel were grown strong, they subdued the Chanaanites , and made them their tributaries, and they did not kill them.
text_la: Postquam autem convaluerunt filii Israël, subjecerunt Chananæos, et fecerunt sibi tributarios, nec interfecerunt eos.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, engrossando em forças os filhos de Israel, fizeram tributários aos cananeus; porém não os expulsaram de todo.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη καὶ ἐπεὶ κατίσχυσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐποίησαν τοὺς Χαναναίους ὑπηκόους ἐξολεθρεῦσαι δὲ αὐτοὺς οὐκ ἐξωλέθρευσαν

text_en: And the children of Joseph spoke to Joshua , and said: Why have you given me but one lot and one portion to possess, whereas I am of so great a multitude, and the Lord has blessed me?
text_la: Locutique sunt filii Joseph ad Josue, et dixerunt : Quare dedisti mihi possessionem sortis et funiculi unius, cum sim tantæ multitudinis, et benedixerit mihi Dominus?
text_pt: Então os filhos de José falaram a Josué, dizendo: Por que me deste por herança só uma sorte e um quinhão, sendo eu um tão grande povo, visto que o Senhor até aqui me tem abençoado?
text_el: ἀντεῖπαν δὲ οἱ υἱοὶ Ιωσηφ τῷ Ἰησοῦ λέγοντες διὰ τί ἐκληρονόμησας ἡμᾶς κλῆρον ἕνα καὶ σχοίνισμα ἕν ἐγὼ δὲ λαὸς πολύς εἰμι καὶ ὁ θεὸς εὐλόγησέν με

text_en: And Joshua said to them: If you be a great people, go up into the woodland, and cut down room for yourself in the land of the Pherezite and the Raphaims: because the possession of mount Ephraim is too narrow for you.
text_la: Ad quos Josue ait : Si populus multus es, ascende in silvam, et succide tibi spatia in terra Pherezæi et Raphaim : quia angusta est tibi possessio montis Ephraim.
text_pt: E disse-lhes Josué: Se tão grande povo és, sobe ao bosque, e ali corta, para ti, lugar na terra dos perizeus e dos refains; pois que as montanhas de Efraim te são tão estreitas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς εἰ λαὸς πολὺς εἶ ἀνάβηθι εἰς τὸν δρυμὸν καὶ ἐκκάθαρον σεαυτῷ εἰ στενοχωρεῖ σε τὸ ὄρος τὸ Εφραιμ

text_en: And the children of Joseph answered him: We cannot go up to the mountains, for the Chanaanites that dwell in the low lands, wherein are situate Bethsan with its towns, and Jezrael in the midst of the valley, have chariots of iron.
text_la: Cui responderunt filii Joseph : Non poterimus ad montana conscendere, cum ferreis curribus utantur Chananæi, qui habitant in terra campestri, in qua sitæ sunt Bethsan cum viculis suis, et Jezraël mediam possidens vallem.
text_pt: Então disseram os filhos de José: As montanhas não nos bastariam; também carros de ferro há entre todos os cananeus que habitam na terra do vale, entre os de Bete-Seã e as suas vilas, e entre os que estão no vale de Jizreel.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν οὐκ ἀρκέσει ἡμῖν τὸ ὄρος τὸ Εφραιμ καὶ ἵππος ἐπίλεκτος καὶ σίδηρος τῷ Χαναναίῳ τῷ κατοικοῦντι ἐν αὐτῷ ἐν Βαιθσαν καὶ ἐν ταῖς κώμαις αὐτῆς ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι Ιεζραελ

text_en: And Joshua said to the house of Joseph , to Ephraim and Manasses : You are a great people, and of great strength, you shall not have one lot only:
text_la: Dixitque Josue ad domum Joseph, Ephraim et Manasse : Populus multus es, et magnæ fortitudinis : non habebis sortem unam,
text_pt: Então Josué falou à casa de José, a Efraim e a Manassés, dizendo: Grande povo és, e grande força tens; não terás uma sorte apenas;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰησοῦς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ιωσηφ εἰ λαὸς πολὺς εἶ καὶ ἰσχὺν μεγάλην ἔχεις οὐκ ἔσται σοι κλῆρος εἷς

text_en: But you shall pass to the mountain, and shall cut down the wood, and make yourself room to dwell in: and may proceed farther, when you have destroyed the Chanaanites , who as you say have iron chariots, and are very strong.
text_la: sed transibis ad montem, et succides tibi, atque purgabis ad habitandum spatia : et poteris ultra procedere cum subverteris Chananæum, quem dicis ferreos habere currus, et esse fortissimum.
text_pt: Porém as montanhas serão tuas. Ainda que é bosque, cortá-lo-ás, e as suas extremidades serão tuas; porque expulsarás os cananeus, ainda que tenham carros de ferro, ainda que sejam fortes.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ δρυμὸς ἔσται σοι ὅτι δρυμός ἐστιν καὶ ἐκκαθαριεῖς αὐτὸν καὶ ἔσται σοι καὶ ὅταν ἐξολεθρεύσῃς τὸν Χαναναῖον ὅτι ἵππος ἐπίλεκτός ἐστιν αὐτῷ σὺ γὰρ ὑπερισχύεις αὐτοῦ

text_en: And all the children of Israel assembled together in Silo, and there they set up the tabernacle of the testimony , and the land was subdued before them.
text_la: Congregatique sunt omnes filii Israël in Silo, ibique fixerunt tabernaculum testimonii, et fuit eis terra subjecta.
text_pt: E Toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel se reuniu em Siló, e ali armaram a tenda da congregação, depois que a terra lhes foi sujeita.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεκκλησιάσθη πᾶσα συναγωγὴ υἱῶν Ισραηλ εἰς Σηλω καὶ ἔπηξαν ἐκεῖ τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ ἡ γῆ ἐκρατήθη ὑπ' αὐτῶν

text_en: But there remained seven tribes of the children of Israel , which as yet had not received their possessions.
text_la: Remanserant autem filiorum Israël septem tribus, quæ necdum acceperant possessiones suas.
text_pt: E dentre os filhos de Israel ficaram sete tribos que ainda não tinham repartido a sua herança.
text_el: καὶ κατελείφθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ οἳ οὐκ ἐκληρονόμησαν ἑπτὰ φυλαί

text_en: And Joshua said to them: How long are you indolent and slack , and go not in to possess the land which the Lord the God of your fathers has given you?
text_la: Ad quos Josue ait : Usquequo marcetis ignavia, et non intratis ad possidendam terram, quam Dominus Deus patrum vestrorum dedit vobis?
text_pt: E disse Josué aos filhos de Israel: Até quando sereis negligentes em chegardes para possuir a terra que o Senhor Deus de vossos pais vos deu?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰησοῦς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἕως τίνος ἐκλυθήσεσθε κληρονομῆσαι τὴν γῆν ἣν ἔδωκεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν

text_en: Choose of every tribe three men , that I may send them, and they may go and compass the land, and mark it out according to the number of each multitude: and bring back to me what they have marked out.
text_la: Eligite de singulis tribubus ternos viros, ut mittam eos, et pergant atque circumeant terram, et describant eam juxta numerum uniuscujusque multitudinis : referantque ad me quod descripserint.
text_pt: De cada tribo escolhei vós três homens, para que eu os envie, e eles se levantem e percorram a terra, e a demarquem segundo as suas heranças, e voltem a mim.
text_el: δότε ἐξ ὑμῶν τρεῖς ἄνδρας ἐκ φυλῆς καὶ ἀναστάντες διελθέτωσαν τὴν γῆν καὶ διαγραψάτωσαν αὐτὴν ἐναντίον μου καθὰ δεήσει διελεῖν αὐτήν καὶ ἤλθοσαν πρὸς αὐτόν

text_en: Divide to yourselves the land into seven parts: let Juda be in his bounds on the south side, and the house of Joseph on the north.
text_la: Dividite vobis terram in septem partes : Judas sit in terminis suis ab australi plaga, et domus Joseph ab aquilone.
text_pt: E dividi-la-ão em sete partes: Judá ficará no seu termo para o sul, e a casa de José ficará no seu termo para o norte.
text_el: καὶ διεῖλεν αὐτοῖς ἑπτὰ μερίδας Ιουδας στήσεται αὐτοῖς ὅριον ἀπὸ λιβός καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ιωσηφ στήσονται αὐτοῖς ἀπὸ βορρᾶ

text_en: The land in the midst between these mark out into seven parts; and you shall come hither to me, that I may cast lots for you before the Lord your God .
text_la: Mediam inter hos terram in septem partes describite : et huc venietis ad me, ut coram Domino Deo vestro mittam vobis hic sortem:
text_pt: E vós demarcareis a terra em sete partes, e me trareis a mim aqui descrita, para que eu aqui lance as sortes perante o Senhor nosso Deus,
text_el: ὑμεῖς δὲ μερίσατε τὴν γῆν ἑπτὰ μερίδας καὶ ἐνέγκατε πρός με ὧδε καὶ ἐξοίσω ὑμῖν κλῆρον ἔναντι κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: For the Levites have no part among you, but the priesthood of the Lord is their inheritance. And Gad and Ruben , and the half tribe of Manasses have already received their possessions beyond the Jordan eastward: which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them.
text_la: quia non est inter vos pars Levitarum, sed sacerdotium Domini est eorum hæreditas. Gad autem et Ruben, et dimidia tribus Manasse, jam acceperant possessiones suas trans Jordanem ad orientalem plagam, quas dedit eis Moyses famulus Domini.
text_pt: Porquanto os levitas não têm parte no meio de vós, porque o sacerdócio do Senhor é a sua parte; e Gade, e Rúben, e a meia tribo de Manassés, receberam a sua herança além do Jordão para o oriente, a qual lhes deu Moisés, o servo do Senhor.
text_el: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν μερὶς τοῖς υἱοῖς Λευι ἐν ὑμῖν ἱερατεία γὰρ κυρίου μερὶς αὐτοῦ καὶ Γαδ καὶ Ρουβην καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ φυλῆς Μανασση ἐλάβοσαν τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτῶν πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἐπ' ἀνατολάς ἣν ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς ὁ παῖς κυρίου

text_en: And when the men were risen up, to go to mark out the land, Joshua commanded them saying: Go round the land and mark it out, and return to me: that I may cast lots for you before the Lord in Silo.
text_la: Cumque surrexissent viri, ut pergerent ad describendam terram, præcepit eis Josue, dicens : Circuite terram, et describite eam, ac revertimini ad me : ut hic coram Domino, in Silo, mittam vobis sortem.
text_pt: Então aqueles homens se levantaram e se foram; e Josué deu ordem aos que iam demarcar a terra, dizendo: Ide, e percorrei a terra, e demarcai-a, e então voltai a mim, e aqui vos lançarei as sortes perante o Senhor, em Siló.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστάντες οἱ ἄνδρες ἐπορεύθησαν καὶ ἐνετείλατο Ἰησοῦς τοῖς ἀνδράσιν τοῖς πορευομένοις χωροβατῆσαι τὴν γῆν λέγων πορεύεσθε καὶ χωροβατήσατε τὴν γῆν καὶ παραγενήθητε πρός με καὶ ὧδε ἐξοίσω ὑμῖν κλῆρον ἔναντι κυρίου ἐν Σηλω

text_en: So they went and surveying it divided it into seven parts, writing them down in a book. And they returned to Joshua , to the camp in Silo.
text_la: Itaque perrexerunt : et lustrantes eam, in septem partes diviserunt, scribentes in volumine. Reversique sunt ad Josue in castra Silo.
text_pt: Foram, pois, aqueles homens, e passaram pela terra, e a demarcaram, em sete partes segundo as cidades, descrevendo-a num livro; e voltaram a Josué, ao arraial em Siló.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν καὶ ἐχωροβάτησαν τὴν γῆν καὶ εἴδοσαν αὐτὴν καὶ ἔγραψαν αὐτὴν κατὰ πόλεις αὐτῆς ἑπτὰ μερίδας εἰς βιβλίον καὶ ἤνεγκαν πρὸς Ἰησοῦν

text_en: And he cast lots before the Lord in Silo, and divided the land to the children of Israel into seven parts.
text_la: Qui misit sortes coram Domino in Silo, divisitque terram filiis Israël in septem partes.
text_pt: Então Josué lhes lançou as sortes em Siló, perante o Senhor; e ali repartiu Josué a terra aos filhos de Israel, conforme às suas divisões.
text_el: καὶ ἐνέβαλεν αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς κλῆρον ἐν Σηλω ἔναντι κυρίου

text_en: And first came up the lot of the children of Benjamin by their families , to possess the land between the children of Juda , and the children of Joseph .
text_la: Et ascendit sors prima filiorum Benjamin per familias suas, ut possiderent terram inter filios Juda et filios Joseph.
text_pt: E tirou a sorte da tribo dos filhos de Benjamim, segundo as suas famílias; e coube-lhe o termo da sua sorte entre os filhos de Judá e os filhos de José.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος φυλῆς Βενιαμιν πρῶτος κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὅρια τοῦ κλήρου αὐτῶν ἀνὰ μέσον Ιουδα καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν υἱῶν Ιωσηφ

text_en: And their border northward was from the Jordan : going along by the side of Jericho on the north side, and thence going up westward to the mountains, and reaching to the wilderness of Bethaven,
text_la: Fuitque terminus eorum contra aquilonem a Jordane : pergens juxta latus Jericho septentrionalis plagæ, et inde contra occidentem ad montana conscendens et perveniens ad solitudinem Bethaven,
text_pt: E o seu termo foi para o lado do norte, desde o Jordão; e sobe aquele termo ao lado de Jericó para o norte, e sobe pela montanha para o ocidente, terminando no deserto de Bete-Áven.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη αὐτῶν τὰ ὅρια ἀπὸ βορρᾶ ἀπὸ τοῦ Ιορδάνου προσαναβήσεται τὰ ὅρια κατὰ νώτου Ιεριχω ἀπὸ βορρᾶ καὶ ἀναβήσεται ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ ἔσται αὐτοῦ ἡ διέξοδος ἡ Μαδβαρῖτις Βαιθων

text_en: and passing along southward by Luza, the same is Bethel , and it goes down into Ataroth-addar to the mountain, that is on the south of the nether Beth-horon.
text_la: atque pertransiens juxta Luzam ad meridiem, ipsa est Bethel : descenditque in Ataroth Addar, in montem qui est ad meridiem Beth-horon inferioris:
text_pt: E dali passa este termo a Luz, ao lado de Luz (que é Betel), para o sul; e desce a Atarote-Adar, ao pé do monte que está do lado do sul de Bete-Horom de baixo;
text_el: καὶ διελεύσεται ἐκεῖθεν τὰ ὅρια Λουζα ἐπὶ νώτου Λουζα ἀπὸ λιβός αὕτη ἐστὶν Βαιθηλ καὶ καταβήσεται τὰ ὅρια Μααταρωθορεχ ἐπὶ τὴν ὀρεινήν ἥ ἐστιν πρὸς λίβα Βαιθωρων ἡ κάτω

text_en: And it bends thence going round towards the sea, south of the mountain that looks towards Beth-horon to the southwest: and the outgoings thereof are into Cariathbaal, which is called also Cariathiarim, a city of the children of Juda This is their coast towards the sea, westward.
text_la: et inclinatur circuiens contra mare ad meridiem montis qui respicit Beth-horon contra Africum : suntque exitus ejus in Cariath-baal, quæ vocatur et Cariathiarim, urbem filiorum Juda. Hæc est plaga contra mare, ad occidentem.
text_pt: E vai este termo e volta ao lado do ocidente para o sul do monte que está defronte de Bete-Horom, para o sul, terminando em Quiriate-Baal (que é Quiriate-Jearim), cidade dos filhos de Judá; esta é a sua extensão para o ocidente.
text_el: καὶ διελεύσεται τὰ ὅρια καὶ περιελεύσεται ἐπὶ τὸ μέρος τὸ βλέπον παρὰ θάλασσαν ἀπὸ λιβὸς ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους ἐπὶ πρόσωπον Βαιθωρων λίβα καὶ ἔσται αὐτοῦ ἡ διέξοδος εἰς Καριαθβααλ αὕτη ἐστὶν Καριαθιαριν πόλις υἱῶν Ιουδα τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ μέρος τὸ πρὸς θάλασσαν

text_en: But on the south side the border goes out from part of Cariathiarim towards the sea, and comes to the fountain of the waters of Nephtoa.
text_la: A meridie autem ex parte Cariathiarim egreditur terminus contra mare, et pervenit usque ad fontem aquarum Nephtoa.
text_pt: E a sua extensão para o sul começa na extremidade de Quiriate-Jearim; e vai este termo ao ocidente e segue até à fonte das águas de Neftoa.
text_el: καὶ μέρος τὸ πρὸς λίβα ἀπὸ μέρους Καριαθβααλ καὶ διελεύσεται ὅρια εἰς Γασιν ἐπὶ πηγὴν ὕδατος Ναφθω

text_en: And it goes down to that part of the mountain that looks on the valley of the children of Ennom: and is over against the north quarter in the furthermost part of the valley of Raphaim, and it goes down into Geennom (that is the valley of Ennom) by the side of the Jebusite to the south: and comes to the fountain of Rogel,
text_la: Descenditque in partem montis, qui respicit vallem filiorum Ennom : et est contra septentrionalem plagam in extrema parte vallis Raphaim. Descenditque in Geennom (id est, vallem Ennom) juxta latus Jebusæi ad austrum : et pervenit ad fontem Rogel,
text_pt: E desce este termo até à extremidade do monte que está defronte do vale do filho de Hinom, que está no vale dos refains para o norte, e desce pelo vale de Hinom do lado dos jebuseus para o sul; e então desce a En-Rogel;
text_el: καὶ καταβήσεται τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ μέρους τοῦ ὄρους ὅ ἐστιν κατὰ πρόσωπον νάπης Ονναμ ὅ ἐστιν ἐκ μέρους Εμεκραφαϊν ἀπὸ βορρᾶ καὶ καταβήσεται Γαιεννα ἐπὶ νώτου Ιεβουσαι ἀπὸ λιβὸς καὶ καταβήσεται ἐπὶ πηγὴν Ρωγηλ

text_en: passing thence to the north, and going out to Ensemes, that is to say, the fountain of the sun:
text_la: transiens ad aquilonem, et egrediens ad Ensemes, id est, fontem solis:
text_pt: E vai desde o norte, e chega a En-Semes; e dali sai a Gelilote, que está defronte da subida de Adumim, e desce à pedra de Boã, filho de Rúben;
text_el: καὶ διελεύσεται ἐπὶ πηγὴν Βαιθσαμυς καὶ παρελεύσεται ἐπὶ Γαλιλωθ ἥ ἐστιν ἀπέναντι πρὸς ἀνάβασιν Αιθαμιν καὶ καταβήσεται ἐπὶ λίθον Βαιων υἱῶν Ρουβην

text_en: And it passes along to the hills that are over against the ascent of Adommim: and it goes down to Abenboen, that is, the stone of Boen the son of Ruben : and it passes on the north side to the champaign countries; and goes down into the plain,
text_la: et pertransit usque ad tumulos, qui sunt e regione ascensus Adommim : descenditque ad Abenboën, id est, lapidem Boën filii Ruben : et pertransit ex latere aquilonis ad campestria : descenditque in planitiem,
text_pt: E passa até ao lado, defronte de Arabá, para o norte, e desce a Arabá.
text_el: καὶ διελεύσεται κατὰ νώτου Βαιθαραβα ἀπὸ βορρᾶ καὶ καταβήσεται

text_en: and it passes by Bethhagla northward: and the outgoings thereof are towards the north of the most salt sea at the south end of the Jordan .
text_la: et prætergreditur contra aquilonem Beth Hagla : suntque exitus ejus contra linguam maris salsissimi ab aquilone in fine Jordanis ad australem plagam:
text_pt: Passa mais este termo até ao lado de Bete-Hogla, para o norte, saindo esse termo na baía do Mar Salgado, para o norte, na extremidade do Jordão, para o sul; este é o termo do sul.
text_el: ἐπὶ τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ νώτου Βαιθαγλα ἀπὸ βορρᾶ καὶ ἔσται ἡ διέξοδος τῶν ὁρίων ἐπὶ λοφιὰν τῆς θαλάσσης τῶν ἁλῶν ἐπὶ βορρᾶν εἰς μέρος τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἀπὸ λιβός ταῦτα τὰ ὅριά ἐστιν ἀπὸ λιβός

text_en: Which is the border of it on the east side. This is the possession of the children of Benjamin by their borders round about, and their families .
text_la: qui est terminus illius ab oriente. Hæc est possessio filiorum Benjamin per terminos suos in circuitu, et familias suas.
text_pt: E o Jordão será seu termo do lado do oriente; esta é a herança dos filhos de Benjamim, nos seus termos em redor, segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: καὶ ὁ Ιορδάνης ὁριεῖ ἀπὸ μέρους ἀνατολῶν αὕτη ἡ κληρονομία υἱῶν Βενιαμιν τὰ ὅρια αὐτῆς κύκλῳ κατὰ δήμους

text_en: And their cities were, Jericho and Bethhagla and Vale-Casis,
text_la: Fueruntque civitates ejus, Jericho et Beth Hagla et vallis Casis,
text_pt: E as cidades da tribo dos filhos de Benjamim, segundo as suas famílias, são: Jericó, e Bete-Hogla, e Emeque-Queziz,
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθησαν αἱ πόλεις τῶν υἱῶν Βενιαμιν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν Ιεριχω καὶ Βαιθεγλιω καὶ Αμεκασις

text_en: Betharaba and Samaraim and Bethel ,
text_la: Beth Araba et Samaraim et Bethel
text_pt: E Bete-Arabá, e Zemaraim, e Betel,
text_el: καὶ Βαιθαβαρα καὶ Σαρα καὶ Βησανα

text_en: and Avim and Aphara and Ophera,
text_la: et Avim et Aphara et Ophera,
text_pt: E Avim, e Pará, e Ofra,
text_el: καὶ Αιιν καὶ Φαρα καὶ Εφραθα

text_en: the town Emona and Ophni and Gabee: twelve cities, and their villages .
text_la: villa Emona et Ophni et Gabee : civitates duodecim, et villæ earum.
text_pt: E Quefar-Amonai, e Ofni e Gaba: doze cidades e as suas aldeias;
text_el: καὶ Καραφα καὶ Κεφιρα καὶ Μονι καὶ Γαβαα πόλεις δέκα δύο καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: Gabam and Rama and Beroth ,
text_la: Gabaon et Rama et Beroth,
text_pt: Gibeão, e Ramá e Beerote,
text_el: Γαβαων καὶ Ραμα καὶ Βεηρωθα

text_en: and Mesphe, and Caphara, and Amosa,
text_la: et Mesphe et Caphara, et Amosa
text_pt: E Mizpá, e Cefira e Moza,
text_el: καὶ Μασσημα καὶ Μιρων καὶ Αμωκη

text_en: and Recem, Jarephel, and Tharela,
text_la: et Recem, Jarephel et Tharela,
text_pt: E Requém e Irpeel, e Tarala,
text_el: καὶ Φιρα καὶ Καφαν καὶ Νακαν καὶ Σεληκαν καὶ Θαρεηλα

text_en: and Sela, Eleph and Jebus, which is Jerusalem , Gabaath and Cariath: fourteen cities, and their villages . This is the possession of the children of Benjamin by their families .
text_la: et Sela, Eleph, et Jebus, quæ est Jerusalem, Gabaath et Cariath : civitates quatuordecim, et villæ earum. Hæc est possessio filiorum Benjamin juxta familias suas.
text_pt: E Zela, Elefe, e Jebus (esta é Jerusalém), Gibeá e Quiriate: catorze cidades com as suas aldeias; esta é a herança dos filhos de Benjamim, segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: καὶ Ιεβους αὕτη ἐστὶν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ πόλεις καὶ Γαβαωθιαριμ πόλεις τρεῖς καὶ δέκα καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν αὕτη ἡ κληρονομία υἱῶν Βενιαμιν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν

text_en: And the second lot came forth for the children of Simeon by their kindreds: and their inheritance was
text_la: Et egressa est sors secunda filiorum Simeon per cognationes suas : fuitque hæreditas
text_pt: E Saiu a segunda sorte a Simeão, para a tribo dos filhos de Simeão, segundo as suas famílias; e foi a sua herança no meio da herança dos filhos de Judá.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ δεύτερος κλῆρος τῶν υἱῶν Συμεων καὶ ἐγενήθη ἡ κληρονομία αὐτῶν ἀνὰ μέσον κλήρων υἱῶν Ιουδα

text_en: in the midst of the possession of the children of Juda : Bersabee and Sabee and Molada,
text_la: eorum in medio possessionis filiorum Juda : Bersabee et Sabee et Molada
text_pt: E tiveram na sua herança: Berseba, e Seba e Moladá.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ὁ κλῆρος αὐτῶν Βηρσαβεε καὶ Σαμαα καὶ Κωλαδαμ

text_en: and Hasersual, Bala and Asem,
text_la: et Hasersual, Bala et Asem
text_pt: E Hazar-Sual, e Balá, e Azem,
text_el: καὶ Αρσωλα καὶ Βωλα καὶ Ασομ

text_en: and Eltholad, Bethul and Harma,
text_la: et Eltholad, Bethul et Harma
text_pt: E Eltolade, e Betul, e Hormá,
text_el: καὶ Ελθουλα καὶ Βουλα καὶ Ερμα

text_en: and Siceleg and Bethmarchaboth and Hasersusa,
text_la: et Siceleg et Bethmarchaboth et Hasersusa
text_pt: E Ziclague, e Bete-Marcabote, e Hazar-Susa,
text_el: καὶ Σικελακ καὶ Βαιθμαχερεβ καὶ Σαρσουσιν

text_en: and Bethlebaoth and Sarohen: thirteen cities, and their villages .
text_la: et Bethlebaoth et Sarohen : civitates tredecim, et villæ earum.
text_pt: E Bete-Lebaote, e Saruém; treze cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: καὶ Βαθαρωθ καὶ οἱ ἀγροὶ αὐτῶν πόλεις δέκα τρεῖς καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: And Remmon and Athor and Asan: four cities, and their villages .
text_la: Ain et Remmon et Athar et Asan : civitates quatuor, et villæ earum:
text_pt: E Aim, e Rimom, e Eter, e Asã; quatro cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: Ερεμμων καὶ Θαλχα καὶ Εθερ καὶ Ασαν πόλεις τέσσαρες καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: And all the villages round about these cities to Baalath Beer Ramath to the south quarter. This is the inheritance of the children of Simeon according to their kindreds,
text_la: omnes viculi per circuitum urbium istarum usque ad Baalath Beer Ramath contra australem plagam. Hæc est hæreditas filiorum Simeon juxta cognationes suas,
text_pt: E todas as aldeias que havia em redor destas cidades, até Baalate-Ber (que é Ramá), do sul; esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: κύκλῳ τῶν πόλεων αὐτῶν ἕως Βαρεκ πορευομένων Βαμεθ κατὰ λίβα αὕτη ἡ κληρονομία φυλῆς υἱῶν Συμεων κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν

text_en: in the possession and lot of the children of Juda : because it was too great, and therefore the children of Simeon had their possession in the midst of their inheritance.
text_la: in possessione et funiculo filiorum Juda : quia major erat, et idcirco filii Simeon possederunt in medio hæreditatis eorum.
text_pt: A herança dos filhos de Simeão foi tirada do quinhão dos de Judá, porquanto a herança dos filhos de Judá era demasiadamente grande para eles; pelo que os filhos de Simeão tiveram a sua herança no meio deles.
text_el: ἀπὸ τοῦ κλήρου Ιουδα ἡ κληρονομία φυλῆς υἱῶν Συμεων ὅτι ἐγενήθη ἡ μερὶς υἱῶν Ιουδα μείζων τῆς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκληρονόμησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Συμεων ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ κλήρου αὐτῶν

text_en: And the third lot fell to the children of Zabulon by their kindreds: and the border of their possession was unto Sarid.
text_la: Ceciditque sors tertia filiorum Zabulon per cognationes suas : factus est terminus possessionis eorum usque Sarid.
text_pt: E saiu a terceira sorte pelos filhos de Zebulom, segundo as suas famílias; e foi o termo da sua herança até Saride.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος ὁ τρίτος τῷ Ζαβουλων κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν ἔσται τὰ ὅρια τῆς κληρονομίας αὐτῶν Εσεδεκ

text_en: And it went up from the sea and from Merala, and came to Debbaseth: as far as the torrent, which is over against Jeconam.
text_la: Ascenditque de mari et Merala, et pervenit in Debbaseth, usque ad torrentem qui est contra Jeconam.
text_pt: E sobe o seu termo pelo ocidente a Maralá, e vai até Dabesete, e chega também até ao ribeiro que está defronte de Jocneão.
text_el: Γωλα ὅρια αὐτῶν ἡ θάλασσα καὶ Μαραγελλα καὶ συνάψει ἐπὶ Βαιθαραβα εἰς τὴν φάραγγα ἥ ἐστιν κατὰ πρόσωπον Ιεκμαν

text_en: And it returns from Sarid eastward to the borders of Ceseleththabor: and it goes out to Dabereth and ascends towards Japhie.
text_la: Et revertitur de Sared contra orientem in fines Ceseleththabor : et egreditur ad Dabereth, ascenditque contra Japhie.
text_pt: E de Saride volta para o oriente, para o nascente do sol, até ao termo de Quislote-Tabor, sai a Daberate, e vai subindo a Jafia.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστρεψεν ἀπὸ Σεδδουκ ἐξ ἐναντίας ἀπ' ἀνατολῶν Βαιθσαμυς ἐπὶ τὰ ὅρια Χασελωθαιθ καὶ διελεύσεται ἐπὶ Δαβιρωθ καὶ προσαναβήσεται ἐπὶ Φαγγαι

text_en: And it passes along from thence to the east side of Gethhepher and Thacasin: and goes out to Remmon, Amthar and Noa.
text_la: Et inde pertransit usque ad orientalem plagam Gethepher et Thacasin : et egreditur in Remmon, Amthar et Noa.
text_pt: E dali passa pelo oriente, para o nascente, a Gate-Hefer, em Ete-Cazim, chegando a Rimom-Metoar, que vai até Neá;
text_el: καὶ ἐκεῖθεν περιελεύσεται ἐξ ἐναντίας ἐπ' ἀνατολὰς ἐπὶ Γεβερε ἐπὶ πόλιν Κατασεμ καὶ διελεύσεται ἐπὶ Ρεμμωνα Αμαθαρ Αοζα

text_en: And it turns about to the north of Hanathon: and the outgoings thereof are the valley of Jephtahel,
text_la: Et circuit ad aquilonem Hanathon : suntque egressus ejus vallis Jephthaël,
text_pt: E rodeando-a, passa o termo para o norte a Hanatom, chegando ao vale de Iftá-El,
text_el: καὶ περιελεύσεται ὅρια ἐπὶ βορρᾶν ἐπὶ Αμωθ καὶ ἔσται ἡ διέξοδος αὐτῶν ἐπὶ Γαιφαηλ

text_en: and Cateth and Naalol and Semeron and Jedala and Bethlehem : twelve cities and their villages .
text_la: et Cateth et Naalol et Semeron et Jerala et Bethlehem : civitates duodecim, et villæ earum.
text_pt: E Catate, Naalal, e Sinrom, e Idala, e Belém; doze cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: καὶ Καταναθ καὶ Ναβααλ καὶ Συμοων καὶ Ιεριχω καὶ Βαιθμαν

text_en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Zabulon by their kindreds, the cities and their villages .
text_la: Hæc est hæreditas tribus filiorum Zabulon per cognationes suas, urbes et viculi earum.
text_pt: Esta é a herança dos filhos de Zebulom, segundo as suas famílias; estas cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ κληρονομία φυλῆς υἱῶν Ζαβουλων κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν πόλεις καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: The fourth lot came out to Issachar by their kindreds.
text_la: Issachar egressa est sors quarta per cognationes suas:
text_pt: A quarta sorte saiu para Issacar; aos filhos de Issacar, segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Ισσαχαρ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος ὁ τέταρτος

text_en: And his inheritance was Jezrael and Casaloth and Sunem,
text_la: fuitque ejus hæreditas Jezraël et Casaloth et Sunem
text_pt: E foi o seu termo Jizreel, e Quesulote e Suném,
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη τὰ ὅρια αὐτῶν Ιαζηλ καὶ Χασαλωθ καὶ Σουναν

text_en: and Hapharaim and Seon and Anaharath,
text_la: et Hapharaim et Seon, et Anaharath
text_pt: E Hafaraim, e Siom, e Anaarate,
text_el: καὶ Αγιν καὶ Σιωνα καὶ Ρεηρωθ καὶ Αναχερεθ

text_en: and Rabboth and Cesion, Abes,
text_la: et Rabboth et Cesion, Abes,
text_pt: E Rabite e Quisiom, e Ebes,
text_el: καὶ Δαβιρων καὶ Κισων καὶ Ρεβες

text_en: and Rameth and Engannim and Enhadda and Bethpheses.
text_la: et Rameth, et Engannim, et Enhadda et Bethpheses.
text_pt: E Remete, e En-Ganim, e En-Hadá, e Bete-Pazez.
text_el: καὶ Ρεμμας καὶ Ιεων καὶ Τομμαν καὶ Αιμαρεκ καὶ Βηρσαφης

text_en: And the border thereof comes to Thabor and Sehesima and Bethsames: and the outgoings thereof shall be at the Jordan : sixteen cities, and their villages .
text_la: Et pervenit terminus ejus usque Thabor et Sehesima et Bethsames, eruntque exitus ejus Jordanis : civitates sedecim, et villæ earum.
text_pt: E chega este termo até Tabor, e Saazima, e Bete-Semes; e vai terminar no Jordão; dezesseis cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: καὶ συνάψει τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ Γαιθβωρ καὶ ἐπὶ Σαλιμ κατὰ θάλασσαν καὶ Βαιθσαμυς καὶ ἔσται αὐτοῦ ἡ διέξοδος τῶν ὁρίων ὁ Ιορδάνης

text_en: This is the possession of the sons of Issachar by their kindreds, the cities and their villages .
text_la: Hæc est possessio filiorum Issachar per cognationes suas, urbes et viculi earum.
text_pt: Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Issacar, segundo as suas famílias; estas cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ κληρονομία φυλῆς υἱῶν Ισσαχαρ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν αἱ πόλεις καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: And the fifth lot fell to the tribe of the children of Aser by their kindreds:
text_la: Ceciditque sors quinta tribui filiorum Aser per cognationes suas:
text_pt: E saiu a quinta sorte para a tribo dos filhos de Aser, segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος ὁ πέμπτος Ασηρ

text_en: And their border was Halcath and Chali and Beten and Axaph,
text_la: fuitque terminus eorum Halcath et Chali et Beten et Axaph
text_pt: E foi o seu termo Helcate, e Hali, e Béten, e Acsafe,
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη τὰ ὅρια αὐτῶν ἐξ Ελεκεθ καὶ Αλεφ καὶ Βαιθοκ καὶ Κεαφ

text_en: and Elmelech and Amaad and Messal: and it reaches to Carmel by the sea and Sihor and Labanath,
text_la: et Elmelech et Amaad et Messal : et pervenit usque ad Carmelum maris et Sihor et Labanath,
text_pt: E Alameleque, e Amade, e Misal; e chega ao Carmelo para o ocidente, e a Sior-Libnate;
text_el: καὶ Ελιμελεκ καὶ Αμιηλ καὶ Μαασα καὶ συνάψει τῷ Καρμήλῳ κατὰ θάλασσαν καὶ τῷ Σιων καὶ Λαβαναθ

text_en: and it returns towards the east to Bethdagon : and passes along to Zabulon and to the valley of Jephthael towards the north to Bethemec and Nehiel. And it goes out to the left side of Cabul,
text_la: ac revertitur contra orientem Bethdagon : et pertransit usque Zabulon et vallem Jephthaël contra aquilonem in Bethemec et Nehiel. Egrediturque ad lævam Cabul,
text_pt: E volta para o nascente do sol a Bete-Dagom, e chega a Zebulom e ao vale de Iftá-El, ao norte de Bete-Emeque e de Neiel, e vem sair a Cabul, pela esquerda,
text_el: καὶ ἐπιστρέψει ἀπ' ἀνατολῶν ἡλίου καὶ Βαιθεγενεθ καὶ συνάψει τῷ Ζαβουλων καὶ ἐκ Γαι καὶ Φθαιηλ κατὰ βορρᾶν καὶ εἰσελεύσεται ὅρια Σαφθαιβαιθμε καὶ Ιναηλ καὶ διελεύσεται εἰς Χωβα μασομελ

text_en: and to Abaran and Rohob and Hamon and Cana , as far as the great Sidon .
text_la: et Abran et Rohob et Hamon et Cana, usque ad Sidonem magnam.
text_pt: E Hebrom, e Reobe, e Hamom, e Caná, até à grande Sidom.
text_el: καὶ Ελβων καὶ Ρααβ καὶ Εμεμαων καὶ Κανθαν ἕως Σιδῶνος τῆς μεγάλης

text_en: And it returns to Horma to the strong city of Tyre , and to Hosa: and the outgoings thereof shall be at the sea from the portion of Achziba:
text_la: Revertiturque in Horma usque ad civitatem munitissimam Tyrum, et usque Hosa : eruntque exitus ejus in mare de funiculo Achziba:
text_pt: E volta este termo a Ramá, e até à forte cidade de Tiro; então torna este termo a Hosa, para terminar no mar, na região de Aczibe.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστρέψει τὰ ὅρια εἰς Ραμα καὶ ἕως πηγῆς Μασφασσατ καὶ τῶν Τυρίων καὶ ἀναστρέψει τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ Ιασιφ καὶ ἔσται ἡ διέξοδος αὐτοῦ ἡ θάλασσα καὶ ἀπὸ Λεβ καὶ Εχοζοβ

text_en: And Amma and Aphec and Rohob: twenty-two cities, and their villages .
text_la: et Amma et Aphec et Rohob : civitates viginti duæ, et villæ earum.
text_pt: E Umá, e Afeque, e Reobe; vinte e duas cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: καὶ Αρχωβ καὶ Αφεκ καὶ Ρααυ

text_en: This is the possession of the children of Aser by their kindreds, and the cities and their villages .
text_la: Hæc est possessio filiorum Aser per cognationes suas, urbesque et viculi earum.
text_pt: Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Aser, segundo as suas famílias; estas cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ κληρονομία φυλῆς υἱῶν Ασηρ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν πόλεις καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: The sixth lot came out to the sons of Nephtali by their families :
text_la: Filiorum Nephthali sexta sors cecidit per familias suas:
text_pt: E saiu a sexta sorte para os filhos de Naftali, segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Νεφθαλι ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος ὁ ἕκτος

text_en: And the border began from Heleph and Elon to Saananim, and Adami, which is Neceb, and Jebnael even to Lecum:
text_la: et cœpit terminus de Heleph et Elon in Saananim, et Adami, quæ est Neceb, et Jebnaël usque Lecum : et egressus eorum usque ad Jordanem:
text_pt: E foi o seu termo desde Helefe e desde Alom em Zaananim, e Adami-Neguebe, e Jabneel, até Lacum, terminando no Jordão.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη τὰ ὅρια αὐτῶν Μοολαμ καὶ Μωλα καὶ Βεσεμιιν καὶ Αρμε καὶ Ναβωκ καὶ Ιεφθαμαι ἕως Δωδαμ καὶ ἐγενήθησαν αἱ διέξοδοι αὐτοῦ ὁ Ιορδάνης

text_en: And the border returns westward to Azanotthabor, and goes out from thence to Hucuca, and passes along to Zabulon southward, and to Aser westward, and to Juda upon the Jordan towards the rising of the sun.
text_la: revertiturque terminus contra occidentem in Azanotthabor, atque inde egreditur in Hucuca, et pertransit in Zabulon contra meridiem, et in Aser contra occidentem, et in Juda ad Jordanem contra ortum solis:
text_pt: E volta este termo pelo ocidente a Aznote-Tabor, e dali passa a Hucoque; e chega a Zebulom ao sul, e chega a Aser ao ocidente, e a Judá pelo Jordão, ao nascente do sol.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιστρέψει τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ θάλασσαν Εναθ Θαβωρ καὶ διελεύσεται ἐκεῖθεν ιακανα καὶ συνάψει τῷ Ζαβουλων ἀπὸ νότου καὶ Ασηρ συνάψει κατὰ θάλασσαν καὶ ὁ Ιορδάνης ἀπ' ἀνατολῶν ἡλίου

text_en: And the strong cities are Assedim, Ser, and Emath, and Reccath and Cenereth,
text_la: civitates munitissimæ, Assedim, Ser, et Emath, et Reccath et Cenereth,
text_pt: E são as cidades fortificadas: Zidim, Zer, e Hamate, Racate e Quinerete,
text_el: καὶ αἱ πόλεις τειχήρεις τῶν Τυρίων Τύρος καὶ Ωμαθα Δακεθ καὶ Κενερεθ

text_en: and Edema and Arama, Asor,
text_la: et Edema et Arama, Asor
text_pt: E Adama, e Ramá, e Hazor,
text_el: καὶ Αρμαιθ καὶ Αραηλ καὶ Ασωρ

text_en: and Cedes and Edri, Enhasor,
text_la: et Cedes et Edrai, Enhasor,
text_pt: E Quedes, e Edrei, e En-Hazor,
text_el: καὶ Καδες καὶ Ασσαρι καὶ πηγὴ Ασορ

text_en: and Jeron and Magdalel , Horem, and Bethanath and Bethsames: nineteen cities, and their villages .
text_la: et Jeron et Magdalel, Horem et Bethanath et Bethsames : civitates decem et novem, et villæ earum.
text_pt: E Irom, e Migdal-El, Horém e Bete-Anate, e Bete-Semes; dezenove cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: καὶ Κερωε καὶ Μεγαλα Αριμ καὶ Βαιθθαμε καὶ Θεσσαμυς

text_en: This is the possession of the tribe of the children of Nephtali by their kindreds, the cities and their villages .
text_la: Hæc est possessio tribus filiorum Nephthali per cognationes suas, urbes et viculi earum.
text_pt: Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Naftali, segundo as suas famílias; estas cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ κληρονομία φυλῆς υἱῶν Νεφθαλι

text_en: The seventh lot came out to the tribe of the children of Dan by their families ,
text_la: Tribui filiorum Dan per familias suas egressa est sors septima:
text_pt: A sétima sorte saiu para a tribo dos filhos de Dã, segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Δαν ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος ὁ ἕβδομος

text_en: and the border of their possession was Saraa and Esthaol, and Hirsemes, that is, the city of the sun,
text_la: et fuit terminus possessionis ejus Sara et Esthaol, et Hirsemes, id est, civitas solis.
text_pt: E foi o termo da sua herança, Sora, e Estaol, e Ir-Semes,
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη τὰ ὅρια αὐτῶν Σαραθ καὶ Ασα πόλεις Σαμμαυς

text_en: Selebin and Aialon and Jethela,
text_la: Selebin et Ajalon et Jethela,
text_pt: E Saalabim, e Aijalom, e Itla,
text_el: καὶ Σαλαβιν καὶ Αμμων καὶ Σιλαθα

text_en: Elon and Themna and Acron,
text_la: Elon et Themna et Acron,
text_pt: E Elom, e Timna, e Ecrom,
text_el: καὶ Αιλων καὶ Θαμναθα καὶ Ακκαρων

text_en: Elthece, Gebbethon and Balaath,
text_la: Elthece, Gebbethon et Balaath,
text_pt: E Elteque, e Gibetom, e Baalate,
text_el: καὶ Αλκαθα καὶ Βεγεθων καὶ Γεβεελαν

text_en: and Juda and Bane and Barach and Gethremmon:
text_la: et Jud et Bane et Barach et Gethremmon:
text_pt: E Jeúde, e Bene-Beraque, e Gate-Rimom,
text_el: καὶ Αζωρ καὶ Βαναιβακατ καὶ Γεθρεμμων

text_en: And Mejarcon and Arecon, with the border that looks towards Joppe ,
text_la: et Mejarcon et Arecon, cum termino qui respicit Joppen,
text_pt: E Me-Jarcom, e Racom, com o termo defronte de Jafo;
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ θαλάσσης Ιερακων ὅριον πλησίον Ιόππης

text_en: and is terminated there. And the children of Dan went up and fought against Lesem, and took it: and they put it to the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt in it, calling the name of it Lesem Dan, by the name of Dan their father.
text_la: et ipso fine concluditur. Ascenderuntque filii Dan, et pugnaverunt contra Lesem, ceperuntque eam : et percusserunt eam in ore gladii, et possederunt, et habitaverunt in ea, vocantes nomen ejus Lesem Dan, ex nomine Dan patris sui.
text_pt: Saiu, porém, pequeno termo aos filhos de Dã, pelo que subiram os filhos de Dã, e pelejaram contra Lesém, e a tomaram, e a feriram ao fio da espada, e a possuíram e habitaram nela; e a Lesém chamaram Dã, conforme ao nome de Dã seu pai.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ κληρονομία φυλῆς υἱῶν Δαν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν αἱ πόλεις αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν

text_en: This is the possession of the tribe of the sons of Dan , by their kindreds, the cities and their villages .
text_la: Hæc est possessio tribus filiorum Dan, per cognationes suas, urbes et viculi earum.
text_pt: Esta é a herança da tribo dos filhos de Dã, segundo as suas famílias; estas cidades e as suas aldeias.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ιουδα καὶ ἐπολέμησαν τὴν Λαχις καὶ κατελάβοντο αὐτὴν καὶ ἐπάταξαν αὐτὴν ἐν στόματι μαχαίρας καὶ κατῴκησαν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐκάλεσαν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς Λασενδακ

text_en: And when he had made an end of dividing the land by lot to each one by their tribes , the children of Israel gave a possession to Joshua the son of Nun in the midst of them,
text_la: Cumque complesset sorte dividere terram singulis per tribus suas, dederunt filii Israël possessionem Josue filio Nun in medio sui,
text_pt: Acabando, pois, de repartir a terra em herança segundo os seus termos, deram os filhos de Israel a Josué, filho de Num, herança no meio deles.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ἐμβατεῦσαι τὴν γῆν κατὰ τὸ ὅριον αὐτῶν καὶ ἔδωκαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ κλῆρον Ἰησοῖ τῷ υἱῷ Ναυη ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: according to the commandment of the Lord , the city which he asked for, Thamnath Saraa, in mount Ephraim: and he built up the city, and dwelt in it.
text_la: juxta præceptum Domini, urbem quam postulavit Thamnath Saraa in monte Ephraim : et ædificavit civitatem, habitavitque in ea.
text_pt: Segundo o mandado do Senhor lhe deram a cidade que pediu, a Timnate-Sera, na montanha de Efraim; e reedificou aquela cidade, e habitou nela.
text_el: διὰ προστάγματος τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἔδωκαν αὐτῷ τὴν πόλιν ἣν ᾐτήσατο Θαμνασαραχ ἥ ἐστιν ἐν τῷ ὄρει Εφραιμ καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν πόλιν καὶ κατῴκει ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: These are the possessions which Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the princes of the families , and of the tribes of the children of Israel , distributed by lot in Silo, before the Lord at the door of the tabernacle of the testimony , and they divided the land.
text_la: Hæ sunt possessiones, quas sorte diviserunt Eleazar sacerdos, et Josue filius Nun, et principes familiarum ac tribuum filiorum Israël in Silo, coram Domino ad ostium tabernaculi testimonii : partitique sunt terram.
text_pt: Estas são as heranças que Eleazar, o sacerdote, e Josué, filho de Num, e os cabeças dos pais das famílias repartiram às tribos dos filhos de Israel, em herança, por sorte, em Siló, perante o Senhor, à porta da tenda da congregação. E assim acabaram de repartir a terra.
text_el: αὗται αἱ διαιρέσεις ἃς κατεκληρονόμησεν Ελεαζαρ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ τοῦ Ναυη καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν ἐν ταῖς φυλαῖς Ισραηλ κατὰ κλήρους ἐν Σηλω ἐναντίον κυρίου παρὰ τὰς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ἐμβατεῦσαι τὴν γῆν

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Joshua , saying: Speak to children of Israel and say to them:
text_la: Et locutus est Dominus ad Josue, dicens : Loquere filiis Israël, et dic eis:
text_pt: Falou mais o SENHOR a Josué, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος τῷ Ἰησοῖ λέγων

text_en: Appoint cities of refuge , of which I spoke to you by the hand of Moses :
text_la: Separate urbes fugitivorum, de quibus locutus sum ad vos per manum Moysi:
text_pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Apartai para vós as cidades de refúgio, de que vos falei pelo ministério de Moisés,
text_el: λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ λέγων δότε τὰς πόλεις τῶν φυγαδευτηρίων ἃς εἶπα πρὸς ὑμᾶς διὰ Μωυσῆ

text_en: That whosoever shall kill a person unawares may flee to them, and may escape the wrath of the kinsman, who is the avenger of blood.
text_la: ut confugiat ad eas quicumque animam percusserit nescius, et possit evadere iram proximi, qui ultor est sanguinis:
text_pt: Para que fuja para ali o homicida, que matar alguma pessoa por engano, e não com intenção; para que vos sirvam de refúgio contra o vingador do sangue.
text_el: φυγαδευτήριον τῷ φονευτῇ τῷ πατάξαντι ψυχὴν ἀκουσίως καὶ ἔσονται ὑμῖν αἱ πόλεις φυγαδευτήριον καὶ οὐκ ἀποθανεῖται ὁ φονευτὴς ὑπὸ τοῦ ἀγχιστεύοντος τὸ αἷμα ἕως ἂν καταστῇ ἐναντίον τῆς συναγωγῆς εἰς κρίσιν

text_en: And when he shall flee to one of these cities : he shall stand before the gate of the city , and shall speak to the ancients of that city , such things as prove him innocent: and so shall they receive him, and give him a place to dwell in.
text_la: cum ad unam harum confugerit civitatum, stabit ante portam civitatis, et loquetur senioribus urbis illius ea quæ se comprobent innocentem : sicque suscipient eum, et dabunt ei locum ad habitandum.
text_pt: E fugindo para alguma daquelas cidades, pôr-se-á à porta dela e exporá a sua causa aos ouvidos dos anciãos da tal cidade; então o tomarão consigo na cidade; e lhe darão lugar, para que habite com eles.

text_en: And when the avenger of blood shall pursue him, they shall not deliver him into his hands, because he slew his neighbour unawares, and is not proved to have been his enemy two or three days before,
text_la: Cumque ultor sanguinis eum fuerit persecutus, non tradent in manus ejus : quia ignorans percussit proximum ejus, nec ante biduum triduumve ejus probatur inimicus.
text_pt: E se o vingador do sangue o seguir, não entregarão na sua mão o homicida, porquanto não feriu a seu próximo com intenção, e não o odiou antes.

text_en: and he shall dwell in that city , till he stand before judgment to give an account of his fact, and till the death of the high priest , who shall be at that time: then shall the manslayer return, and go into his own city and house from whence he fled.
text_la: Et habitabit in civitate illa, donec stet ante judicium, causam reddens facti sui, et moriatur sacerdos magnus, qui fuerit in illo tempore : tunc revertetur homicida, et ingredietur civitatem et domum suam de qua fugerat.
text_pt: E habitará na mesma cidade, até que compareça em juízo perante a congregação, até que morra o sumo sacerdote que houver naqueles dias; então o homicida voltará, e virá à sua cidade e à sua casa, à cidade de onde fugiu.

text_en: And they appointed Cedes in Galilee of mount Nephtali, and Sichem in mount Ephraim, and Cariath-Arbe, the same is Hebron in the mountain of Juda .
text_la: Decreveruntque Cedes in Galilæa montis Nephthali, et Sichem in monte Ephraim, et Cariatharbe, ipsa est Hebron in monte Juda.
text_pt: Então designaram a Quedes na Galiléia, na montanha de Naftali, e a Siquém, na montanha de Efraim, e a Quiriate-Arba (esta é Hebrom), na montanha de Judá.
text_el: καὶ διέστειλεν τὴν Καδης ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ ἐν τῷ ὄρει τῷ Νεφθαλι καὶ Συχεμ ἐν τῷ ὄρει τῷ Εφραιμ καὶ τὴν πόλιν Αρβοκ αὕτη ἐστὶν Χεβρων ἐν τῷ ὄρει τῷ Ιουδα

text_en: And beyond the Jordan to the east of Jericho , they appointed Bosor, which is upon the plain of the wilderness of the tribe of Ruben , and Ramoth in Galaad of the tribe of Gad , and Gaulon in Basan of the tribe of Manasses .
text_la: Et trans Jordanem contra orientalem plagam Jericho, statuerunt Bosor, quæ sita est in campestri solitudine de tribu Ruben, et Ramoth in Galaad de tribu Gad, et Gaulon in Basan de tribu Manasse.
text_pt: E, além do Jordão, na direção de Jericó para o oriente, designaram a Bezer, no deserto, na campina da tribo de Rúben, e a Ramote, em Gileade da tribo de Gade, e a Golã, em Basã da tribo de Manassés.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἔδωκεν Βοσορ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ ἀπὸ τῆς φυλῆς Ρουβην καὶ Αρημωθ ἐν τῇ Γαλααδ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Γαδ καὶ τὴν Γαυλων ἐν τῇ Βασανίτιδι ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Μανασση

text_en: These cities were appointed for all the children of Israel , and for the strangers, that dwelt among them, that whosoever had killed a person unawares might flee to them, and not die by the hand of the kinsman, coveting to revenge the blood that was shed, until he should stand before the people to lay open his cause.
text_la: Hæ civitates constitutæ sunt cunctis filiis Israël, et advenis qui habitabant inter eos, ut fugeret ad eas qui animam nescius percussisset, et non moreretur in manu proximi, effusum sanguinem vindicare cupientis, donec staret ante populum expositurus causam suam.
text_pt: Estas são as cidades que foram designadas para todos os filhos de Israel, e para o estrangeiro que habitasse entre eles, para que se acolhesse a elas todo aquele que por engano matasse alguma pessoa, para que não morresse às mãos do vingador do sangue, até se apresentar diante da congregação.
text_el: αὗται αἱ πόλεις αἱ ἐπίκλητοι τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ τῷ προσηλύτῳ τῷ προσκειμένῳ ἐν αὐτοῖς καταφυγεῖν ἐκεῖ παντὶ παίοντι ψυχὴν ἀκουσίως ἵνα μὴ ἀποθάνῃ ἐν χειρὶ τοῦ ἀγχιστεύοντος τὸ αἷμα ἕως ἂν καταστῇ ἔναντι τῆς συναγωγῆς εἰς κρίσιν

text_en: Then the princes of the families of Levi came to Eleazar the priest , and to Joshua the son of Nun , and to the princes of the kindreds of all the tribes of the children of Israel .
text_la: Accesseruntque principes familiarum Levi ad Eleazarum sacerdotem, et Josue filium Nun, et ad duces cognationum per singulas tribus filiorum Israël:
text_pt: Então os cabeças dos pais dos levitas se achegaram a Eleazar, o sacerdote, e a Josué, filho de Num, e aos cabeças dos pais das tribos dos filhos de Israel;
text_el: καὶ προσήλθοσαν οἱ ἀρχιπατριῶται τῶν υἱῶν Λευι πρὸς Ελεαζαρ τὸν ἱερέα καὶ πρὸς Ἰησοῦν τὸν τοῦ Ναυη καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιφύλους πατριῶν ἐκ τῶν φυλῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And they spoke to them in Silo in the land of Chanaan , and said: The Lord commanded by the hand of Moses , that cities should be given us to dwell in, and their suburbs to feed our cattle.
text_la: locutique sunt ad eos in Silo terræ Chanaan, atque dixerunt : Dominus præcepit per manum Moysi, ut darentur nobis urbes ad habitandum, et suburbana earum ad alenda jumenta.
text_pt: E falaram-lhes em Siló, na terra de Canaã, dizendo: O Senhor ordenou, pelo ministério de Moisés, que se nos dessem cidades para habitar, e os seus arrabaldes para os nossos animais.
text_el: καὶ εἶπον πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἐν Σηλω ἐν γῇ Χανααν λέγοντες ἐνετείλατο κύριος ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ δοῦναι ἡμῖν πόλεις κατοικεῖν καὶ τὰ περισπόρια τοῖς κτήνεσιν ἡμῶν

text_en: And the children of Israel gave out of their possessions according to the commandment of the Lord , cities and their suburbs.
text_la: Dederuntque filii Israël de possessionibus suis juxta imperium Domini, civitates et suburbana earum.
text_pt: Por isso os filhos de Israel deram aos levitas da sua herança, conforme a ordem do Senhor, as seguintes cidades e os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τοῖς Λευίταις ἐν τῷ κατακληρονομεῖν διὰ προστάγματος κυρίου τὰς πόλεις καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῶν

text_en: And the lot came out for the family of Caath of the children of Aaron the priest out of the tribes of Juda , and of Simeon , and of Benjamin , thirteen cities.
text_la: Egressaque est sors in familiam Caath filiorum Aaron sacerdotis, de tribubus Juda, et Simeon, et Benjamin, civitates tredecim:
text_pt: E saiu a sorte para as famílias dos coatitas; e aos filhos de Arão, o sacerdote, que eram dos levitas, tiveram por sorte da tribo de Judá, e da tribo de Simeão, e da tribo de Benjamim, treze cidades;
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος τῷ δήμῳ Κααθ καὶ ἐγένετο τοῖς υἱοῖς Ααρων τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν τοῖς Λευίταις ἀπὸ φυλῆς Ιουδα καὶ ἀπὸ φυλῆς Συμεων καὶ ἀπὸ φυλῆς Βενιαμιν κληρωτὶ πόλεις δέκα τρεῖς

text_en: And to the rest of the children of Caath, that is, to you Levites , who remained, out of the tribes of Ephraim, and of Dan , and the half tribe of Manasses , ten cities.
text_la: et reliquis filiorum Caath, id est Levitis, qui superfuerant, de tribubus Ephraim, et Dan, et dimidia tribu Manasse, civitates decem.
text_pt: E aos outros filhos de Coate couberam por sorte, das famílias da tribo de Efraim, e da tribo de Dã, e da meia tribo de Manassés, dez cidades;
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Κααθ τοῖς καταλελειμμένοις ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Εφραιμ καὶ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Δαν καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασση κληρωτὶ πόλεις δέκα

text_en: And the lot came out to children of Gerson, that they should take of the tribes of Issachar and of Aser and of Nephtali , and of the half tribe of Manasses in Basan, thirteen cities.
text_la: Porro filii Gerson egressa est sors, ut acciperent de tribubus Issachar et Aser et Nephthali, dimidiaque tribu Manasse in Basan, civitates numero tredecim.
text_pt: E aos filhos de Gérson couberam por sorte, das famílias da tribo de Issacar, e da tribo de Aser, e da tribo de Naftali, e da meia tribo de Manassés, em Basã, treze cidades;
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Γεδσων ἀπὸ τῆς φυλῆς Ισσαχαρ καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς φυλῆς Ασηρ καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς φυλῆς Νεφθαλι καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασση ἐν τῷ Βασαν πόλεις δέκα τρεῖς

text_en: And to the sons of Merari by their kindreds, of the tribes of Ruben and of Gad and of Zabulon , twelve cities.
text_la: Et filiis Merari per cognationes suas de tribubus Ruben et Gad et Zabulon urbes duodecim.
text_pt: Aos filhos de Merari, segundo as suas famílias, da tribo de Rúben, e da tribo de Gade, e da tribo de Zebulom, doze cidades;
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Μεραρι κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν ἀπὸ φυλῆς Ρουβην καὶ ἀπὸ φυλῆς Γαδ καὶ ἀπὸ φυλῆς Ζαβουλων κληρωτὶ πόλεις δώδεκα

text_en: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities and their suburbs, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses , giving to every one by lot.
text_la: Dederuntque filii Israël Levitis civitates et suburbana earum, sicut præcepit Dominus per manum Moysi, singulis sorte tribuentes.
text_pt: E deram os filhos de Israel aos levitas estas cidades e os seus arrabaldes por sorte, como o Senhor ordenara pelo ministério de Moisés.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τοῖς Λευίταις τὰς πόλεις καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῶν ὃν τρόπον ἐνετείλατο κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ κληρωτί

text_en: Of the tribes of the children of Juda and of Simeon Joshua gave cities: whose names are these,
text_la: De tribubus filiorum Juda et Simeon dedit Josue civitates, quarum ista sunt nomina,
text_pt: Deram mais, da tribo dos filhos de Judá e da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, estas cidades, que por nome foram mencionadas,
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν ἡ φυλὴ υἱῶν Ιουδα καὶ ἡ φυλὴ υἱῶν Συμεων καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς φυλῆς υἱῶν Βενιαμιν τὰς πόλεις καὶ ἐπεκλήθησαν

text_en: to the sons of Aaron , of the families of Caath of the race of Levi (for the first lot came out for them)
text_la: filiis Aaron per familias Caath Levitici generis (prima enim sors illis egressa est),
text_pt: Para que fossem dos filhos de Arão, das famílias dos coatitas dos filhos de Levi; porquanto a primeira sorte foi sua.
text_el: τοῖς υἱοῖς Ααρων ἀπὸ τοῦ δήμου τοῦ Κααθ τῶν υἱῶν Λευι ὅτι τούτοις ἐγενήθη ὁ κλῆρος

text_en: the city of Arbe the father of Enac, which is called Hebron , in the mountain of Juda , and the suburbs thereof round about.
text_la: Cariatharbe patris Enac, quæ vocatur Hebron, in monte Juda, et suburbana ejus per circuitum.
text_pt: Assim lhes deram a cidade de Arba, do pai de Anaque (esta é Hebrom), no monte de Judá, e os seus arrabaldes ao redor.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς τὴν Καριαθαρβοκ μητρόπολιν τῶν Ενακ αὕτη ἐστὶν Χεβρων ἐν τῷ ὄρει Ιουδα τὰ δὲ περισπόρια κύκλῳ αὐτῆς

text_en: But the fields and the villages thereof he had given to Caleb the son of Jephone for his possession.
text_la: Agros vero et villas ejus dederat Caleb filio Jephone ad possidendum.
text_pt: Porém o campo da cidade, e as suas aldeias, deram a Calebe, filho de Jefoné, por sua possessão.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς ἀγροὺς τῆς πόλεως καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς ἔδωκεν Ἰησοῦς τοῖς υἱοῖς Χαλεβ υἱοῦ Ιεφοννη ἐν κατασχέσει

text_en: He gave therefore to the children of Aaron the priest , Hebron a city of refuge , and the suburbs thereof, and Lebna with the suburbs thereof,
text_la: Dedit ergo filiis Aaron sacerdotis Hebron confugii civitatem, ac suburbana ejus : et Lobnam cum suburbanis suis:
text_pt: Assim aos filhos de Arão, o sacerdote, deram Hebrom, cidade do refúgio do homicida, e os seus arrabaldes, Libna e os seus arrabaldes;
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ααρων τὴν πόλιν φυγαδευτήριον τῷ φονεύσαντι τὴν Χεβρων καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα τὰ σὺν αὐτῇ καὶ τὴν Λεμνα καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα τὰ πρὸς αὐτῇ

text_en: and Jether and Estemo,
text_la: et Jether, et Esthemo,
text_pt: Jatir e os seus arrabaldes, e Estemoa e os seus arrabaldes;
text_el: καὶ τὴν Αιλωμ καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ καὶ τὴν Τεμα καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ

text_en: and Holon, and Dabir,
text_la: et Holon, et Dabir,
text_pt: E Holom e os seus arrabaldes, e Debir e os seus arrabaldes;
text_el: καὶ τὴν Γελλα καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ καὶ τὴν Δαβιρ καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ

text_en: and Ain, and Jeta, and Bethsames, with their suburbs: nine cities out of the two tribes , as has been said.
text_la: et Ain, et Jeta, et Bethsames, cum suburbanis suis : civitates novem de tribubus, ut dictum est, duabus.
text_pt: E Aim e os seus arrabaldes, e Jutá e os seus arrabaldes, e Bete-Semes e os seus arrabaldes; nove cidades destas duas tribos.
text_el: καὶ Ασα καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ καὶ Τανυ καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ καὶ Βαιθσαμυς καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ πόλεις ἐννέα παρὰ τῶν δύο φυλῶν τούτων

text_en: And out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin , Gabaon, and Gabae,
text_la: De tribu autem filiorum Benjamin, Gabaon, et Gabæ,
text_pt: E da tribo de Benjamim, Gibeão e os seus arrabaldes, Geba e os seus arrabaldes;
text_el: καὶ παρὰ τῆς φυλῆς Βενιαμιν τὴν Γαβαων καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ καὶ Γαθεθ καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ

text_en: and Anathoth and Almon, with, their suburbs: four cities.
text_la: et Anathoth et Almon, cum suburbanis suis : civitates quatuor.
text_pt: Anatote e os seus arrabaldes, e Almom e os seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.
text_el: καὶ Αναθωθ καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ καὶ Γαμαλα καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ πόλεις τέσσαρες

text_en: All the cities together of the children of Aaron the priest , were thirteen, with their suburbs,
text_la: Omnes simul civitates filiorum Aaron sacerdotis, tredecim, cum suburbanis suis.
text_pt: Todas as cidades dos sacerdotes, filhos de Arão, foram treze cidades e os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: πᾶσαι αἱ πόλεις υἱῶν Ααρων τῶν ἱερέων δέκα τρεῖς

text_en: and to the rest of the families of the children of Caath of the race of Levi was given this possession.
text_la: Reliquis vero per familias filiorum Caath Levitici generis, hæc est data possessio.
text_pt: E as famílias dos filhos de Coate, levitas, que ficaram dos filhos de Coate, tiveram as cidades da sua sorte, da tribo de Efraim.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς δήμοις υἱοῖς Κααθ τοῖς Λευίταις τοῖς καταλελειμμένοις ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Κααθ καὶ ἐγενήθη πόλις τῶν ὁρίων αὐτῶν ἀπὸ φυλῆς Εφραιμ

text_en: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Sichem one of the cities of refuge , with the suburbs thereof in mount Ephraim, and Gazer,
text_la: De tribu Ephraim urbes confugii, Sichem cum suburbanis suis in monte Ephraim, et Gazer
text_pt: E deram-lhes Siquém, cidade de refúgio do homicida, e os seus arrabaldes, no monte de Efraim, e Gezer e os seus arrabaldes;
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν αὐτοῖς τὴν πόλιν τοῦ φυγαδευτηρίου τὴν τοῦ φονεύσαντος τὴν Συχεμ καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ καὶ Γαζαρα καὶ τὰ πρὸς αὐτὴν καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ

text_en: and Cibsaim, and Beth-horon, with their suburbs, four cities.
text_la: et Cibsaim et Beth-horon, cum suburbanis suis, civitates quatuor.
text_pt: E Quibzaim e os seus arrabaldes, e Bete-Horom e os seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.
text_el: καὶ τὴν Καβσαϊμ καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα τὰ πρὸς αὐτῇ καὶ τὴν ἄνω Βαιθωρων καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ πόλεις τέσσαρες

text_en: And of the tribe of Dan , Eltheco and Gabathon,
text_la: De tribu quoque Dan, Eltheco et Gabathon,
text_pt: E da tribo de Dã, Elteque e os seus arrabaldes, Gibetom e os seus arrabaldes;
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Δαν τὴν Ελκωθαιμ καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ καὶ τὴν Γεθεδαν καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ

text_en: and Aialon and Gethremmon, with their suburbs, four cities.
text_la: et Ajalon et Gethremmon, cum suburbanis suis, civitates quatuor.
text_pt: Aijalom e os seus arrabaldes, Gate-Rimom e os seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.
text_el: καὶ Αιλων καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ καὶ Γεθερεμμων καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ πόλεις τέσσαρες

text_en: And of the half tribe of Manasses , Thanac and Gethremmon, with their suburbs, two cities.
text_la: Porro de dimidia tribu Manasse, Thanach et Gethremmon, cum suburbanis suis, civitates duæ.
text_pt: E da meia tribo de Manassés, Taanaque e os seus arrabaldes, e Gate-Rimom e os seus arrabaldes; duas cidades.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασση τὴν Ταναχ καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ καὶ τὴν Ιεβαθα καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ πόλεις δύο

text_en: All the cities were ten, with their suburbs, which were given to the children of Caath, of the inferior degree.
text_la: Omnes civitates decem, et suburbana earum, datæ sunt filiis Caath inferioris gradus.
text_pt: As cidades para as famílias dos demais filhos de Coate, foram dez e os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: πᾶσαι πόλεις δέκα καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα τὰ πρὸς αὐταῖς τοῖς δήμοις υἱῶν Κααθ τοῖς ὑπολελειμμένοις

text_en: To the children of Gerson also of the race of Levi out of the half tribe of Manasses , Gaulon in Basan, one of the cities of refuge , and Bosra, with their suburbs, two cities.
text_la: Filiis quoque Gerson Levitici generis dedit de dimidia tribu Manasse confugii civitates, Gaulon in Basan, et Bosram, cum suburbanis suis, civitates duas.
text_pt: E aos filhos de Gérson, das famílias dos levitas, deram da meia tribo de Manassés, Golã, cidade de refúgio do homicida, em Basã, e os seus arrabaldes, e Beesterá e os seus arrabaldes; duas cidades.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Γεδσων τοῖς Λευίταις ἐκ τοῦ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασση τὰς πόλεις τὰς ἀφωρισμένας τοῖς φονεύσασι τὴν Γαυλων ἐν τῇ Βασανίτιδι καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ καὶ τὴν Βοσοραν καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ πόλεις δύο

text_en: And of the tribe of Issachar , Cesion, and Dabereth,
text_la: Porro de tribu Issachar, Cesion, et Dabereth,
text_pt: E da tribo de Issacar, Quisiom e os seus arrabaldes, Daberate e os seus arrabaldes,
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ισσαχαρ τὴν Κισων καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ καὶ Δεββα καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ

text_en: and Jaramoth, and Engannim, with their suburbs, four cities.
text_la: et Jaramoth, et Engannim, cum suburbanis suis, civitates quatuor.
text_pt: Jarmute e os seus arrabaldes, En-Ganim e os seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.
text_el: καὶ τὴν Ρεμμαθ καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ καὶ Πηγὴν γραμμάτων καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ πόλεις τέσσαρες

text_en: And of the tribe of Aser , Masal and Abdon,
text_la: De tribu autem Aser, Masal et Abdon,
text_pt: E da tribo de Aser, Misal e os seus arrabaldes, Abdom e os seus arrabaldes,
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ασηρ τὴν Βασελλαν καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ καὶ Δαββων καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ

text_en: and Helcath, and Rohob, with their suburbs, four cities.
text_la: et Helcath, et Rohob, cum suburbanis suis, civitates quatuor.
text_pt: Helcate e os seus arrabaldes, e Reobe e os seus arrabaldes;
text_el: καὶ Χελκατ καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ καὶ Ρααβ καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ πόλεις τέσσαρες

text_en: Of the tribe also of Nephtali , Cedes in Galilee , one of the cities of refuge : and Hammoth Dor, and Carthan, with their suburbs, three cities.
text_la: De tribu quoque Nephthali civitates confugii, Cedes in Galilæa, et Hammoth Dor, et Carthan, cum suburbanis suis, civitates tres.
text_pt: E da tribo de Naftali, Quedes, cidade de refúgio do homicida, na Galiléia, e os seus arrabaldes, e Hamote-Dor e os seus arrabaldes, e Cartã e os seus arrabaldes; três cidades.
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Νεφθαλι τὴν πόλιν τὴν ἀφωρισμένην τῷ φονεύσαντι τὴν Καδες ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ καὶ τὴν Εμμαθ καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ καὶ Θεμμων καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ πόλεις τρεῖς

text_en: All the cities of the families of Gerson, were thirteen, with their suburbs.
text_la: Omnes urbes familiarum Gerson, tredecim, cum suburbanis suis.
text_pt: Todas as cidades dos gersonitas, segundo as suas famílias, foram treze cidades e os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: πᾶσαι αἱ πόλεις τοῦ Γεδσων κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν πόλεις δέκα τρεῖς

text_en: And to the children of Merari, Levites of the inferior degree, by their families were given of the tribe of Zabulon , Jecnam and Cartha,
text_la: Filiis autem Merari Levitis inferioris gradus per familias suas data est de tribu Zabulon, Jecnam, et Cartha
text_pt: E às famílias dos filhos de Merari, aos demais levitas, foram dadas, da tribo de Zebulom, Jocneão e os seus arrabaldes, Cartã e os seus arrabaldes,
text_el: καὶ τῷ δήμῳ υἱῶν Μεραρι τοῖς Λευίταις τοῖς λοιποῖς ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς υἱῶν Ζαβουλων τὴν Μααν καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Καδης καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: and Damna and Naalol, four cities with their suburbs.
text_la: et Damna et Naalol, civitates quatuor cum suburbanis suis.
text_pt: Dimna e os seus arrabaldes, Naalal e os seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.
text_el: καὶ Δεμνα καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ Σελλα καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς πόλεις τέσσαρες

text_en: Of the tribe of Ruben beyond the Jordan over against Jericho , Bosor in the wilderness , one of the cities of refuge , Misor and Jaser and Jethson and Mephaath, four cities with their suburbs.
text_la: De tribu Ruben ultra Jordanem contra Jericho civitates refugii, Bosor in solitudine, Misor et Jaser et Jethson et Mephaath, civitates quatuor cum suburbanis suis.
text_pt: E da tribo de Rúben, Bezer e os seus arrabaldes, e Jaza e os seus arrabaldes,
text_el: καὶ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου τοῦ κατὰ Ιεριχω ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ρουβην τὴν πόλιν τὸ φυγαδευτήριον τοῦ φονεύσαντος τὴν Βοσορ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τῇ Μισωρ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Ιαζηρ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.
text_pt: Quedemote e os seus arrabaldes, e Mefaate e os seus arrabaldes; quatro cidades.
text_el: καὶ τὴν Δεκμων καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Μαφα καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς πόλεις τέσσαρες

text_en: Of the tribe of Gad , Ramoth in Galaad, one of the cities of refuge , and Manaim
text_la: De tribu Gad civitates confugii, Ramoth in Galaad, et Manaim
text_pt: E da tribo de Gade, Ramote, cidade de refúgio do homicida, em Gileade, e os seus arrabaldes, e Maanaim e os seus arrabaldes,
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς φυλῆς Γαδ τὴν πόλιν τὸ φυγαδευτήριον τοῦ φονεύσαντος τὴν Ραμωθ ἐν τῇ Γαλααδ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Καμιν καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: and Hesebon and Jaser, four cities with their suburbs,
text_la: et Hesebon et Jazer, civitates quatuor cum suburbanis suis.
text_pt: Hesbom e os seus arrabaldes, Jazer e os seus arrabaldes; ao todo, quatro cidades.
text_el: καὶ τὴν Εσεβων καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Ιαζηρ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς αἱ πᾶσαι πόλεις τέσσαρες

text_en: all the cities of the children of Merari by their families and kindreds, were twelve.
text_la: Omnes urbes filiorum Merari per familias et cognationes suas, duodecim.
text_pt: Todas estas cidades foram dos filhos de Merari, segundo as suas famílias, que ainda restavam das famílias dos dos levitas; e foi a sua sorte doze cidades.
text_el: πᾶσαι πόλεις τοῖς υἱοῖς Μεραρι κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν τῶν καταλελειμμένων ἀπὸ τῆς φυλῆς Λευι καὶ ἐγενήθη τὰ ὅρια πόλεις δέκα δύο

text_en: So all the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty-eight,
text_la: Itaque civitates universæ Levitarum in medio possessionis filiorum Israël fuerunt quadraginta octo
text_pt: Todas as cidades dos levitas, no meio da herança dos filhos de Israel, foram quarenta e oito cidades e os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: πᾶσαι αἱ πόλεις τῶν Λευιτῶν ἐν μέσῳ κατασχέσεως υἱῶν Ισραηλ τεσσαράκοντα ὀκτὼ πόλεις καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῶν

text_en: with their suburbs, each distributed by the families .
text_la: cum suburbanis suis, singulæ per familias distributæ.
text_pt: Estavam estas cidades, cada uma com os seus arrabaldes em redor delas; assim estavam todas estas cidades.
text_el: κύκλῳ τῶν πόλεων τούτων πόλις καὶ τὰ περισπόρια κύκλῳ τῆς πόλεως πάσαις ταῖς πόλεσιν ταύταις

text_en: And the Lord God gave to Israel all the land that he had sworn to give to their fathers: and they possessed it, and dwelt in it.
text_la: Deditque Dominus Deus Israëli omnem terram, quam traditurum se patribus eorum juraverat : et possederunt illam, atque habitaverunt in ea.
text_pt: Desta maneira deu o Senhor a Israel toda a terra que jurara dar a seus pais; e a possuíram e habitaram nela.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν κύριος τῷ Ισραηλ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσεν δοῦναι τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν καὶ κατεκληρονόμησαν αὐτὴν καὶ κατῴκησαν ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And he gave them peace from all nations round about: and none of their enemies dared stand against them, but were brought under their dominion.
text_la: Dataque est ab eo pax in omnes per circuitum nationes : nullusque eis hostium resistere ausus est, sed cuncti in eorum ditionem redacti sunt.
text_pt: E o Senhor lhes deu repouso de todos os lados, conforme a tudo quanto jurara a seus pais; e nenhum de todos os seus inimigos pôde resisti-los; todos os seus inimigos o Senhor entregou-lhes nas mãos.
text_el: καὶ κατέπαυσεν αὐτοὺς κύριος κυκλόθεν καθότι ὤμοσεν τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν οὐκ ἀνέστη οὐθεὶς κατενώπιον αὐτῶν ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν πάντας τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτῶν παρέδωκεν κύριος εἰς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν

text_en: Not so much as one word, which he had promised to perform unto them, was made void, but all came to pass.
text_la: Ne unum quidem verbum, quod illis præstiturum se esse promiserat, irritum fuit, sed rebus expleta sunt omnia.
text_pt: Palavra alguma falhou de todas as boas coisas que o Senhor falou à casa de Israel; tudo se cumpriu.
text_el: οὐ διέπεσεν ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ῥημάτων τῶν καλῶν ὧν ἐλάλησεν κύριος τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ πάντα παρεγένετο

text_en: At the same time Joshua called the Rubenites , and the Gadites , and the half tribe of Manasses ,
text_la: Eodem tempore vocavit Josue Rubenitas, et Gaditas, et dimidiam tribum Manasse,
